celebration.name_latin: Patrocinium Sancti Benedicti Abbatis, Patroni principalis Europae

summary_en: The Sacred Congregation of Rites, following Paul VI's Apostolic Letter Pacis nuntius (24 Oct 1964) naming St Benedict principal Patron of Europe, approves a proper Mass of St Benedict, Patron of Europe, and grants that on 11 July each year in every church and oratory of Europe it may be celebrated as a votive Mass of II class (two such Masses only when 11 July is a Sunday), while the feast of St Benedict on 21 March remains at III class; no protocol number is printed (the grade is given on the 1960 Code of Rubrics scale, so no API grade is assigned).
excerpt: Eadem insuper Sacra Rituum Congregatio, firmo manente S. Benedicti Abbatis festo gradu III classis die 21 mensis martii, servatis rubricis, recolendo, indulget ut, quotannis die 11 mensis iulii, in omnibus et singulis Europae ecclesiis et oratoriis, Missa de praefato patrocinio S. Benedicti celebrari possit tamquam votiva II classis.

summary_en: Letter of the Sacred Congregation of Rites to the Prefect of the Congregation of the Council, turning into a norm its 1965 reply to a dubium on which Mass is said at an evening Mass satisfying the festive precept (Notitiae 1 [1965] 307, n. 87): wherever an Ordinary is granted the faculty to let the faithful satisfy the precept at Mass on the evening of Saturday or of the day before a feast of precept, the rescript is to state that the liturgical texts of the following Sunday or feast are used, and that the homily and the prayer of the faithful are not omitted. This is the universal basis of the anticipated (vigil) Mass as the API models it.
excerpt: ... velit in relativo Rescripto mentionem facere de adhibendis, talibus in casibus, de mandato Sacrae huius Congregationis, textibus liturgicis sive dominicae sive festi sequentis, atque de non omittendis homilia et oratione fidelium, ad mentem Instructionis S. R. C. diei 26 septembris 1964, nn. 53-56.

celebration.name_latin: S. Ioseph, Sponsi B. Mariae Virginis, Conf. et Ecclesiae universae Patroni

summary_en: For the year 1967 only (Urbis et Orbis), the Office and Mass of St Joseph, Spouse of the BVM and Patron of the universal Church, are to be celebrated on 18 March instead of being transferred by the rubrics from 19 March (Passion Sunday II, 'in palmis') to 3 April; Paul VI granted this in the audience of 9 May 1966 and the SCR published it on 13 May 1966. No protocol number is printed; the grade of the celebration is not stated on the page.
excerpt:
Sanctissimus porro Dominus noster Paulus Papa VI, referente infrascripto S. R. C. Cardinali Praefecto, in Audientia die 9 maii anni huius eidem concessa, relatis precibus benigne annuit statuitque ut proximo anno 1967 Officium et Missa de S. Ioseph, Sponso B. M. V., Conf. et Ecclesiae universae Patrono, celebrentur die 18 martii: servatis de cetero rubricis.
Ex Secretaria S. Rituum Congregationis, die 13 maii 1966.

summary_en: Declaration of the Sacred Congregation of Rites for the year 1967 only: since the Fourth Sunday of Advent falls on the Vigil of the Nativity, the Mass of the day is that of the Vigil, but the anticipated evening Mass of Saturday 23 December 1967 (satisfying the Sunday precept by apostolic indult) is to be the Mass of the Fourth Sunday of Advent, not of the Vigil. No protocol number is printed; recorded as a one-year occurrence ruling on the universal calendar rather than a permanent change, hence flagged for review.
excerpt: Cum Dominica IV Adventus, hoc anno 1967, incidat in Vigiliam Nativitatis D. N. I. C., Missa dicitur de Vigilia. Ubi vero ex apostolico indulto horis post-meridianis Sabbati diei 23 decembris 1967 celebratur Missa ad satisfaciendum praeceptum pro dominica sequenti, Sacra Rituum Congregatio declarat Missam vespertinam, in praedicto Sabbato, dicendam esse, non de Vigilia Nativitatis, sed de Dominica IV Adventus.

summary_en: Declaration of the Sacred Congregation of Rites fixing the 1969 calendar for places where the solemnities of the Epiphany, the Ascension and Corpus Christi are no longer of precept and have been transferred to Sunday: Epiphany on Sunday 5 January (Holy Name of Jesus moved to Monday 6 January), Ascension on Sunday 18 May (Vigil on Saturday 17 May; the weekday of 14 May with commemoration of St Boniface, St John Baptist de la Salle on 15 May, St Ubald on 16 May) and Corpus Christi on Sunday 8 June (St Boniface on 5 June, St Norbert on 6 June, Saturday of Our Lady on 7 June), with the Scripture readings of the Office reassigned accordingly. No protocol number is printed. Marked for review because the declaration binds only where the transfer indult is in force, so the reviewer should confirm the general_calendar classification.
excerpt: haec Sacra Congregatio Rituum declarat, in locis ubi supradicta festa iam non sunt de praecepto, adveniente anno 1969 servandum esse Calendarium quod sequitur: Die 5 ianuarii, Dominica: IN EPIPHANIA DOMINI, I cl. Die 6 ianuarii, feria II: SS. Nominis Iesu, II cl. [...] Die 18 maii, Dominica: IN ASCENSIONE DOMINI, I cl. [...] Die 8 iunii, Dominica: SS.MI CORPORIS CHRISTI, I cl.

summary_en: Paul VI's motu proprio Mysterii paschalis approves the Normae universales de anno liturgico et de Calendario and the new Calendarium Romanum generale for the whole Latin Church, in force from 1 January 1970; the Normae follow at pp. 165-176 (pdf 51-62) and the Calendarium at pp. 177-186 (pdf 63-72), with the interim Schema Calendarii generalis pro anno 1970 at pp. 187-202 (pdf 73-88).
excerpt: Huiusmodi ergo causis diligentissime coram Domino perpensis, novum Calendarium Romanum generale a Consilio ad exsequendam Constitutionem de Sacra Liturgia compositum, itemque normas universales ad ordinationem anni liturgici spectantes, Apostolica Nostra auctoritate approbamus, ut a die I mensis Ianuarii proximi anni MCMLXX vigere incipiant

summary_en: Decree of the Sacred Congregation of Rites promulgating the Normae universales and the Calendarium Romanum generale approved by Mysterii paschalis, in force 1 January 1970, with interim rules for using the new Calendar with the old books (solemnities/feasts/memorials treated as I/II/III class feasts, Baptism of the Lord and Christ the King on their new days, suppressed feasts no longer celebrated in the Roman rite but retainable in particular calendars, transferred saints kept on their old day until the new books, newly inscribed saints as optional memorials) and ordering that all diocesan and religious calendars and Propers be conformed to the new general Calendar.
excerpt: Anni liturgici ordinatione atque generali Calendario Romano a Summo Pontifice PAULO PP. VI approbatis, per Litteras Apostolicas Mysterii paschalis celebrationem die 14 februarii 1969 motu proprio datas, Sacra haec Congregatio, de speciali mandato eiusdem Summi Pontificis ea promulgat, statuens ut a die 1 ianuarii proximi anni 1970 vigere incipiant.

summary_en: The Order of Preachers may adopt the Missale Romanum and the Normae universales with the new Calendarium Romanum generale and the Litany of Saints for the whole Order; ad interim, until its own particular calendar is approved, the Order's I-class saints (B.M.V. a Rosario, S. Dominicus, S. Thomas Aquinas, S. Catharina Senensis) become solemnities, II-class feasts remain feasts, III-class saints and Beati become obligatory memorials, and the rest optional memorials.
excerpt: Dum Calendarium particulare definitivum Ordinis rite paratum sit et approbatum, ad interim, Sancti Ordinis Fratrum Praedicatorum qui celebrantur tamquam festa I classis, habeantur tamquam Sollemnitates (nempe, B. M. V. a Rosario, S. Dominici, S. Thomae Aquinatis et S. Catharinae Senensis); qui vero recensentur tamquam festa II classis, tamquam « festa » recolantur

summary_en: Instruction of the Congregation for Divine Worship on accommodating particular calendars 'ad interim' for 1970 until the typical editions are complete: celebrations also in the general Calendar follow it; proper celebrations hitherto in particular calendars are kept, I-class feasts as solemnities, II-class as feasts, III-class as obligatory memorials (one chosen when they coincide with a general obligatory memorial), commemorations as optional memorials or omitted; the same applies to feasts of Beati. Kind is 'other' because it is a general norm about every particular calendar rather than a change to one of them.
excerpt: Interim, pro anno 1970 et donec editio typica librorum liturgicorum completa sit, haec serventur: 1. Celebrationes, quae etiam in Calendario generali inscribuntur, eadem ratione, qua in eo recensentur, peragantur. 2. Celebrationes propriae usque adhuc in Calendariis particularibus inscriptae, retineantur, et recolantur eadem ratione ac celebrationes in Calendario generali retentae

summary_en: The proper Calendar of the Order of St Benedict, adapted to the new Roman Calendar, is approved for two years.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, 7 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 623/69): probatur « ad biennium » Calendarium proprium O.S.B., aptatum novo Calendario Romano.

summary_en: The proper Calendar and Offices of the diocese of Lodi (Laudensis), revised according to the Instruction of the Congregation of Rites of 14 February 1961, are approved. Two protocol numbers are printed; the id uses the first.
excerpt: Italia, Laudensis: 14 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 542/69 et 721/69): probantur Calendarium et Officia Propria, recognita iuxta Instructionem S. C. Rituum, diei 14 febr. 1961.

summary_en: The Redemptorists may celebrate St Clement Mary Hofbauer on 16 March 1970 with the grade of feast, for that year only, the 150th anniversary of his death.
excerpt: Congregatio SS.mi Redemptoris, 18 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 826/69): conceditur ut festum S. Clementis Mariae Hofbauer, Presbyteri, die 16 martii celebrari possit, pro anno 1970, tamquam festum. Nam illo die complentur 150 anni ab eius morte.

summary_en: The Rogationists may, for ten years, celebrate votive Masses of the Most Holy Name of Jesus in their churches and oratories on 31 January, unless a solemnity occurs. Recorded as 'other' with review because it is a votive-Mass indult tied to a fixed annual date rather than a calendar inscription.
excerpt: Congregatio Rogationistarum a Corde Iesu, 19 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 510/69): conceditur « ad decennium » ut in ecclesiis et oratoriis Congregationis celebrentur Missae votivae de SS.mo Nomine Iesu, die 31 ianuarii, dummodo non occurrat sollemnitas.

summary_en: The diocese of Greensburg (USA), where Bl. John Nepomucene Neumann exercised pastoral ministry, may celebrate his feast on 7 January as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: U.S.A.: Greensburgensis, 23 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 833/69): conceditur ut festum B. Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann, qui in dioecesi et in civitate Greensburgensi ministerium pastorale exercuit, celebrari possit die 7 ianuarii, tamquam Memoria obligatoria.

summary_en: The diocese of Greensburg (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed Elizabeth Seton on 4 January as a memorial (III class).
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: Greensburgensis, 23 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 833/69): conceditur ut festum Beatae Elisabethae Seton celebrari valeat die 4 ianuarii tamquam Memoria (III cl.).

summary_en: For 1970 only, in the diocese of Valencia the feast of St Vincent Ferrer is kept on 6 April (its traditional date in the Valencian region) and the solemnity of the Annunciation, displaced by Holy Week that year, on the following day, 7 April.
excerpt: Hispania: Valentina, 23 iulii 1969 (Prot. n. 846/69): conceditur ut pro anno 1970 festum S. Vincentii Ferrer celebretur die 6 aprilis et Sollemnitas Annuntiationis Domini, die sequenti, cum inde ab antiquis temporibus die 6 aprilis in regione Valentina celebretur sollemnitas S. Vincentii Ferrer.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. M. V. a Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may, for five years, keep a Commemoration of all the deceased of the Order on 15 November in their proper calendar.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. M. V. a Monte Carmelo, 7 aug. 1969 (Prot. n. 933/69): conceditur « ad quinquennium » ut in Calendario proprio die 15 novembris fiat Commemoratio omnium defunctorum Ordinis.

summary_en: Venezuela is allowed the colour blue on the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception and in her votive Masses, and black on Good Friday, in place of the red prescribed by the Institutio generalis. Recorded as 'other' because it concerns liturgical colour, not the content or rank of a calendar; may be out of scope.
excerpt: Venetiola, 8 aug. 1969 (Prot. n. 938/69): conceditur ut in sollemnitate Immaculatae Conceptionis B. V. M. et in eiusdem Missis votivis color caeruleus adhibeatur, et feria VI Hebdomadae Sanctae color niger.

summary_en: For the Proper of all Australia: St Patrick is raised to the grade of solemnity, St Peter Chanel to obligatory memorial, and the feasts of St Bridget, St Columba and Bl. Oliver Plunket are removed.
excerpt: Australia, 2 sept. 1969 (Prot. n. 1109/69): conceditur ut S. Patricius celebretur gradu sollemnitatis, S. Petrus Chanel gradu memoriae obligatoriae et festa Ss. Birgittae, Columbae et B. Oliverii Plunket exspungantur e Proprio totius Australiae.

summary_en: The Cistercian Order may use the new Roman Breviary throughout the Order, and the monks and monasteries that do so are to follow the Calendarium Romanum with the Order's Proper added.
excerpt: Sacer Ordo Cisterciensis: 3 sept. 1969 (Prot. n. 973/69): conceditur ut in universo Ordine novum Breviarium romanum adhiberi valeat, ita tamen ut in recitatione chorali adhibeatur si Superior cum voto capituli conventualis ita statuerit, et monachi et monasteria qui Officium divinum secundum Breviarium romanum celebrabunt, sequantur etiam Calendarium Romanum, addito « Proprio » Ordinis.

summary_en: In the diocese of Treviso the titular saints of the parish church of Ss. Leonard and Roch at Ponzano Veneto may be celebrated together on 6 November. Listed under 'X. Varia'; it concerns a single parish, not the diocesan calendar, hence 'other' with review. The same protocol number is also printed under 'VIII. Missae votivae in Sanctuariis' for a Treviso sanctuary (p. 363), which is not recorded.
excerpt: Tarvisina, 3 sept. 1969 (Prot. n. 981/69): conceditur ut sancti titulares ecclesiae paroecialis SS. Leonardi et Rochi in pago v. « Ponzano Veneto » communi celebratione recolantur die 6 novembris.

summary_en: For England and Wales: St David (1 March) is celebrated as a solemnity in Wales and a feast in England; St George (23 April) as a solemnity in England and a feast in Wales.
excerpt: Anglia-Cambria, 24 sept. 1969 (Prot. n. 1102/69): conceditur ut die 1 martii S. David celebretur gradu sollemnitatis in Cambria, gradu festi in Anglia; die 23 aprilis S. Georgius celebretur gradu sollemnitatis in Anglia, gradu festi in Cambria.

summary_en: The diocese of Buffalo (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed John Nepomucene Neumann on 7 January as a memorial (III class).
excerpt: Buffalensis, 4 oct. 1969 (Prot. n. 1161/69): conceditur ut festum Beati Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann celebrari valeat die 7 ianuarii tamquam Memoria (III cl.).

summary_en: Vietnam: the solemnity of St Francis Xavier, principal patron, is celebrated on the Sunday immediately preceding Christ the King, and the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception on the second Sunday of Advent (8 December being a working day).
excerpt: Viet-Nam, 16 oct. 1969 (Prot. n. 1353/69): conceditur ut Sollemnitas S. Francisci Xavier, Patroni Principalis, celebretur in dominica quae immediate praecedit Sollemnitatem D. N. I. C. Universorum Regis, cum prima dominica decembris semper in Tempore Adventus incidatur. Conceditur insuper ut Sollemnitas « In Conceptione Immaculata B. M. Virginis » in secunda dominica Adventus celebretur.

celebration.name_latin: Beati Cuthbertus Mayne et Socii Martyres

summary_en: The Society of Jesus: the faculties for the liturgical celebration of the Mass and Office of Blessed Cuthbert Mayne and companion martyrs granted for 1966-1969 are renewed and extended for 1970 (a temporary faculty, not a calendar entry; recorded for review).
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 16 oct. 1969 (Prot. n. 991/69): conceditur ut facultates, quae circa legitimam celebrationem liturgicam S. Missae et Officii festorum Beatorum Cuthberti Mayne et Sociorum Martyrum annis 1966, 1967, 1968 et 1969 a Sacra Rituum Congregatione concessae erant (cf. Prot. S. R. C. D 2/966), renoventur et extendantur pro anno 1970

summary_en: The Prelature of the Holy House of Loreto (Italy) may celebrate the feast of the BVM of Loreto in its proper calendar with the grade of solemnity (the page does not print the date).
excerpt: Italia: Praelatura ab alma domo lauretana, 20 oct. 1969 (Prot. n. 1359/69): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio festum B. M. Virginis Lauretanae gradu Sollemnitatis celebretur.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Perdolens de Sorano

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Sorrows 'de Sorano' is constituted principal patroness before God of the whole diocese of Querétaro (Mexico).
excerpt: Queretarensis in Mexico, 31 oct. 1969 (Prot. n. 1536/69): Beata Maria Virgo Perdolens de Sorano constituitur totius dioecesis Queretarensis principalis apud Deum Patrona.

summary_en: Ireland: St Patrick on 17 March is raised to the grade of solemnity (transferred to 18 March when it falls on a Sunday), St Brigid on 1 February and St Columba on 19 June to the grade of feast.
excerpt: Hibernia, 7 nov. 1969 (Prot. n. 1547/69): conceditur ut S. Patricius die 17 martii gradu sollemnitatis celebretur (quando autem sollemnitas incidit in dominicam transfertur in diem 18 martii), S. Brigitta die 1 februarii gradu Festi et S. Columba die 19 iunii gradu Festi.

target.institute: Congregatio « Filles de Sainte Marie de la Providence Sainte »

summary_en: The Congregation of the Filles de Sainte Marie de la Providence may celebrate the solemnity of Notre Dame de la Providence on 21 November, the rubrics being observed.
excerpt: Congregatio « Filles de Sainte Marie de la Providence Sainte », 15 nov. 1969 (Prot. n. 1650/69): conceditur ut Sollemnitas « Notre Dame de la Providence » celebretur in praedicta Congregatione, die 21 novembris: servatis rubricis

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Divina Providentia

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Divine Providence (Nuestra Señora de la Divina Providencia) is constituted principal patroness before God of the whole nation of Puerto Rico.
excerpt: Porturicus, 19 nov. 1969 (Prot. n. 1568/69): Beata Maria Virgo a Divina Providentia v. Nuestra Señora de la Divina Providencia cunctae Nationis Porturicensis principalis apud Deum Patrona constituitur.

summary_en: Japan: the 26 Martyrs of Japan on 6 February as a feast, the BVM 'de Inventione Christianorum' on 17 March as an optional memorial, the Blessed 25 Martyrs of Japan on 10 September as an obligatory memorial, and St Francis Xavier on 3 December as a feast.
excerpt: Iaponia, 19 nov. 1969 (Prot. n. 1749/69): conceditur ut Ss. 26 Martyres Iaponiae celebrentur die 6 februarii gradu Festi, B. M. Virgo de Inventione Christianorum die 17 martii gradu Memoriae ad libitum, Beati 25 Martyres Iaponiae die 10 septembris gradu Memoriae obligatoriae, S. Franciscus Xavier die 3 decembris gradu Festi.

summary_en: Mozambique may use the colour blue at all feasts of the BVM in the celebration of Mass (a liturgical-colour indult, recorded for review because the API tracks colours per celebration).
excerpt: Mozambicum, 19 nov. 1969 (Prot. n. 1750/69): conceditur ut in omnibus festis B. M. Virginis color caeruleus adhiberi valeat in celebratione Missae.

celebration.name_latin: B. M. Virgo Domina Nostra a SS.mo Sacramento

summary_en: The Sisters of the Blessed Sacrament of Autun may celebrate the feast of Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament on 8 May as a feast (II class).
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum SS.mi Sacramenti Augustodunensis, 4 dec. 1969 (Prot. n. 1832/69): conceditur ut festum B. M. Virginis Dominae Nostrae a SS.mo Sacramento, celebrari possit in eadem Congregatione die 8 maii tamquam Festum (II cl.).

celebration.name_latin: S. Ioannes Baptista De La Salle

summary_en: The Brothers of the Christian Schools may, for five years, celebrate the feast of St John Baptist de La Salle on 15 May in all houses of the Institute, since 7 April in the General Roman Calendar almost always falls in Easter time.
excerpt: Institutum Fratrum Scholarum Christianarum, 17 dec. 1969 (Prot. n. 1810/69): conceditur ad quinquennium ut in omnibus domibus praefati Instituti festum S. Ioannis Baptistae De La Salle celebretur die 15 maii.

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Mercy is constituted principal patroness before God of the archdiocese of Guayaquil and of all the dioceses of the coast of Ecuador.
excerpt: Guayaquilensis et dioeceses litoris Aequatoriae, 3 ianuarii 1970 (Prot. n. 2067/69): Beata Maria Virgo a Mercede archidioecesis Guayaquilensis necnon omnium dioecesium litoris Aequatoriae principalis apud Deum Patrona constituitur.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Gniezno (Poland) may celebrate the feast of Blessed Radzym-Gaudentius, its first metropolitan archbishop, on his dies natalis, 14 October, as an obligatory memorial (the Latin texts of his proper Mass and Office are confirmed by the same decree).
excerpt:
Gnesnensis in Polonia, 8 ian. 1970 (Prot. n. 1766/69): confirmatur textus latinus Missae propriae et Officii proprii Beati Radzym-Gaudentii.
Conceditur insuper ut festum eiusdem Beati, qui fuit primus Archiepiscopus Metropolita Gnesnensis, celebretur in illa archidioecesi eius die natali, nempe 14 octobris, tamquam memoria obligatoria.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo v. Nuestra Señora de los Remedios

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary 'Nuestra Señora de los Remedios' is constituted principal patroness before God of the town of Espinoso del Rey (archdiocese of Toledo, Spain).
excerpt: Toletana in Hispania, 8 ianuarii 1970 (Prot. n. 2065/69): Beata Maria Virgo v. Nuestra Señora de los Remedios oppidi v. « Espinoso del Rey » constituitur principalis apud Deum Patrona.

summary_en: Cambodia: the Congregation confirms the decision of the Episcopal Conference of Laos and Cambodia to transfer the solemnity of All Saints and the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed to the days between 15 September and 15 October, when the traditional 'Prachum Ben' festivals in honour of the dead are celebrated; the protocol is printed as '240 70' (the slash is not visible). The Summarium line in Notitiae 53 (p. 133, 'Laos et Cambogia', Prot. n. 240/70) dates the concession 2 February 1970, while the full text gives 26 January 1970.
excerpt:
petiit a Sacra Congregatione pro Cultu divino confirmationem decisionis eiusdem Conferentiae transferendi sollemnitatem Omnium Sanctorum et Commemorationem omnium fidelium defunctorum diebus inter 15 septembris et 15 octobris, quibus quotannis in Cambogia ex saeculari populi consuetudine festivitates celebrantur in honorem mortuorum (« Prachum Ben »).
Confirmatio data est die 26 ianuarii h. a. (Prot. n. 240 70).

summary_en: The Congregation of the Servants of Mary, Ministers of the Sick, may celebrate the feast of St Maria Soledad Torres Acosta in all its houses on 11 October.
excerpt: Congregatio Servarum Mariae ministrarum infirmis, 3 martii 1970 (Prot. n. 1169/70): conceditur ut Festum S. Mariae Soledad Torres Acosta celebretur in omnibus domibus Congregationis die 11 octobris.

summary_en: The diocese of Tonga (Pacific Episcopal Conference) may celebrate the optional memorial of St Peter Chanel with the grade of feast (II class); the page does not print the date.
excerpt: Pacifici Conferentia Episcopalis: Tonganae, 4 martii 1970 (Prot. n. 785/70): conceditur ut memoria ad libitum S. Petri Chanel celebretur gradu Festi (II cl.).

summary_en: Rwanda-Burundi (one episcopal conference for two nations, RW and BI, so the nation code is left null): the solemnity of the Epiphany is assigned to the Sunday falling between 2 and 8 January, Corpus Christi to the Sunday after Trinity Sunday, the Sacred Heart of Jesus to the third Sunday after Pentecost, and St Joseph, Spouse of the BVM, to 1 May.
excerpt: Ruanda-Burundia, 4 martii 1970 (Prot. n. 787/70): ea quae sequuntur confirmantur, nempe: Sollemnitas Epiphaniae Domini assignatur dominicae a die 2 ad diem 8 ianuarii occurrenti; Sollemnitas SS.mae Eucharistiae assignatur dominicae post SS.mam Trinitatem; Sollemnitas Sacratissimi Cordis Iesus assignatur dominicae tertiae post Pentecosten; Sollemnitas S. Ioseph, Sponsi B. M. V., assignatur diei primae mensis maii.

summary_en: The diocese of Altoona-Johnstown (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed John Nepomucene Neumann on 7 January as a memorial (III class).
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: Altunensis-Johnstonensis, 23 martii 1970 (Prot. n. 1432/70): conceditur ut festum Beati Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann celebrari valeat die 7 ianuarii tamquam Memoria (III cl.).

summary_en: For the parish of S. Zenone in Borsea (diocese of Adria, Italy): the feast of St Zeno, titular of the church, may be celebrated on the second Saturday after Easter with the grade of solemnity (I class), without external transfer to the following Sunday; and in the same parish the Nativity of the BVM (8 September) may be celebrated as a solemnity (I class).
excerpt:
Italia: Adriensis, 23 martii 1970 (Prot. n. 1464/70): conceditur pro paroecia S. Zenonis in « Borsea » ut festum eiusdem Sancti, ecclesiae titularis, celebrari valeat secundo sabbato post Pascha gradu Sollemnitatis (I cl.). Iuxta tamen novas normas Calendarii Romani ipsa sollemnitas exsterna in dominicam sequentem transferri non potest.
Conceditur insuper ut in eadem paroecia festum Nativitatis B. M. V. (8 septembris) celebrari valeat tamquam Sollemnitas (I cl.).

summary_en: The diocese of Allentown (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed John Nepomucene Neumann on 7 January as an obligatory memorial (III class).
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: Alanopolitanae, 6 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1549/70); Baltimorensis, 30 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1766/70); Eriensis, 14 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1633/70): conceditur ut festum B. Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann celebrari possit die 7 ianuarii, tamquam Memoria obligatoria (III. cl.).

summary_en: The diocese of Córdoba (Spain) may celebrate the feast of St Raphael the Archangel on 24 October; the feast celebrated in the city of Córdoba on 7 May since 1651, as a memorial, is suppressed, also in the church dedicated to him, so that St Raphael is honoured with a single celebration in the whole city.
excerpt:
Hispania: Cordubensis, 11 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1622/70): conceditur ut in dioecesi Cordubensi festum S. Raphaelis Archangeli celebrari possit die 24 octobris.
Festum autem quod in calendario particulari, iam ab anno 1651 in civitate Cordubensi, die 7 maii celebratur, in forma memoriae, etiam in ecclesia eius nomine dicata supprimatur

summary_en: The diocese of Erie (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed John Nepomucene Neumann on 7 January as an obligatory memorial (III class).
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: Alanopolitanae, 6 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1549/70); Baltimorensis, 30 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1766/70); Eriensis, 14 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1633/70): conceditur ut festum B. Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann celebrari possit die 7 ianuarii, tamquam Memoria obligatoria (III. cl.).

summary_en: In the village of Strullendorf (archdiocese of Bamberg, Germany) the feast of the consecration of the parish church is henceforth celebrated on 5 July each year, since at the end of September (28 September, the former date) the harvest is not yet finished.
excerpt: Germania: Bambergensis, 15 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1472/70): conceditur ut in posterum, in vico Strullendorf, Archidioecesis Bambergensis, die 5 iulii quotannis, ad normam legum liturgicarum, festum consecrationis ecclesiae paroecialis celebretur.

summary_en: Czechoslovakia (nation code CZ per the guide, flagged for review): the feast of Ss. Cyril and Methodius may be celebrated on 5 July throughout the territory, for pastoral reasons (the people of Moravia honour the holy patrons on that day every year).
excerpt: Cecoslovachia, 21 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1682/70): conceditur ut in toto Cecoslovachiae territorio Festum SS. Cyrilli et Methodii die 5 iulii celebrari valeat.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Baltimore (USA) may celebrate the feast of Blessed John Nepomucene Neumann on 7 January as an obligatory memorial (III class).
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: Alanopolitanae, 6 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1549/70); Baltimorensis, 30 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1766/70); Eriensis, 14 aprilis 1970 (Prot. n. 1633/70): conceditur ut festum B. Ioannis Nepomuceni Neumann celebrari possit die 7 ianuarii, tamquam Memoria obligatoria (III. cl.).

summary_en: The feast of Blessed Mary of the Apostles Wüllenweber is inscribed in the calendar of the Society of the Divine Saviour on 5 September.
excerpt: Societas divini Salvatoris, 4 maii 1970 (Prot. n. 1810/70): conceditur ut festum Beatae Mariae ab Apostolis Wüllenweber in calendario Societatis Divini Salvatoris die 5 semptembris inscribatur.

summary_en: Notificatio of the Congregation (17 May 1970, published in L'Osservatore Romano on 20 May 1970): since the vernacular editions of the Missale Romanum cannot appear before the end of the year, the General Calendar and the particular calendars 'ad interim' remain in use also during 1971.
excerpt:
Cum autem praevideatur fore impossibile ut intra finem huius anni editiones Missalis Romani linguis vernaculis appareant, statuitur ut Calendarium generale necnon Calendaria particularia « ad interim » in usu retineantur etiam durante anno 1971.
Romae, die 17 maii 1970.

summary_en: El Salvador may celebrate the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross on 3 May throughout the Republic, since by ancient tradition 3 May, the 'día de la Cruz', is celebrated with great devotion by all the faithful.
excerpt: Salvatoriana Respublica, 20 maii 1970 (Prot. n. 1513/70): conceditur ut Festum Exaltationis Sanctae Crucis celebretur in tota Republica Salvatoriana die 3 maii.

summary_en: Instruction 'Calendaria particularia' of the Congregation for Divine Worship on the revision of particular calendars and of the Propers of Offices and Masses, approved by Paul VI on 23 June 1970 and dated 24 June 1970: general norms (not a change to any single calendar; recorded because it governs every particular calendar, e.g. patron grades nn. 8-11, dies proprius nn. 21-24, patrons nn. 30-35, solemnities whose precept was removed nn. 36-37).
excerpt:
INSTRUCTIO DE CALENDARIIS PARTICULARIBUS ATQUE OFFICIORUM ET MISSARUM PROPRIIS RECOGNOSCENDIS
[...] Summus vero Pontifex PAULUS VI, die 23 iunii 1970, hanc Instructionem in omnibus et singulis approbare dignatus est, atque sanxit ut eam omnes ad quos spectavisset diligenter exsequerentur.
Romae, ex Aedibus Sacrae Congregationis pro Cultu Divino, die 24 iunii 1970.

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of Mercy is constituted principal patroness before God of the territory and city of Merlo, in the diocese of Morón (Argentina).
excerpt: Moronensis in Argentina, 26 augusti 1970 (Prot. n. 1855/69): Beata Maria Virgo a Mercede territorii necnon civitatis v. « Merlo », in dioecesi Moronensi, principalis apud Deum Patrona constituitur.

summary_en: In the churches of the Friars Minor in Bologna the solemnity of St Francis may be celebrated on 4 October notwithstanding the solemnity of St Petronius, principal patron of the city, which in those churches is transferred to 5 October.
excerpt: Italia: Bononiensis, 23 sept. 1970 (Prot. n. 3074/70): conceditur ut in ecclesiis O.F.M. Bononiae, sollemnitas S. Francisci celebrari valeat die 4 octobris non obstante sollemnitate S. Petronii, Patroni principalis civitatis, quae in supradictis ecclesiis transfertur ad diem 5 octobris.

summary_en: The national calendar of France is confirmed 'ad interim'.
excerpt: Gallia, 29 sept. 1970 (Prot. n. 3106/70): confirmatur « ad interim » Calendarium nationale Galliae.

target.institute: Sorores minimae Dominae Nostrae a Suffragio

summary_en: The Sorores minimae of Our Lady of Suffrage may celebrate the feast of the BVM of Suffrage in all their houses on 3 November.
excerpt: Sorores minimae Dominae Nostrae a Suffragio, 1 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 3130/70): conceditur ut festum B. Mariae Virginis a Suffragio celebrari valeat in omnibus domibus Sororum minimarum Dominae Nostrae a Suffragio die tertia mensis novembris.

summary_en: The English Benedictine Congregation may celebrate the feast of the BVM Help of Christians in the Monastery of the BVM Help of Christians on 12 October.
excerpt: Congregatio Anglica O. S. B., 7 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 3112/70): conceditur ut festum B. M. V. « Auxilium Christianorum » celebrari valeat in Monasterio B. M. V. « Auxilium Christianorum » die 12 octobris

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculati Cordis

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Heart of the BVM is confirmed as principal patroness before God of the diocese of Azogues (Ecuador).
excerpt: Azoguensis in Aequatoria, 12 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 1995/70): Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculati Cordis Beatae Mariae Virginis, dioecesis Azoguensis, principalis apud Deum Patrona confirmatur.

summary_en: The Missionaries of the Sacred Heart of Jesus may celebrate the feast of Our Lady of the Sacred Heart, principal patroness of the Congregation, on the last Saturday of May.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum Sacri Cordis Iesu, 20 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 1805/70): conceditur ut festum Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde, Patronae principalis eiusdem Congregationis, celebrari valeat ultimo die sabbato mensis maii.

summary_en: Patriarchate of Venice: the solemnities of St Mark the Evangelist and of the Presentation of the BVM may be celebrated in the Basilica of St Mark or in the Basilica della Salute even when they fall on a Sunday of Easter time or on the solemnity of Christ the King (a precedence concession limited to two basilicas, recorded for review).
excerpt: Patriarcatus Venetiarum, 27 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 3332/70): conceditur ut sollemnitates S. Marci Evangelistae et in Praesentatione B. M. V., celebrari valeant in Basilica S. Marci vel in Basilica B. M. V. v. d. « della Salute », etiam quando incidunt vel in dominicam temporis paschalis vel in sollemnitatem D. N. I. C. Universorum Regis.

summary_en: St John the Baptist is confirmed as principal patron of a new parish to be erected in the city of Maracaibo (Venezuela); the diocese is printed 'Machaibensis', evidently for Maracaibensis.
excerpt: Machaibensis in Venetiola, 28 oct. 1970 (Prot. n. 3392/70): S. Ioannis Baptista Patronus principalis novae paroeciae, quae in civitate Maracaibensi erigenda est, confirmatur.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo v. d. « Nuestra Señora de la Natividad de Chilla »

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary 'Nuestra Señora de la Natividad de Chilla' is confirmed as principal patroness before God of the diocese of Machala (Ecuador).
excerpt: Machalensis in Ecuador, 10 nov. 1970 (Prot. n. 3404/70): Beata Maria Virgo v. d. « Nuestra Señora de la Natividad de Chilla » dioecesis machalensis, principalis apud Deum Patrona confirmatur.

summary_en: Grants that the solemnity of the anniversary of the dedication of the church of « Notre-Dame Mère de la Sainte Espérence » at Mesnil-Saint-Loup (diocese of Troyes, France) may be transferred to the Monday after Pentecost; a single-church item recorded for review.
excerpt: Trecensis, 30 nov. 1970 (Prot. n. 3678/70): conceditur ut, sollemnitas anniversarii dedicationis ecclesiae v. d. « Notre-Dame Mère de la Sainte Espérence », loco « Mesnil-Saint-Loup », transferri possit in feriam secundam post Pentecosten.

summary_en: Grants that, on the occasion of the eighth centenary of the dedication of the cathedral, the Mass and Office of the anniversary of the dedication may be celebrated throughout the diocese of Tournai (Belgium) on 9 May 1971, the fifth Sunday of Easter; a one-year concession recorded for review.
excerpt: Tornacensis, 28 dec. 1970 (Prot. n. 3866/70): conceditur ut, occasione celebrationis VIII centenarii dedicationis ecclesiae cathedralis, die 9 maii 1971, dominica quinta Paschae, celebrari possit, in tota dioecesi Tornacensi, Missa et Officium de anniversario dedicationis ecclesiae.

summary_en: Grants that the feast of St Jeanne de Lestonnac, foundress of the Company of Mary Our Lady, may be celebrated on 15 May in that Society.
excerpt: Societas Mariae Dominae Nostrae, 11 ian. 1971 (Prot. n. 3823/70): conceditur ut festum S. Ioannae de Lestonnac, Fundatricis Societatis Mariae Dominae Nostrae, die 15 maii celebrari possit.

summary_en: Grants that the parish church of St Joseph the Worker in the city of Vasto (diocese of Vasto, Italy) be consecrated without consecration of the altar, and additionally that the solemnity of the anniversary of the consecration of that church may be celebrated on 31 October; a single-church item recorded for review.
excerpt: Vestanae in Italia, 26 ian. 1971 (Prot. n. 32/71): conceditur ut ecclesia paroecialis S. Iosepho Opifici dicata, in civitate Vestana, consecrari valeat, non obstante can. 1165 § 5 C.I.C., omissa consecratione altaris. Conceditur insuper ut sollemnitas anniversarii consecrationis eiusdem ecclesiae celebrari valeat die 31 octobris.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Friar Servants of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Servites).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis, 6 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 3485/70): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

summary_en: Confirms the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Mother of God as principal patron before God, and St Justus as secondary patron, of the whole diocese of San Justo (Argentina); two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Sancti Iusti in Argentina, 18 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 765/70): Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Matris Dei, principalis apud Deum Patrona et S. Iustus Patronus secundarius totius dioecesis confirmantur.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « a Praesentatione »

summary_en: Confirms the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Presentation, whose feast is celebrated on 2 February, as principal patron before God of the Prelature of Humahuaca (Argentina).
excerpt: Humahuacensis Praelaturae in Argentina, 19 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 3880/70): Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « a Praesentatione », cuius festum die 2 februarii celebratur, principalis apud Deum Patrona Praelaturae Humahuacensis confirmatur.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Narcissus as principal patron of a new parish erected in the city of Girona (diocese of Girona, Spain); parish-level, so the level is recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Gerundensis in Hispania, 22 febr. 1971 (Prot. n. 516/71): confirmatur electio S. Narcissi, Patroni principalis novae paroeciae, quae in civitate Gerundensi erigenda est.

summary_en: Confirms the national calendar of Belgium together with the proper of Masses of Belgium.
excerpt: Belgium, 9 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 3257/70): confirmatur Calendarium nationale necnon proprium Missarum Belgii.

summary_en: Grants the Philippines that the feast of the Holy Name of Jesus be celebrated on the third Sunday in Ordinary Time.
excerpt: Insulae Philippinae, 16 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 670/71): conceditur ut festum Sancti Nominis Iesu celebretur in tertia dominica « per annum ».

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Society of Jesus.
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 26 martii 1971 (Prot. n. 651/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Societatis.

summary_en: Grants the archdiocese of Cape Town (South Africa) that the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary « Our Lady of the Flight into Egypt » may be celebrated on the third Sunday in Ordinary Time, and that St Patrick be celebrated with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Civitas Capitis seu Capetownensis in Africa Meridionali, 4 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 837/71): conceditur ut sollemnitas B.M.V. v. d. « Our Lady of the Flight into Egypt » celebrari valeat in tertia dominica « per annum », et S. Patricius gradu festi.

summary_en: Grants the archdiocese of San Antonio (USA) that St Patrick may be celebrated on 17 March with the grade of feast.
excerpt: S. Antonius in Civitatibus Foederatis Americae Septentrionalis, 6 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 839/71): conceditur ut S. Patricius celebrari valeat die 17 martii gradu festi.

summary_en: Grants the diocese of Linz (Austria) that the feast of St Maximilian, bishop and martyr, be inserted in the diocesan calendar with the grade of memorial, and that the feast of St Severinus, abbot, be celebrated on 8 January.
excerpt: Linciensis in Austria, 21 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 895/71): conceditur ut festum S. Maximiliani, Episcopi et Martyris, gradu memoriae in Calendarium dioecesanum inseri valeat atque festum S. Severini Abbatis die 8 ianuarii celebretur.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Florian, martyr, as principal patron of the diocese of Linz (Austria), in place of St Maximilian.
excerpt: Linciensis in Austria, 21 apr. 1971 (Prot. n. 926/71). confirmatur electio S. Floriani martyris, Patroni principalis dioecesis Linciensis, loco S. Maximiliani.

target.institute: Societas Parisiensis Missionum ad exteras gentes

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Paris Foreign Missions Society.
excerpt: Societas Parisiensis Missionum ad exteras gentes, 6 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 629/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Societatis.

summary_en: Grants the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur that the solemnity of St Julie Billiart be celebrated on 13 May.
excerpt: Sorores Dominae Nostrae a « Namur », 13 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 538/71): conceditur ut sollemnitas S. Iuliae Billiart die 13 maii celebretur.

summary_en: Grants the Congregation of the Sisters of Divine Providence that a votive Mass in honour of Blessed John Martin Moye may be celebrated on 4 May in the houses of the Congregation, provided no liturgical day listed in nn. 1-4 of the table of precedence occurs; a fixed-date votive Mass rather than a calendar inscription, recorded for review.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum a divina Providentia, 26 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 1055/71): conceditur ut die 4 mensis maii celebrari valeat in domibus Congregationis Missa votiva in honorem Beati Ioannis Martini Moye, dummodo non occurrat dies liturgicus in nn. 1-4 tabulae praecedentiae inscriptus

summary_en: Confirms the election of St John of Ortega as patron of the Spanish professional association « Colegio Nacional de Aparejadores y Arquitectos Técnicos »; a patron of an association rather than of a territory or institute, recorded for review.
excerpt: Hispania, 26 maii 1971 (Prot. n. 1944/70): confirmatur electio S. Ioannis de Ortega Patroni Consociationis v. « Colegio Nacional de Aparejadores y Arquitectos Tecnicos ».

summary_en: Grants that in the Congregation of the Carmelite Sisters of Charity St Joaquina Vedruna may be celebrated with the grade of solemnity and Our Lady of Mount Carmel with the grade of feast; two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum Carmelitarum a Caritate, 8 iunii 1971 (Prot. n. 1117/71): conceditur ut in ipsa Congregatione S. Joaquina Vedruña celebrari valeat gradu Sollemnitatis et B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo gradu Festi.

summary_en: Notification of the Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship (no protocol number printed) on the use of the new Missal, Liturgy of the Hours and Calendar: episcopal conferences are to fix the date on which the Calendarium Romanum of 14 February 1969 enters into force in their territory; those using a proper calendar keep it ad interim with grades adjusted to the universal norms; in 1972 the solemnity of St Joseph, falling on the fifth Sunday of Lent, is anticipated to Saturday 18 March (with Ordinaries able to allow the St Joseph Mass formulary at Saturday evening Masses); in 1973 the Nativity of St John the Baptist is kept on Sunday 24 June (or 23 June where Corpus Christi is transferred to that Sunday), and on Friday 29 June Sts Peter and Paul is celebrated with the Sacred Heart transferred to the following Sunday, while where Sts Peter and Paul is not of precept and is transferred to Sunday, the Sacred Heart is kept on 29 June and Sts Peter and Paul on 1 July.
excerpt: 7. Anno 1972, Sollemnitas S. Ioseph, dominica quinta in Quadragesima incidit. Proinde sabbato anticipatur, nempe die 18 martii. [...] 8. Anno 1973, ob occurrentiam quarundam sollemnitatum, Calendarium ordinatur sequenti modo: a) Die 24 iunii, dominica: IN NATIVITATE S. IOANNIS BAPTISTAE, Sollemnitas. [...] b) die 29 iunii, feria VI SS. PETRI ET PAULI, Apost., Sollemnitas. SS.mi CORDIS IESU, Sollemnitas.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem; the patriarchate spans several states (Israel, Palestine, Jordan, Cyprus), so no nation code is assigned.
excerpt: Patriarchatus Latinus Hierosolymitanus, 16 iunii 1971 (Prot. n. 2562/70): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Patriarchatus.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Domina Nostra de Guadalupe »

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Our Lady of Guadalupe as principal patron of the diocese of Phoenix (USA).
excerpt: Phoenicensis in Civitatibus Foederatis Americae Septentrionalis, 21 iunii 1971 (Prot. n. 1068/71): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Domina Nostra de Guadalupe », Patronae principalis dioecesis Foenicensis.

summary_en: Yugoslavia: the Office and Mass of St Nicholas Tavelić, hitherto celebrated on 5 December, are transferred to his dies natalis, 14 November, and his external solemnity may be celebrated for pastoral reasons on the Sunday falling between 11 and 17 November; the nation is Yugoslavia (no single current ISO code), flagged for review.
excerpt: Iugoslavia, 26 iunii 1971 (Prot. n. 1221/71): conceditur ut a) Officium et Missa sancti Nicolai Tavelic, qui die 5 decembris celebrabantur, in diem natalem eiusdem Sancti, scilicet 14 novembris transferantur; b) sollemnitas externa eiusdem Sancti in dominica a die 11-17 novembris occurrente ob rationes pastorales celebretur.

summary_en: Grants that priests of Azione Cattolica Italiana working in the « Collegio Assistenti Centrali » or the « Consulta Generale dell'Apostolato dei Laici » may, during their term, follow the General Roman Calendar when reciting the Liturgy of the Hours alone; a calendar-observance indult for a category of priests, not a change to any calendar, recorded for review.
excerpt: Actio Catholica Italiana, 1 iulii 1971 (Prot. n. 1211/71): conceditur ut sacerdotes, qui operam dant in « Collegio Assistenti Centrali » vel in « Consulta Generale dell'Apostolato dei Laici », adhiberi possint, durante munere, Calendarium Romanum Generale in recitatione « a solo » Liturgiae Horarum.

summary_en: Grants that in Poland the celebrations of the Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of Our Lady of Mount Carmel, optional memorials in the universal Church, may be kept as obligatory memorials; two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Polonia, 7 iulii 1971 (Prot. n. 1181/71): conceditur ut celebratio Immaculati Cordis B.M.V. et celebratio B. Mariae de Monte Carmelo, quae uti « memoriae ad libitum » in universa Ecclesiae peraguntur, in Polonia fieri possint « memoriae obligatoriae ».

summary_en: Second act under the same protocol: grants that in Poland the Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary may still be celebrated on 2 July, but only in churches bearing the title of the Visitation that keep a tradition of popular pilgrimages; applies to certain churches only, flagged for review.
excerpt: Conceditur insuper ut celebratio Visitationis B.M.V. die 2 iulii celebrari adhuc possit sed tantum illis in ecclesiis, quae titulo « Visitationis » ornantur et traditionem popularium peregrinationum repetunt.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Helsinki (Finland).
excerpt: Helsinkiensis, 8 iulii 1971 (Prot. n. 1102/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium dioecesis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Confederation of Canons Regular of St Augustine.
excerpt: Confoederatio Canonicorum Regularium Sancti Augustini, 8 iulii 1971 (Prot. n. 1299/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Confoederationis.

summary_en: Grants that St James the Less, Apostle, may be celebrated on 1 May in the diocese of Funchal (Portugal): with the grade of solemnity in the city of Funchal and of feast in the whole diocese; grade recorded as feast (diocese-wide) and flagged because two grades are printed.
excerpt: Funchalensis, 23 iulii 1971 (Prot. n. 1392/71): conceditur ut S. Apostolus Iacobus Minor celebrari valeat die prima maii, in civitate Funchalensi gradu Sollemnitatis, in tota dioecesi gradu Festi.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Ravenna and Cervia (Italy).
excerpt: Ravennatensis et Cerviensis, 3 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 1237/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium dioecesis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Cellite Brothers (Alexians).
excerpt: Congregatio Fratrum Cellitarum seu Alexianorum, 3 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 3883/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Congregationis.

summary_en: Grants Mexico, for ten years, that the solemnity of Our Lady of Guadalupe may be celebrated on 12 December even when it falls on a Sunday of Advent; a temporary (decennial) occurrence concession, flagged for review.
excerpt: Mexicum, 14 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 1582/71): conceditur « ad decennium » ut sollemnitas Dominae Nostrae a « Guadalupe » celebrari valeat die 12 decembris etiam si in dominicam Adventus incidit.

summary_en: Grants that the liturgical celebration of St Mary Domenica Mazzarello may be held on 13 May in the Congregation of the Daughters of Mary Help of Christians.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiarum Mariae Auxiliatricis, 15 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 1537/71): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica S. Mariae Dominicae Mazzarello peragi valeat die 13 maii.

summary_en: Regional Episcopal Conference of China: grants that the blessing and imposition of ashes may be transferred to the First Sunday of Lent, and that on the civil festival « Ching Ming » a Mass for the dead may be celebrated unless a solemnity of precept or a Sunday of Lent or Easter occurs; the first point moves a rite of Ash Wednesday, not a celebration, so it is recorded for review; no ISO nation code is assigned to the conference.
excerpt: Conferentia Regionalis Episcoporum Sinarum, 29 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 1612/71): ea quae sequuntur confirmantur, nempe: a) Benedictio et impositio cinerum ad dominicam primam in Quadragesima transferri potest; b) in festo civili, « Ching Ming » nuncupato, Missa defunctorum celebrari potest, nisi occurrat sollemnitas de praecepto servanda aut dominica quadragesimae vel paschae.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1971: grants that in the dioceses of England and Wales the liturgical celebrations in honour of the Forty Martyrs of England and Wales may be held on the 30th Sunday in Ordinary Time of that year.
excerpt: Anglia et Cambria, 29 sept. 1971 (Prot. n. 1691/71): conceditur ut hoc anno in dioecesibus Angliae et Cambriae celebrationes liturgicae in honorem Sanctorum 40 Martyrum Angliae et Cambriae fieri possint die dominica XXX « per annum ».

summary_en: Grants that the Valencia province of the Capuchins may celebrate on 1 July the feast of the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ, title of the province; a single religious province, so flagged for review; no rank is printed beyond the word 'festum'.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 8 oct. 1971 (Prot. n. 1750/71): conceditur ut in Provincia Valentina eiusdem Ordinis, die prima mensis iulii celebrare possit festum Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D.N.I.C., Tituli Provinciae.

summary_en: Grants that in Brazil the solemnities of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of All Saints may be transferred to the Sunday immediately following, for the good of the faithful; two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Brasilia, 14 oct. 1971 (Prot. n. 1734/71): conceditur ut Sollemnitates Assumptionis B.M.V. et Omnium Sanctorum in dominicam immediate sequentem transferri valeant, ad bonum fidelium promovendum.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of St Augustine.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini, 18 oct. 1971 (Prot. n. 1763/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Discalced Carmelites.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 20 oct. 1971 (Prot. n. 1653/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nossa Senhora da Conceiçao da Praia »

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title « Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Praia » as principal patron of the whole city of Bahia (Salvador da Bahia, Brazil); a civil city rather than a diocese, so recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: Provincia de « Bahia » in Brasilia, 4 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 1826/71): confirmatur electio B.M.V. sub titulo « Nossa Senhora da Conceiçao da Praia », Patrona principalis totius Civitatis de Bahia in Brasilia.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Ascoli Piceno (Italy).
excerpt: Ausculana in Piceno, 11 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 1792/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium dioecesis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of Spain.
excerpt: Hispania, 18 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 2028/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: With the favourable opinion of the Congregation for the Causes of Saints, grants that liturgical cult may be paid to Blessed David, priest and monk, by the whole Cistercian Order, and that his liturgical memoria may be celebrated each year on 11 December; the word 'memoria' is used but no formal rank is printed.
excerpt: Sacer Ordo Cisterciensis, 21 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 2325/71): favorabili voto a S. Congregatione pro Causis Sanctorum habito, conceditur ut cultus liturgicus Beato Davidi, presbytero et monacho, ab universo Ordine Cisterciensi legitime tribui possit, atque eius memoria liturgica die 11 decembris quotannis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of England (« Anglia »).
excerpt: Anglia, 21 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 25/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Preachers.
excerpt: Ordo Praedicatorum, 25 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 1860/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Grants that in the national calendar of Poland the celebrations of St Adalbert (Wojciech) and of St Stanislaus, martyr, be inscribed as solemnities; two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Polonia, 25 nov. 1971 (Prot. n. 944/71): conceditur ut celebratio S. Vojtechi Adalberti et S. Stanislai Martyris in Calendario nationali uti sollemnitas inscribatur.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the United States of America.
excerpt: Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis, 28 dec. 1971 (Prot. n. 2153/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the calendar common to the Franciscan families.
excerpt: Familiae Franciscanae, 3 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 1760/71): confirmatur Calendarium commune Familiis Franciscalibus.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Paul the Apostle as patron of the scuba divers (« Subaquanei ») of Italy; a patron of a category of persons, recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: Italia, 13 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 3267/70): confirmatur electio S. Pauli Apostoli « Subaquaneorum » Italiae Patroni.

summary_en: Grants, in accordance with n. 58 of the Universal Norms on the Liturgical Year and the Calendar, that in the parish of St Joseph (Vikhroli), archdiocese of Bombay (India), the solemnity of the Title may be transferred to the Sunday preceding the First Sunday of Lent; a single-parish item recorded for review.
excerpt: Bombayensis, 21 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 151/72): conceditur ad mentem n. 58 Normarum « de Anno liturgico et de Calendario », ut in paroecia S. Ioseph (Vikhroli), eiusdem dioecesis, sollemnitas Tituli transferri possit in dominicam quae primam dominicam in Quadragesima praecedit.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of Zaire (Democratic Republic of the Congo).
excerpt: « Zaïre », 21 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 1535/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Friars Minor Conventual.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, 29 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 1758/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Friars Minor.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, 29 ian. 1972 (Prot. n. 1759/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Matris Misericordiae »

summary_en: Confirms the Latin and Spanish texts of the Mass and Liturgy of the Hours for the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Mother of Mercy, to be kept each year on 4 May with the grade of feast, in the Congregation of the Franciscan Sisters Daughters of Mercy; primarily a text confirmation (normally not recorded) but it states the date and grade of the celebration, so it is recorded for review.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum Franciscalium Filiarum Misericordiae, 1 febr. 1972 (Prot. n. 24/72): confirmantur textus lingua latina et hispanica exarati Missae et Liturgiae Horarum pro celebratione Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Matris Misericordiae », die 4 maii gradu festi quotannis peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Third Order Regular of St Francis.
excerpt: Tertius Ordo Regularis S. Francisci, 2 febr. 1972 (Prot. n. 172/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of Scotland.
excerpt: Scotia, 14 martii 1972 (Prot. n. 2222/70): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum (moniales Ordinis Immaculatae Conceptionis)

summary_en: Grants that the nuns of the Order of the Immaculate Conception (Conceptionists) may celebrate Blessed Beatrice de Silva, virgin, with the grade of feast on 1 September.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, 14 martii 1972 (Prot. n. 760/72): conceditur ut moniales Ordinis Immaculatae Conceptionis Beatam Beatricem de Silva, virginem, gradu festi celebrare valeant, die 1 septembris.

summary_en: Grants that in the proper calendar of India St Thomas may be inscribed with the title « Apostle of India » and celebrated with the grade of solemnity; no date is printed in the decree.
excerpt: India, 25 martii 1972 (Prot. n. 584/71): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio eiusdem dicionis Sanctus Thomas titulo Indiae Apostolus inscribi graduque Sollemnitatis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Carmelites.
excerpt: Ordo Carmelitarum, 17 apr. 1972 (Prot. n. 243/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Minorca (Spain).
excerpt: Minoricensis, 18 apr. 1972 (Prot. n. 379/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium dioecesis.

target.institute: Congregatio Filiorum et Ancillarum Amoris Miserentis

summary_en: Grants that in the churches and oratories of the Congregation of the Sons and Handmaids of Merciful Love the feast of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of Grace may be celebrated each year on 8 May, using the liturgical texts already approved for the Order of Servants of Mary; no rank is printed beyond the word 'festum'.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum et Ancillarum Amoris Miserentis, 21 apr. 1972 (Prot. n. 567/72): conceditur ut in ecclesiis et oratoriis eiusdem Congregationis quotannis celebrari valeat festum Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Gratiae, die 8 maii, adhibitis textibus liturgicis pro Ordine Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis iam probatis.

summary_en: Grants that in Colombia the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross may be celebrated on 3 May and the feast of the Apostles Philip and James on 4 May; two celebrations in one decree, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Columbia, 8 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 723/72): conceditur ut festum Exaltationis Sanctae Crucis celebrari possit die 3 maii, et festum Apostolorum Philippi et Iacobi die 4 eiusdem mensis.

celebration.name_latin: B. Maria V. sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Paz »

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title « Nuestra Señora de la Paz » as principal patron before God of the diocese of Cartago (Colombia).
excerpt: Carthadensis in Columbia, 15 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 600/72): confirmatur electio B. Mariae V. sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Paz » principalis apud Deum Patronae dioecesis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Angoulême (France).
excerpt: Engolismensis, 18 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 138/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

celebration.name_latin: SS. Cyrillus et Methodius, Slavorum Apostoli

summary_en: Grants that the celebration of Sts Cyril and Methodius, Apostles of the Slavs, may be kept each year on 5 July with the grade of feast throughout Slovenia and with the grade of solemnity in the archdiocese of Ljubljana; in 1972 Slovenia was a region of Yugoslavia, so recorded as a sub-national region with the current code SI and flagged for review.
excerpt: Slovenia, 20 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 612/72): conceditur ut celebratio SS. Cyrilli et Methodii, Slavorum Apostolorum, die 5 iulii quotannis peragi possit gradu festi in tota Slovenia, gradu vero sollemnitatis in archidioecesi Labacensi.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus.
excerpt: Congregatio Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu, 23 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 602/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculate as principal patron of the parish in the town of Montalbán (diocese of Córdoba, Spain); a single-parish item recorded for review.
excerpt: Cordubensis, 23 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 610/72): confirmatur electio B. Mariae V. Immaculatae, Patronae principalis paroeciae in oppido v.d. « Montalban » exstantis.

summary_en: Grants the convent of the Discalced Carmelites and the sanctuary of St Thérèse of the Child Jesus in the city of Cairo (Egypt) that the feast of St Thérèse of the Child Jesus may be celebrated on 3 October, under n. 21 of the Instruction on particular calendars; a single convent and sanctuary, recorded for review.
excerpt: Cahirensis, 24 maii 1972 (Prot. n. 605/72): conceditur Conventui Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo et Sanctuario S. Teresiae a Iesu Infante, in civitate Cahirensi exstantibus, ut festum S. Teresiae a Iesu Infante, ad normam Instructionis de Calendariis particularibus n. 21, die 3 octobris celebrari valeat.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Benedictine Confederation.
excerpt: Confoederatio Ordinis Sancti Benedicti, 22 iunii 1972 (Prot. n. 829/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Confoederationis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the dioceses of Chambéry, Maurienne and Tarentaise (France).
excerpt: Camberiensis, Maurianensis et Tarantasiensis, 30 iunii 1972 (Prot. n. 1672/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the particular calendars of certain provinces of the Capuchin Friars Minor, namely those of France, Great Britain, Spain and Catalonia, Lombardy and the Marches (Picenum).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 6 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 890/72): confirmatur Calendarium particulare quarundam Provinciarum Ordinis, nempe Galliae, Britanniae Maioris, Hispaniae et Catalauniae, Langobardiae, Picenae.

celebration.name_latin: Sollemnitas Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D. N. I. C.

summary_en: Grants that the Congregation « Adoratrices du Précieux Sang » may celebrate the solemnity of the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ on 1 July.
excerpt: Congregatio « Adoratrices du Précieux Sang », 12 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 887/72): conceditur ut in Congregatione celebrari valeat, die 1 iulii, Sollemnitas Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D. N. I. C.

summary_en: Grants certain particular celebrations to the Passionist nuns of the Most Precious Blood for their monastery of the Passion at Les Sables-d'Olonne (France); the celebrations are not named, and the grant is for a single monastery, so recorded for review.
excerpt: Moniales Passionistae Pretiosissimi Sanguinis, 14 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 919/72): conceduntur quaedam celebrationes particulares pro monasterio Passionis, apud « Les Sables-D'Olonne » exstante.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Sons of Holy Mary Immaculate.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum S. Mariae Immaculatae, 20 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 923/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Congregationis.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: Confirms certain variations introduced into the proper calendar of the Order of Discalced Carmelites.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, 20 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 969/72): confirmantur quaedam variationes in Calendarium proprium inductae

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Francis of Camporosso as principal patron before God of the Genoa province of the Capuchin Friars Minor; a single religious province, recorded for review. The protocol is printed with a hyphen (464-72) on this page and as 464/72 on p. 362.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 28 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 464-72): confirmatur electio S. Francisci a Camporosso, principalis apud Deum Patroni Provinciae Genuensis Ordinis Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum.

summary_en: Second act under protocol 464/72 (the first confirms him as patron of the province, p. 360): grants that in the Genoa province of the Capuchins St Francis of Camporosso may be celebrated with the grade of feast, and as a solemnity in the church of the Immaculate Conception where his body is kept; grade recorded as the province-wide feast and flagged because two grades are printed.
excerpt: Die 28 iulii 1972 (Prot. n. 464/72): conceditur ut in Provincia Ianuensi Ordinis S. Franciscus a Camporosso celebrari valeat gradu Festi; in ecclesia autem B. Mariae V. Immaculatae, ubi eius corpus asservatur, uti Sollemnitas.

summary_en: Confirms the particular calendar of the Cosenza Commissariat of the Capuchin Friars Minor.
excerpt: Die 3 aug. 1972 (Prot. n. 1078/72): confirmatur Calendarium particulare Commissariatus Consentini Ordinis.

celebration.name_latin: Sollemnitas B. Mariae V. a SS.mo Sacramento

summary_en: Grants that in the parish of Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament at San Pier d'Arena (archdiocese of Genoa, Italy) the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary of the Blessed Sacrament may be celebrated on the third Sunday of October; a single-parish item recorded for review.
excerpt: Ianuensis, 18 aug. 1972 (Prot. n. 1143/72): conceditur ut in paroecia Dominae Nostrae a SS.mo Sacramento, loco v. d. « San Pier d'Arena » sita, sollemnitas B. Mariae V. a SS.mo Sacramento celebrari valeat tertia dominica mensis octobris.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Cistercian Order of the Strict Observance (Trappists).
excerpt: Ordo Cisterciensis Strictioris Observantiae, 31 aug. 1972 (Prot. n. 855/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Ordinis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Brescia (Italy).
excerpt: Brixiensis, 6 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 1061/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium dioecesis.

summary_en: Grants that in the archdiocese of Barcelona (Spain) the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mercy may be celebrated on 24 September with the grade of solemnity.
excerpt: Barcinonensis, 21 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 1228/72): conceditur ut in archidioecesi die 24 septembris celebrari valeat B. Mariae V. de Mercede, gradu sollemnitatis.

celebration.name_latin: Sollemnitas Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D. N. I. C.

summary_en: Grants that in the « Monastero delle Suore Adoratrici del Preziosissimo Sangue » of the Sisters of St Joseph Benedict Cottolengo the solemnity of the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ may be celebrated on 1 July; a single monastery, recorded for review.
excerpt: Sorores Sancti Ioseph B. Cottolengo, 21 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 1268/72): conceditur ut in monasterio v. d. « Monastero delle Suore Adoratrici del Preziosissimo Sangue », celebrari valeat die 1 iulii sollemnitas Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D. N. I. C.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar common to the German-language regions, entitled « Der Regionalkalender für das Deutsche Sprachgebiet »; a multi-nation language region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland and other German-speaking territories) with no single ISO code, recorded for review.
excerpt: Regiones Linguae Germanicae, 21 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 2069/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Regionibus linguae Germanicae commune, quod inscribitur: « Der Regionalkalender für das Deutsche Sprachgebiet ».

summary_en: Confirms the variations to be introduced into the proper calendar by the religious provinces of the Order of St Augustine in North America.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Sancti Augustini, 22 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 632/72): confirmantur variationes in Calendarium Proprium inducendae a Provinciis religiosis Ordinis in America Septentrionali exstantibus.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1972: grants that the liturgical celebrations in honour of the Forty Martyrs of England and Wales may be held on the 29th Sunday in Ordinary Time (22 October) of that year.
excerpt: Anglia et Cambria, 29 sept. 1972 (Prot. n. 1307/72): conceditur ut hoc anno celebrationes liturgicae in honorem Sanctorum 40 Martyrum Angliae et Cambriae fieri possint die dominica XXIX « per annum » (22 octobris).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: S. Teresia ab Avila. In transverberatione cordis

summary_en: Grants that the proper calendar of the Order of Discalced Carmelites be completed with the celebration « St Teresa of Avila, in the transverberation of her heart »; no date or grade is printed.
excerpt: die 4 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1285/72), conceditur ut idem Calendarium compleatur celebratione « S. Teresiae ab Avila. In transverberatione cordis ».

summary_en: Grants that in the Roman province of the Capuchins Blessed Crispin of Viterbo may be celebrated on 19 May, with the grade of feast in the Roman friary of the Conception of the BVM and in the friary of Viterbo and as an obligatory memorial in the whole province; grade recorded as the province-wide obligatory memorial and flagged because two grades are printed.
excerpt: Die 4 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1333/72): conceditur ut in Provincia romana Ordinis, Beatus Crispinus a Viterbio celebrari valeat die 19 maii, gradu Festi in Conventu Romano Conceptionis B. Mariae V. et in Conventu Viterbiensi, gradu Memoriae obligatoriae in tota Provincia.

celebration.name_latin: S. Ioseph, Sponsus B. M. V.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as principal patron before God of the diocese of Ciudad Guzmán (Mexico).
excerpt: Civitas Guzmana, 9 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1154/72): confirmatur electio S. Ioseph, Sponsi B. M. V., dioecesis Civitatis Guzmanae principalis apud Deum Patroni.

summary_en: Confirms the regional calendar of Slovenia and the proper calendars of the dioceses of Ljubljana and Maribor-Lavant and of the Apostolic Administration of the Slovene Littoral; in 1972 Slovenia was a region of Yugoslavia, so recorded as a sub-national region with the current code SI and flagged for review.
excerpt: Slovenia, 12 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1125/72): confirmatur Calendarium Regionale Sloveniae et Calendaria propria dioecesium Labacensis, Mariborensis-Lavantinae et Administraturae Apostolicae Litoris Sloveni.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1972 only: in the city of Goa the feast of St Francis Xavier may be celebrated on 3 December 1972 even though it coincides with the First Sunday of Advent, and elsewhere in the archdiocese of Goa and Daman either the Sunday or the feast may be kept that day (the same protocol also grants a pilgrims' votive Mass at the Bom Jesus basilica, not recorded).
excerpt: Goana et Damanensis, 16 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1357/72): conceditur ut in civitate Goana festum S. Francisci Xavier celebretur hoc anno die 3 decembris etiamsi eadem die occurrat Prima Dominica Adventus; in tota Archidioecesi celebrari potest, eadem die huius anni, vel Prima Dominica Adventus vel festum S. Francisci Xavier.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Matris Ecclesiae

summary_en: Grants that the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Mother of the Church, patroness of the diocese, may be kept throughout the diocese 'Alanopolitana' on 11 October; the diocese could not be identified with certainty from the Latin name, so the nation is left null.
excerpt: Alanopolitana, 19 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1402/72): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Matris Ecclesiae, Patronae dioecesis, peragi valeat in tota dioecesi die 11 octobris.

target.institute: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B. M. V. Immaculatae

summary_en: Grants that members of the Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate may use either the General Calendar or the calendar of the local Church, in both cases with their own proper celebrations added, the choice being made at the level of the religious province or wider by the competent superiors.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B. M. V. Immaculatae, 26 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1299/72): conceditur ut sodales Congregationis aut Calendarium generale, additis celebrationibus propriis, aut Calendarium Ecclesiae localis, additis semper celebrationibus propriis, adhibere possit, dummodo electio circa Calendarium adhibendum fiat in ambitu religiosae Provinciae vel amplioris dicionis a Superioribus competentibus.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Liverpool (England).
excerpt: Liverpolitana, 28 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1430/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Rome.
excerpt: Roma, 28 oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 928/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of Ireland (the same protocol number also covers the English translation of the Irish proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours, a text confirmation not recorded).
excerpt: Hibernia, 6 nov. 1972 (Prot. n. 203/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of the Pious Schools (Piarists).
excerpt: Ordo Scholarum Piarum, 11 nov. 1972 (Prot. n. 1270/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendars of 41 German-speaking dioceses listed by name (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg and Bolzano-Bressanone in Italy: Aquisgranensis, Augustana Vindelicorum, Basileensis, Bambergensis, Bauzanensis-Brixinensis, Berolinensis, Campitemplensis, Coloniensis, Curiensis, Essendiensis, Eystettensis, Friburgensis, Fuldensis, Gorliciensis, Graecensis-Seccoviensis, Gurcensis, Herbipolensis, Hildesiensis, Lausannensis Genevensis et Friburgensis, Limburgensis, Linciensis, Luganensis, Luxemburgensis, Misnensis, Moguntina, Monacensis et Frisingensis, Monasteriensis, Oenipontana, Osnabrugensis, Paderbornensis, Passaviensis, Ratisbonensis, Rottemburgensis, Salisburgensis, S. Hippolyti, S. Galli, Sedunensis, Sideropolitana, Spirensis, Trevirensis, Vindobonensis); spans several nations so the nation is null; the protocol is printed without a year suffix.
excerpt: Regiones linguae Germanicae, die 15 nov. 1972 (Prot. n. 2069): confirmata sunt Calendaria propria dioecesium linguae germanicae, quae sequuntur, nempe: Aquisgranensis, Augustana Vindelicorum, Basileensis, Bambergensis, Bauzanensis-Brixinensis, Berolinensis, Campitemplensis, Coloniensis, Curiensis, Essendiensis, Eystettensis, Friburgensis, Fuldensis, Gorliciensis, Graecensis-Seccoviensis, Gurcensis, Herbipolensis, Hildesiensis, [...] Spirensis, Trevirensis, Vindobonensis.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Sigüenza-Guadalajara (Spain).
excerpt: Seguntina-Guadalaiarensis, 29 nov. 1972 (Prot. n. 1603/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Patriarchal Vatican Basilica of St Peter; a single-church calendar, so the level is recorded as 'other'.
excerpt: Sacrosancta Patriarchalis Basilica Vaticana, 13 dec. 1972 (Prot. n. 432/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium Basilicae.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Theatines; the same protocol also confirms the Latin texts of the Order's proper Masses, a text approval not recorded.
excerpt: Ordo Clericorum Regularium (Theatinorum), 20 dec. 1972 (Prot. n. 1619/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Order of Augustinian Recollects.
excerpt: Ordo Augustinianorum Recollectorum, 20 dec. 1972 (Prot. n. 1677/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the diocese of Amiens (France).
excerpt: Ambianensis, 16 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 1503/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

target.institute: Congregatio ab Annuntiatione O.S.B. (ecclesia abbatialis S. Columbae in « Glenstal »)

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the abbey church of St Columba at Glenstal (Ireland), of the Benedictine Congregation of the Annunciation; the retrospective list in Notitiae 85 p. 285 gives the same date under the name 'Sorores S. Benedicti ab Annuntiatione', which does not match.
excerpt: Congregatio ab Annuntiatione O.S.B., 18 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 131/73): confirmatur Calendarium proprium ecclesiae abbatialis S. Columbae in « Glenstal ».

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti: ecclesia abbatialis S. Anselmi de Urbe

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Benedictine abbey church of Sant'Anselmo in Rome.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti: ecclesia abbatialis S. Anselmi de Urbe, 18 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 1847/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1974 only: because the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception falls on the Second Sunday of Advent in 1974 and would otherwise be anticipated to Saturday, Paul VI concedes that, at the judgement of each Episcopal Conference, it may be celebrated on Sunday 8 December 1974 notwithstanding the Advent Sunday; notice signed by the Secretary, no protocol number printed.
excerpt: Pluribus Episcopis petentibus, Summus Pontifex Paulus VI concedit ut celebratio liturgica B. Mariae V. Immaculatae anno 1974 de iudicio Conferentiae Episcoporum peragi possit die 8 decembris, dominica Adventus non obstante.

target.institute: Ordo Hospitalarius S. Ioannis a Deo

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Hospitaller Order of St John of God.
excerpt: Ordo Hospitalarius S. Ioannis a Deo, 24 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 115/73): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Congregation of Missionaries of St Joseph.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum a S. Ioseph, 25 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 558/71): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

target.institute: Congregatio Servarum B. M. V. Infirmis Ministrantium
