celebration.name_latin: B. Maria Virgo sub titulo « Salus infirmorum »

summary_en: Grants that in the Congregation of the Servants of Mary Ministering to the Sick the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary 'Health of the Sick' may be kept on 8 May with the rank of solemnity (the same protocol also confirms Latin and Spanish Mass texts, not recorded).
excerpt: Congregatio Servarum B. M. V. Infirmis Ministrantium, 30 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 1652/72): conceditur ut in Congregatione celebratio B. Mariae V. sub titulo « Salus infirmorum » die 8 maii gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

summary_en: Confirms the proper calendar of the Sisters of the Divine Redeemer.
excerpt: Sorores Divini Redemptoris, 31 ian. 1973 (Prot. n. 1545/72): confirmatur Calendarium proprium.

target.institute: Moniales Passionistae Pretiosissimi Sanguinis (monasterium Passionis apud « Les Sables-D'Olonne »)

summary_en: Instruction 'Normae circa Patronos constituendos' of the Congregation for Divine Worship (19 March 1973, AAS 65, pp. 276-279; no protocol number printed) fixing how patrons rank in calendars: the patron of a place (town or city), moral person, association, institute or group is celebrated as a solemnity with precedence over all feasts of the general or particular calendar and over Sundays of Christmas Time and Ordinary Time; the patron of a diocese, province, region, nation or wider territory, or of a religious province, is celebrated as a feast, which for pastoral reasons may be raised to a solemnity; secondary patrons formerly constituted are celebrated as obligatory memorials.
excerpt: 12. Celebratio Patroni loci vel oppidi vel civitatis, personae moralis, sodalitatis, instituti, coetus, peragitur gradu sollemnitatis. Quae sollemnitas gaudet praecedentia super omnia festa in Calendario generali vel particulari inscripta et super dominicas temporis Nativitatis et « per annum ». Celebratio Patroni dioecesis, provinciae, regionis, nationis aut amplioris territorii et provinciae religiosae peragitur gradu festi. [...] 14. Patroni secundarii olim constituti celebrentur gradu memoriae obligatoriae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Benedictine abbey of Notre-Dame et Saint-Pierre de Faremoutiers (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Abbatia Dominae Nostrae et S. Petri de Faremoutiers O.S.B., 22 apr. 1975 (Prot. n. 519/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Congregation of the Blessed Sacrament is confirmed.
excerpt: Congregatio Presbyterorum a SS.mo Sacramento, 29 apr. 1975 (Prot. n. 328/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Verdun (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Virodunensis, 13 maii 1975 (Prot. n. 1864/72).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Cortona (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Cortonensis, 15 maii 1975 (Prot. n. 2320/74).

summary_en: The proper calendars of the provinces of the Order of Friars Minor Conventual are confirmed.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, 22 maii 1975 (Prot. n. 241/75): confirmantur calendaria propria Provinciarum Ordinis.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Franciscan families in Poland is confirmed.
excerpt: Familiae Franciscales in Polonia, 22 maii 1975 (Prot. n. 688/75).

summary_en: St Apollinaris, bishop and martyr, is confirmed as principal patron of the dioceses of the region of Emilia-Romagna (Italy).
excerpt: Aemiliana et Flaminia regio in Italia, 5 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 578/75): confirmatur electio S. Apollinaris Episcopi et Martyris dioecesium regionis Aemilianae et Flaminiae principalis apud Deum Patroni.

summary_en: In the dioceses of the Dominican Republic the feast of St Dominic may be celebrated on 4 August and the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross on 3 May, while the memorial of St John Mary Vianney is transferred to 8 August and the feast of Sts Philip and James to 4 May.
excerpt: Dominicanae Reipubblicae dioeceses, 5 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 657/75): conceditur ut festum S. Dominici die 4 augusti et festum Exaltationis S. Crucis die 3 maii celebrari valeant, dum memoria S. Ioannis Mariae Vianney ad diem 8 augusti et festum SS. Philippi et Iacobi Apostolorum ad diem 4 maii transferuntur.

target.institute: « Bénédictines de Notre-Dame du Calvaire », O.S.B.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Benedictines of Notre-Dame du Calvaire is confirmed.
excerpt: « Bénédictines de Notre-Dame du Calvaire », O.S.B., 11 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 592/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Benedictine monastery of the Holy Cross is confirmed; the page does not say where the monastery is.
excerpt: Monasterium S. Crucis, O.S.B., 11 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 713/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Vitoria (Spain) is confirmed.
excerpt: Victoriensis, 12 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 716/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Augustinians of the Assumption is confirmed.
excerpt: Congregatio Augustinianorum ab Assumptione, 16 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 745/75).

summary_en: In the dioceses of the region of Emilia-Romagna (Italy) the liturgical celebration of St Apollinaris is raised to the rank of feast.
excerpt: Dioeceses regionis Aemilianae et Flaminiae in Italia, 17 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 579/75): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Sancti Apollinaris gradu festi fiat.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Clerics Regular of Somasca is confirmed.
excerpt: Ordo Clericorum Regularium a Somascha, 27 iunii 1975 (Prot. n. 854/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Pontifical German-Hungarian College in Rome is confirmed; a single-institution item.
excerpt: Pont. Collegium Germanicum et Hungaricum Urbis, 3 iulii 1975 (Prot. n. 848/75): confirmatur calendarium proprium Collegii.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Congregation of the Most Holy Redeemer (Redemptorists) is confirmed.
excerpt: Congregatio SS.mi Redemptoris, 14 iulii 1975 (Prot. n. 371/75).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo in Caelum Assumpta

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary Assumed into Heaven is confirmed as patroness of the diocese of Tuxpan (Mexico).
excerpt: Tuxpaniensis, 16 iulii 1975 (Prot. n. 2309/74): confirmatur electio B. Mariae V. in Caelum Assumptae dioecesis Tuxpaniensis apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Massa Marittima-Populonia (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Massana-Populonensis, 16 iulii 1975 (Prot. n. 7/75).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the dioceses of Argentina, listed under Calendaria particularia (decree of 31 July 1975).
excerpt: Argentinae dioeceses, 31 iulii 1975 (Prot. n. 2180/74).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Lyon (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Lugdunensis, 7 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 36/75).

target.institute: Moniales S. Benedicti (Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple, Limon, Igny)

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Benedictine nuns of the Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple at Limon (Igny, France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Moniales S. Benedicti (Abbaye Saint-Louis du Temple, Limon, Igny), 18 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 87/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Reims (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Remensis, 18 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 97/75).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of Graces is confirmed as patroness of the locality of Palagianello (diocese of Castellaneta, Italy); a single-locality item.
excerpt: Castellanetensis, 19 augusti 1975 (Prot. CD 111/75): confirmatur electio B. Mariae V. sub titulo Matris Gratiarum apud Deum Patronae loci v.d. « Palagianello ».

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Society of Mary is confirmed.
excerpt: Societas Mariae, 2 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 194/75).

summary_en: The celebration of St Oliver Plunkett is inserted into the calendar of the diocese of Hildesheim (Germany), to be kept each year on 10 July.
excerpt: Hildesiensis, 2 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 198/75): conceditur ut celebratio S. Oliverii Plunkett inseratur in Calendarium dioecesis, die 10 iulii quotannis peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: B. Maria Virgo a La Salette

summary_en: In the parish church of St Francis of Assisi in the diocese of Pavia (Italy) the Mass of the Blessed Virgin Mary of La Salette may be celebrated each year on 19 September; a single-parish item.
excerpt: Papiensis, 13 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 266/75): conceditur ut in ecclesia paroeciali S. Francisci Assisiensis die 19 mensis sept. quotannis celebrari possit Missa B. Mariae Virginis a La Salette.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Troyes (France) is confirmed.
excerpt: Trecensis, 16 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 82/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Sardinia (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Sardiniae dioeceses, 20 sept. 1975 (Prot. CD 297/75).

summary_en: It is established that the celebration of St Gemma Galgani is kept on 16 May by all who venerate her; the decree is listed under the Passionists but its wording ("ab omnibus qui eam colunt") reaches beyond the congregation.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis Iesu Christi, 10 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 204/75): statuitur ut celebratio S. Gemmae Galgani ab omnibus qui eam colunt, die 16 maii peragatur.

summary_en: In the VII Pastoral Region of Peru the feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross may be celebrated on 3 May instead of 14 September, with the feast of the Apostles Philip and James transferred to 4 May.
excerpt: Peruviae dioeceses, 15 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 230/75): conceditur ut in VII Regione Pastorali Peruviae festum exaltationis S. Crucis die 3 maii celebrari possit, loco diei 14 septembris, festo Apostolorum Philippi et Iacobi ad diem 4 maii translato.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Czechoslovakia is confirmed; the same protocol is described on p. 340 as the Latin text and Slovak translation of the Proper of Masses of the dioceses of Slovakia, so the code may need to be SK rather than CZ.
excerpt: Cecoslovachiae dioeceses, 15 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 488/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Lugo (Spain) is confirmed; the protocol is printed without a year suffix (p. 341 prints it as Prot. CD 332/75 for the same diocese).
excerpt: Lucensis in Hispania, 20 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 332).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Siena (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Senensis, 20 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 523/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Montalcino (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Ilcinensis, 20 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 524/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Bologna (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Bononiensis, 30 oct. 1975 (Prot. CD 538/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the whole Cassinese Benedictine Congregation and the proper calendars of its individual monasteries are confirmed.
excerpt: Congregatio Casinensis, O.S.B., 4 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 474/75): confirmatur Calendarium proprium totius Congregationis necnon Calendaria propria singulorum Monasteriorum.

summary_en: St Rose of Lima is confirmed as patroness of the public security officers (police) of the province of La Pampa (diocese of Santa Rosa, Argentina); a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Sancta Rosa in Argentina, 5 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 578/75): confirmatur electio S. Rosae Limanae apud Deum Patronae Ministrorum Publicae Securitatis Provinciae v. d. « La Pampa ».

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Congregation of the Holy Rosary, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Congregatio a S. Rosario, 7 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 609/75).

target.institute: « Bénédictines du Saint-Sacrement, Monastère Sainte-Trinité de Bayeux »

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Benedictines of the Blessed Sacrament, Monastery of the Holy Trinity at Bayeux, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: « Bénédictines du Saint-Sacrement, Monastère Sainte-Trinité de Bayeux », 11 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 627/75).

target.institute: Moniales O.S.B. ab Adoratione perpetua SS.mi Sacramenti (dioecesis Baiocensis in Gallia)

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Benedictine nuns of Perpetual Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament (diocese of Bayeux, France), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Moniales O.S.B. ab Adoratione perpetua SS.mi Sacramenti (dioecesis Baiocensis in Gallia), 12 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 632/75).

summary_en: In the diocese of Chur the celebration of Sts Placidus and Sigisbert may be transferred from 11 July to 12 July.
excerpt: Curiensis, 20 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 589/75): conceditur ut in dioecesi Curiensi celebratio SS. Placidi et Sigisberti transferri valeat a die 11 ad diem 12 iulii.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Lodi (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia. The page prints the same protocol number (CD 589/75) and date as the preceding Curiensis line, which is probably a misprint; the id carries a -2 suffix to stay unique.
excerpt: Laudensis, 20 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 589/75).

celebration.name_latin: S. Ioseph Sponsus B. Mariae Virginis

summary_en: St Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, is confirmed as patron of the city of Antofagasta (Chile).
excerpt: Antofagastensis in Chilia, 22 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 686/75): confirmatur electio S. Ioseph B. Mariae Virginis Sponsi civitatis Antofagastensis apud Deum Patroni.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the prelature nullius of Acquaviva delle Fonti (Italy) listed under Calendaria particularia; the same decree confirms the Italian text of the Proper of Masses (p. 12).
excerpt: Aquavivensis praelatura nullius, 24 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 362/75).

target.institute: Sorores Dominae nostrae a Caritate Boni Pastoris

celebration.name_latin: B. Maria Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde

summary_en: The Sisters of Our Lady of Charity of the Good Shepherd may inscribe Bl. Maria Droste zu Vischering of the Divine Heart in their particular calendar as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Sorores Dominae nostrae a Caritate Boni Pastoris, 24 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 659/75): conceditur ut celebratio B. Mariae Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde in Calendario particulari inscribi valeat tamquam memoria obligatoria.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Congregation of the Blessed Sacrament, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Congregatio SS.mi Sacramenti, 25 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 695/75).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Nardo (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Neritonensis, 27 nov. 1975 (Prot. CD 525/75).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Calahorra y La Calzada-Logroño (Spain) is confirmed; the page prints the date as "10 dec. 1975", evidently a misprint for 10 December 1974 (the same protocol is dated 10 dec. 1974 in Notitiae 104, p. 107), so the date is transcribed as printed and the id uses 1974.
excerpt: Calaguritana, Calceatensis, Logrognensis, 10 dec. 1975 (Prot. n. 1248/74).

summary_en: The Sisters of the Most Precious Blood may celebrate the Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ on 1 July as a solemnity.
excerpt: Sorores Pretiosissimi Sanguinis, 10 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 740/75): conceditur ut celebratio Pretiosissimi Sanguinis D.N.I.C. peragi valeat die 1 iulii tamquam sollemnitas.

target.institute: Congregatio Clericorum Parochialium seu Catechistarum S. Viatoris

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Clerics of St Viator, listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Congregatio Clericorum Parochialium seu Catechistarum S. Viatoris, 10 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 749/75).

summary_en: Regional particular calendar of the dioceses of the Piceno region (Marche, Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia; a multi-diocese region within one nation, recorded with level other.
excerpt: Picenae regionis dioeceses, 10 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 752/75).

celebration.name_latin: S. Ambrosius, episcopus et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: St Ambrose, bishop and doctor of the Church, is confirmed as patron of the Lombardy region (Italy); a regional (multi-diocese) patronage, recorded with level other.
excerpt: Regio Longobardica in Italia, 11 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 711/75): confirmatur electio S. Ambrosii Episcopi et Ecclesiae Doctoris apud Deum Patroni Regionis Longobardiae.

target.institute: Ordines Fratrum S. Augustini et Augustinianorum Recollectorum

summary_en: The Order of St Augustine and the Augustinian Recollects may inscribe Bl. Ezekiel Moreno in their particular calendar as an obligatory memorial (the same decree confirms his Mass and Office texts, p. 13).
excerpt: Ordines Fratrum S. Augustini et Augustinianorum Recollectorum, 15 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 704/75): conceditur ut in Calendario particulari memoria obligatoria B. Ezechielis Moreno inscribi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: S. Vincentia Maria Lopez y Vicuña

summary_en: The Religious of Mary Immaculate may celebrate St Vicenta Maria Lopez y Vicuna each year on 25 May according to the norms of the Roman Calendar.
excerpt: Religiosae Mariae Immaculatae, 29 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 838/75): conceditur ut celebratio S. Vincentiae Mariae Lopez y Vicuña, quotannis die 25 maii, secundum normas Calendarii Romani, peragi valeat.

target.institute: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B. Mariae Virginis Immaculatae

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Oblates of Mary Immaculate is confirmed, and it may be inserted either into the General Roman Calendar or into the calendar of the local Church, the choice being made at the level of the religious province or a wider circumscription by the competent superiors.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum B. Mariae Virginis Immaculatae, 30 dec. 1975 (Prot. CD 741/75): confirmatur Calendarium particulare atque conceditur ut idem Calendarium inseri valeat sive in Calendarium Romanum generale sive in Calendarium Ecclesiae localis, dummodo electio circa Calendarium adhibendum fiat in ambitu religiosae Provinciae vel amplioris dicionis a Superioribus competentibus.

celebration.name_latin: B. Arnoldus Janssen; B. Maria Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde

summary_en: The diocese of Muenster may inscribe in its calendar, as optional memorials, Bl. Arnold Janssen and Bl. Maria Droste zu Vischering of the Divine Heart (the same decree confirms the German Mass texts, p. 11).
excerpt: Monasteriensis, 3 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 822/75): conceditur ut in Calendario dioecesis inscribi valeant tamquam memoriae ad libitum celebrationes B. Arnoldi Janssen et B. Mariae Droste zu Vischering a Divino Corde.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Colle di Val d'Elsa (Collensis, Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Collensis, 7 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 772/75).

summary_en: The diocese of Timisoara (Romania) is allowed, for pastoral reasons, to keep some celebrations on the days they had before the reformed Roman Calendar.
excerpt: Decreta particularia, Timisoarensis, 8 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 4/76): conceditur, ob rationes pastorales, ut aliquae celebrationes peragi valeant diebus sicut ante Calendarium Romanum instauratum.

target.institute: Congregatio Sacrorum Cordium Iesu et Mariae necnon Adorationis perpetuae SS.mi Sacramenti altaris

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Congregation of the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary (Picpus), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin Mass and Office texts, p. 13).
excerpt: Congregatio Sacrorum Cordium Iesu et Mariae necnon Adorationis perpetuae SS.mi Sacramenti altaris, 8 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 43/75).

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska is confirmed as patroness of the missionary works in Poland.
excerpt: Polonia, 20 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 814/75): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Teresiae Ledochowska apud Deum Patrona operibus missionalibus in Polonia addictorum.

summary_en: Bl. Vincent Grossi is inscribed in the proper calendar of the Church of Lodi, to be celebrated each year on 7 November as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Laudensis, 21 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 48/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Vincentii Grossi in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Laudensis inseratur, quotannis die 7 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Bl. Joseph Moscati is inscribed in the proper calendar of the Church of Salerno, to be celebrated each year on 12 April as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Salernitana, 21 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 86/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioseph Moscati in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Salernitanae inseratur, quotannis die 12 aprilis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: In the city of Priverno and in the abbey of Fossanova (diocese of Terracina-Latina-Priverno-Sezze) St Thomas Aquinas may be celebrated on 7 March as a solemnity, under n. 21 of the Instruction Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Terracinensis, Latinensis, Privernensis et Setinae, 22 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 73/76): ad normam n. 21 Instr. Calendaria particularia conceditur ut celebratio S. Thomae de Aquino, in civitate Privernensi et in Abbatia Fossanovae, peragi valeat die 7 martii gradu sollemnitatis.

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Order of St Augustine for Italy and Malta is confirmed (the same decree confirms the Latin and Italian Proper texts, p. 54).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini, 23 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 705/75): confirmatur Calendarium particulare pro Italia et Melita.

summary_en: The particular calendar of the Sardinian province of the Order of Friars Minor is confirmed.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, 24 ian. 1976 (Prot. CD 95/76): confirmatur Calendarium particulare Provinciae Sardiniae eiusdem Ordinis.

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska is inserted in the calendar of the archdiocese of Salzburg, to be celebrated each year on 6 July as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Salisburgensis, 2 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 126/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Teresiae Ledochowska, in Calendarium Archidioecesis Salisburgensis inseratur, quotannis die 6 iulii tamquam memoria ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Bl. Mary Teresa Ledochowska may be inscribed in the calendar of the diocese of Sankt Poelten on 6 July as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Sancti Hippolyti, 3 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 141/76): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Theresiae Ledochowska in Calendario dioecesis Sancti Hippolyti die 6 iulii tamquam memoria ad libitum ascribi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, Provincia Umbriae

summary_en: Particular celebrations are confirmed for the Umbrian province of the Capuchins: St Veronica Giuliani as an obligatory memorial (9 July in the houses of the diocese of Citta di Castello, with Sts Nicholas Pick, Willehad and companions on 10 July; elsewhere as in the common Franciscan calendar for Italy confirmed 8 July 1973, Prot. 855/73), and St Joseph of Leonessa as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Cappuccinorum, 4 feb. 1976 (Prot. CD 145/76): confirmantur celebrationes particulares pro Provincia Umbriae eiusdem Ordinis, nempe: S. Veronicae Giuliani memoria obligatoria [...] S. Iosephi a Leonessa memoria obligatoria

summary_en: In all monasteries of the Cassinese Benedictine Congregation the celebration of St Benedict may be held each year on 21 March.
excerpt: Congregatio Casinensis, O.S.B., 12 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 170/76): conceditur ut in omnibus monasteriis eiusdem Congregationis celebratio S. Benedicti die 21 martii quotannis peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Belley (France), listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin and French Proper texts, p. 95).
excerpt: Bellicensis, 24 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 258/76).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Lyciensis Assumptionis B.M.V.

celebration.name_latin: B. Aegidius Maria a S. Ioseph

summary_en: In the Lecce province of the Friars Minor (Assumption of the BVM) Bl. Giles Mary of St Joseph may be celebrated each year on 7 February as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Lyciensis Assumptionis B.M.V., 25 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 223/75): conceditur ut celebratio B. Aegidii Mariae a S. Ioseph die 7 februarii quotannis celebrari valeat gradu memoriae obligatoriae.

summary_en: In the calendar of the archdiocese of Salerno the obligatory memorial of St Alferius is transferred from 12 April to 5 October.
excerpt: Salernitana, 26 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 255/76): conceditur ut in calendarium archidioecesis memoria obligatoria S. Alpherii e die 12 aprilis ad diem 5 octobris transferri valeat.

summary_en: The diocese of Aachen may insert in its calendar the optional memorial of Bl. Arnold Janssen on 15 January.
excerpt: Aquisgranensis, 26 febr. 1976 (Prot. CD 276/76): conceditur ut memoria ad libitum Beati Arnoldi Janssen, quotannis die 15 ianuarii celebranda, in calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Oblates of the Virgin Mary, listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin and Italian Proper texts, p. 96).
excerpt: Congregatio Oblatorum B.M.V., 3 martii 1976 (Prot. CD 275/76).

celebration.name_latin: SS. Carolus Lwanga et socii, martyres

summary_en: In Southern Africa the liturgical celebration of Sts Charles Lwanga and companions on 3 June may be held with the rank of feast. The Southern African conference also covers Botswana, Lesotho and Swaziland, so the nation code ZA is approximate.
excerpt: Africa Meridionalis dioeceses, 13 martii 1976 (Prot. CD 324/76): conceditur ut in Africa Meridionali celebratio liturgica Sanctorum Caroli Lwanga et sociorum quotannis die 3 iunii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Pisa (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Pisana, 23 martii 1976 (Prot. CD 626/75).

target.institute: Congregatio Solesmensis O.S.B. (Abbatia SS.mi Salvatoris de Leyre in Hispania)

summary_en: Particular calendar of the abbey of San Salvador de Leyre (Solesmes Congregation, Spain), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Congregatio Solesmensis O.S.B. (Abbatia SS.mi Salvatoris de Leyre in Hispania), 1 apr. 1976 (Prot. CD 434/76).

target.institute: Congregatio Solesmensis O.S.B. (Abbatia SS.mi Salvatoris de Leyre in Hispania)

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Mother of Providence is confirmed as patroness of the abbey of San Salvador de Leyre (Spain).
excerpt: Congregatio Solesmensis O.S.B. (Abbatia SS.mi Salvatoris de Leyre in Hispania), 1 apr. 1976 (Prot. CD 435/76): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Matris Providentiae Abbatiae SS.mi Salvatoris de Leyre in Hispania apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Ugento-Santa Maria di Leuca (Italy), listed under Calendaria particularia.
excerpt: Uxentina - S. Maria Leucadensis, 2 apr. 1976 (Prot. CD 385/76).

summary_en: In the houses of the Blessed Sacrament Fathers within the archdiocese of Liverpool the feast of Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament may be transferred from 13 May to 8 May.
excerpt: Congregatio Presbyterorum a SS.mo Sacramento, 9 Aprilis 1976 (Prot. CD 454/76) conceditur ut, in domibus eiusdem Congregationis intra fines Archidioecesis Liverpolitanae exstantibus, festum B.M.V. a SS.mo Sacramento a die 13 maii transferri valeat ad diem 8 maii.

summary_en: Bl. Eugene de Mazenod is inserted in the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, to be celebrated each year on 21 May as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio SS.mi Cordis Iesu, 13 apr. 1976 (Prot. CD 475/76): conceditur ut in calendarium proprium eiusdem Congregationis celebratio Beati Eugenii de Mazenod inseratur et quotannis die 21 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

summary_en: St Michael the Archangel is confirmed as patron of the ministers of the Portuguese public security police (Policia de Seguranca Publica). The page prints the year of the decree as 1076, an evident misprint for 1976; the date is recorded as 1976-04-23.
excerpt: Lusitania, 23 apr. 1076 (Prot. CD 410/76): confirmatur electio Sancti Michaëlis Archangeli ministrorum lusitanorum publicae securitatis v.d. « Policia de Segurança Publica » apud Deum Patroni.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the Society of St Edmund, listed under Calendaria particularia (the same decree confirms the Latin and English Proper texts, p. 179).

summary_en: Decree 'De celebratione Baptismatis Domini': where the solemnity of the Epiphany is transferred to the Sunday falling on 7 or 8 January, so that the feast of the Baptism of the Lord would be omitted, the Baptism of the Lord is transferred to the Monday immediately following (with a commentary on pp. 478-479).

summary_en: The Sacred Congregation for the Clergy confirmed the decisions of the Mexican Episcopal Conference on weekday holy days of obligation: Epiphany is assigned to the Sunday between 2 and 8 January, the Ascension to the Seventh Sunday of Easter and Corpus Christi to the Sunday after Trinity; St Joseph, Sts Peter and Paul, the Assumption, All Saints and the Immaculate Conception cease to be of obligation; Mary Mother of God (1 January), Our Lady of Guadalupe (12 December) and Christmas remain of obligation. Printed as the headnote to a pastoral reflection by Bishop Arturo Szymanski of Tampico.
excerpt: Die 18 ianuarii 1978, Prot. 157210/I, Sacra Congregatio pro Clericis confirmavit ea, quae a Conferentia Episcoporum Mexici statuta fuerant de celebrationibus, quae infra hebdomadam sunt de praecepto servandae. Qua de re in dioecesibus Mexici: 1. Dominicae, tamquam diei proprio, assignantur Sollemnitates quae sequuntur, hac ratione: a) Epiphania, dominicae a die 2 ad diem 8 ianuarii occurrenti; b) Ascensio, dominicae VII Paschae; c) sollemnitas Ss.mi Corporis et Sanguinis Christi, dominicae post Ss.mam Trinitatem.

summary_en: Apostolic Letter 'Egregiae virtutis' of John Paul II, 31 December 1980, by which Sts Cyril and Methodius are constituted and declared heavenly co-patrons of the whole of Europe alongside St Benedict, with all the liturgical honours and privileges that belong to principal patrons of places. No protocol number is printed; the liturgical consequences (feast on 14 February throughout Europe) are set out in the Congregation's circular letter of 18 January 1981 (Prot. CD 199/81).

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Cyrillus, monachus, et Methodius, episcopus

summary_en: Circular letter of the Congregation for the Sacraments and Divine Worship to the presidents of the episcopal conferences of Europe: following 'Egregiae virtutis', from 1981 the celebration of Sts Cyril and Methodius is to be kept in all parts of Europe with the grade of feast, on the day already fixed in the Roman Calendar (14 February), with Gloria at Mass and the Office as on solemnities except the little hours; where by particular law the saints are already celebrated on a different day or grade, that day and grade are kept.
excerpt: 1. Celebratio Ss. Cyrilli, monachi, et Methodii, episcopi, a vertente anno 1981, peragenda erit gradu Festi. Namque Sancti Cyrillus et Methodius, uti Sanctus Benedictus, posthac Europae Patroni coluntur. [...] 2. Novus celebrationis gradus nullam secumfert variationem circa diem, quo ipsa celebratio peragitur, prout in Calendario Romano invenitur, nempe 14 februarii.

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed Luigi Scrosoppi may be inserted in the calendar of the Congregation of the Sisters of Providence on 5 October as a feast.

summary_en: Particular calendar of the archdiocese of Lanciano-Ortona (Lancianensis-Ortonensis): decree of 8 October 1981. summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mediatrix may be inserted in the calendar of the Congregation of the Missionary Sisters of Christ the King on 31 August as a feast; the same decree confirmed the texts of her Mass and Office (Summarium p. 586).

summary_en: Particular calendar of the diocese of Bayeux-Lisieux (Baiocensis et Lexoviensis): decree of 13 October 1981, the same decree that confirmed the French text of the diocesan Proper of Masses (Summarium p. 584). celebration.name_latin: Beati Alphonsus de Baena et Ioannes a Sancto Martino Rodriguez

summary_en: The archdiocese of Toledo may insert the celebration of Blessed Alfonso de Baena and Blessed Juan de San Martín Rodríguez in its calendar on 14 July as an optional memorial; in their birthplaces (« Villatobas » and « Yuncos ») it is kept on 15 July as an obligatory memorial, and there the obligatory memorial of St Bonaventure is transferred from 15 to 17 July.
excerpt:
Toletana, 15 martii 1982 (Prot. CD 369/82): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Alphonsi de Baena et Beati Ioannis a Sancto Martino Rodriguez in Calendarium archidioecesis Toletanae inseri valeat, quotannis die 14 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.
Conceditur insuper ut in locis nativitatis Beatorum, scilicet: « Villatobas » et « Yuncos », eorundem celebratio die 15 iulii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat. In supradictis locis celebratio memoriae obligatoriae Sancti Bonaventurae, episcopi et Ecclesiae Doctoris, a die 15 ad diem 17 iulii transferatur.

excerpt: Congregatio parvarum sororum pauperum, 14 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 638/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Ioannae Jugan in Calendarium Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 30 augusti gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Lucca may insert the liturgical celebration of St Leonard of Port Maurice in its calendar on 26 November as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Lucensis, 15 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 1025/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica S. Leonardi de Porto Maurizio in Calendarium archidioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 26 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Society of the Divine Saviour (Salvatorians) may insert the liturgical celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of the Saviour in its calendar on 11 October with the grade of solemnity.
excerpt: Societas Divini Salvatoris, 18 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 213/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Salvatoris in Calendarium Societatis inseri valeat, quotannis die 11 octobris gradu sollemnitatis peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of 's-Hertogenbosch may insert the liturgical celebration of Blessed Peter Donders in its diocesan calendar on 14 January as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Buscoducensis, 25 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 908/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Petri Donders in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat quotannis die 14 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: In the churches of the Cistercian Order the celebration of St Philip Neri or of St Gregory VII, pope, may be kept on 26 May as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Cisterciensis, 27 octobris 1982 Prot. CD 1074/82): conceditur ut in ecclesiis Ordinis Cisterciensis celebratio Sancti Philippi Neri vel Sancti Gregorii VII papae quotannis die 26 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragi possit.

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Mariana (Brazil) the election of St Rita of Cascia as patroness before God of the town and whole municipality of « Viçosa » is confirmed.
excerpt: Marianensis, 28 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 947/82): confirmatur electio Sanctae Ritae de Cascia Patronae apud Deum oppidi totiusque municipii v.d. « Viçosa ».

celebration.name_latin: Beati Salvator Lilli et septem socii martyres

summary_en: The Roman Province of the Friars Minor may insert the liturgical celebration of Blessed Salvatore Lilli and his seven companion martyrs in the calendar of the province on 23 November as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Romana, 3 novembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1073/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatorum Salvatoris Lilli et septem eius sociorum martyrum in Calendarium Provinciae inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, Provincia catalaunica

summary_en: The Catalan Province of the Capuchins may insert in its calendar St Salvador of Horta on 18 March, Blessed Bonaventura Gran on 11 September and Blessed Maria Angela Astorch on 2 December, all as optional memorials; Blessed Maria Angela Astorch on 2 December is kept as a feast in the Capuchin Poor Clare monastery « SS. Margarita » in Barcelona-Horta and as an obligatory memorial in the Capuchin Poor Clare monasteries of Manresa, Mataró, Gerona and Palma de Mallorca.

target.institute: Moniales a Visitatione Beatae Mariae Virginis (monasterium de Urbe)

summary_en: In the church of the monastery of the Visitation of Holy Mary in Rome the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Guadalupe may be kept on 10 December with the grade of solemnity.
excerpt: Moniales a Visitatione Beatae Mariae Virginis, 9 novembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1067/82): conceditur ut in ecclesia monasterii a Visitatione Sanctae Mariae de Urbe celebratio Beatae Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe quotannis die 10 decembris gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

summary_en: The diocese of Frederico Westphalen (Brazil) may insert the liturgical celebration of Blessed Kateri Tekakwitha in its calendar on 17 April as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Vestphaleniana, 9 novembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1089/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Catharinae Tekakwitha in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 17 aprilis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Joseph the Worker as patron before God of the diocese of Daet (Philippines); the same Summarium line is repeated in issue 200.
excerpt: Daëtiensis, 29 novembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1136/82): confirmatur electio S. Ioseph opificis Patroni apud Deum dioecesis Daëtiensis.

summary_en: The Congregation of the Sisters of the Divine Saviour may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Saviour, into its calendar, on 11 October each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum Divini Salvatoris, 7 decembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1193/82): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Salvatoris in Calendarium eiusdem Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 11 octobris gradu sollemnitatis peragenda.

summary_en: Blessed Jeanne Jugan may be inserted into the calendar of the archdiocese of Rennes (France), to be celebrated every year on 30 August as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Rhedonensis, 11 decembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1210/82): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Ioannae Jugan in Calendarium archidioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 30 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Angela a Cruce Guerrero González

summary_en: The Society of the Sisters of the Cross may celebrate its foundress Blessed Angela of the Cross Guerrero González in its churches every year on 5 November as a feast.
excerpt: Societas Sororum a Cruce, 17 decembris 1982 (Prot. CD 1224/82): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Angelae a Cruce Guerrero González, Fundatricis, in ecclesiis eiusdem Societatis quotannis die 5 novembris gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: For the dioceses of the United States of America three celebrations are granted: Blessed Kateri Tekakwitha, virgin, on 14 July as an obligatory memorial; Blessed Marie-Rose Durocher, virgin, on 6 October as an optional memorial; Blessed André Bessette, religious, on 6 January as an optional memorial.

The Congregation of the Sacred Stigmata (Stigmatines) may transfer the solemn celebration of its Title, the Sacred Stigmata of Our Lord Jesus Christ, from the Friday before Ash Wednesday to the Friday after the Second Sunday of Easter.
excerpt: Congregatio a SS. Stigmatibus D.N.I.C., 7 ianuarii 1983 (Prot. 109/83): conceditur ut sollemnis celebratio Tituli « SS. Stigmatum D.N.I.C. » a feria VI ante Cineres ad feriam VI post dominicam secundam Paschae transferri possit.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Lawrence, deacon and martyr, as principal patron before God of the parish community of the same Title in the diocese of Limburg (Germany), and of St Leonard as its secondary patron; parish-level, flagged for review.
excerpt: Limburgensis, 8 ianuarii 1983 (Prot. CD 111/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Laurentii diaconi et martyris in Patronum apud Deum principalem communitatis paroecialis eiusdem Tituli atque Sancti Leonardi ipsius communitatis in Patronum apud Deum secundarium.

summary_en: For three parish churches of the archdiocese of Kraków (Poland) the celebration of the Title is fixed on a day each year: Maternity of the BVM at Dziekanowice on 11 October, St Gregory the Great at Kraków-Ruszcza on 12 March, Sts Philip and James at Osielec on 1 May; parish-level items, flagged for review.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Veneta « Sancti Antonii de Padova »

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' with no description beyond the heading; the same protocol appears under 'Confirmatio textuum propriorum religiosorum' (p. 139) confirming the Latin and Italian text of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours of the Venetian Province of St Anthony of Padua of the Friars Minor, which presumably carries the province's proper calendar.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Veneta « Sancti Antonii de Padova », 22 ianuarii 1983 (Prot. CD 629/79).

target.institute: Confoederatio Canonicorum Regularium Ordinis Sancti Augustini

summary_en: The Confederation of Canons Regular of St Augustine may insert Blessed Achard, bishop, into its proper calendar on 27 April as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Confoederatio Canonicorum Regularium Ordinis Sancti Augustini, 1 februarii 1983 (Prot. CD 119/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Achardi, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 27 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Cisterciensium Reformatorum seu Strictioris Observantiae

summary_en: The Trappists (OCSO) may insert Blessed Maria Gabriella Sagheddu, virgin, on 22 April into the calendars of the monasteries of Tre Fontane, Frattocchie, Vitorchiano and Valserena: an obligatory memorial at Vitorchiano and an optional memorial in the other monasteries (grade therefore left unset).
The Cistercian Order may insert Blessed Maria Gabriella Sagheddu into its proper calendar on 22 April as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Cisterciensis, 5 februarii 1983 (Prot. CD 203/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Gabrielae Sagheddu in calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Rose of Viterbo as patroness before God of the florists and flower-growers of the dioceses of Viterbo, Tuscania, Civita Castellana, Acquapendente and Bagnoregio (Italy); a professional-group patronage, so recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: Viterbiensis - Tuscanensis - Faliscodunensis - Aquipendiensis - Balneoregiensis, 8 februarii 1983 (Prot. CD 1011/82): confirmatur electio S. Rosae de Viterbo Patronae apud Deum christifidelium florum cultorum et floristarum earundem dioecesium.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Pope Pius X as patron before God of the pious Italian association UNITALSI (Unione Nazionale Italiana trasporto ammalati a Lourdes e Santuari internazionali); an association patronage, so recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: « Unione Nazionale Italiana trasporto ammalati a Lourdes e Santuari internazionali » (UNITALSI), 8 februarii 1983 (Prot. CD 770/82): confirmatur electio Sancti Papae Pii X in Patronum apud Deum sodalium piae Unionis Italicae UNITALSI nuncupatae.

summary_en: The Brazilian Benedictine Congregation may insert into its proper calendar the celebrations proper to the dioceses of Brazil: Bl. José de Anchieta (9 June, obligatory memorial), BB. Ignatius de Azevedo and companions (17 July, obligatory memorial), St Rose of Lima, patroness of Latin America (23 August, feast), BVM 'Nossa Senhora da Conceição Aparecida', patroness of Brazil (12 October, solemnity), BB. Roque González and companions (19 November, obligatory memorial), BVM 'Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe', patroness of Latin America (12 December, feast).
excerpt: Congregatio Brasiliana Benedictina, 15 februarii 1983 (Prot. CD 200/83): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium Confoederationis Ordinis Sancti Benedicti inseri valeant celebrationes propriae dioecesium Brasiliae, quae sequuntur: B. Iosephi de Anchieta, presbyteri (9 iunii: memoria obligatoria); BB. Ignatii de Azevedo, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum (17 iulii: memoria obligatoria); S. Rosae de Lima, virginis, Patronae Americae Latinae (23 augusti: festum); beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora da Conceição Aparecida », Patronae Brasiliae (12 octobris: sollemnitas); BB. Rochi González, et sociorum, martyrum (19 novembris: memoria obligatoria) et beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora de Guadalupe », Patronae Americae Latinae (12 decembris: festum).

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Casimir as principal patron before God of the city of Radom (diocese of Sandomierz-Radom, Poland); a city patronage, so recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: Sandomiriensis - Radomensis, 4 martii 1983 (Prot. CD 208/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Casimiri Patroni apud Deum principalis civitatis Radomensis.

target.institute: Ordo Cisterciensium reformatorum seu Strictioris observantiae

summary_en: The Trappists (OCSO) may insert Blessed Maria Gabriella Sagheddu into the calendar of the whole Order on 22 April as an optional memorial (extending the monastery-level concession Prot. CD 125/83).
excerpt: Ordo Cisterciensium reformatorum seu Strictioris observantiae, 5 martii 1983 (Prot. CD 330/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Gabrielae Sagheddu in Calendarium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Missionary Society of St Paul with no description of the act; a bare Calendaria line, recorded as a particular-calendar approval per ruling.
excerpt: Societas Missionalis Sancti Pauli, 7 martii 1983 (Prot. CD 1120/83).

summary_en: In the parish of Sonseca (archdiocese of Toledo, Spain) the liturgical celebration of Blessed Gabriel of St Mary Magdalen may be kept every year on 3 September as an obligatory memorial; parish-level, flagged for review.
excerpt: Toletana, 10 martii 1983 (Prot. CD 369/83): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Gabrielis a Magdalena in paroecia loci v.d. « Sonseca » die 3 septembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae quotannis peragi valeat.

summary_en: The dioceses of Sardinia (Italy) may insert Blessed Maria Gabriella Sagheddu, virgin, into their proper calendar on 22 April as an optional memorial; in the parish of St Catherine at Dorgali the same celebration may be kept as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Sardiniae dioeceses, 25 martii 1983 (Prot. CD 465/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Gabrielae Sagheddu, virginis, in Calendarium Proprium earundem dioecesium inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda. Conceditur insuper ut eadem celebratio in paroecia S. Catharinae in « Dorgali » gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: S. Maximilianus Maria Kolbe, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: By mandate of John Paul II the Congregation inserts St Maximilian Maria Kolbe, priest and martyr, into the General Roman Calendar on 14 August, his dies natalis, as an obligatory memorial; the covering letter to the presidents of the Episcopal Conferences (25 April 1983) and the Latin proper texts for Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours are printed with the decree.
excerpt: Sacra porro Congregatio pro Sacramentis et Cultu Divino, praedicto obsequens mandato, celebrationem SANCTI MAXIMILIANI MARIAE KOLBE, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium Romanum generale inseri decernit, quotannis die 14 augusti eius natalicio, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragendam.

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses' for the dioceses of Hungary with no description of the act; a bare Calendaria line, recorded as a particular-calendar approval of the national calendar.
excerpt: Hungariae dioecesis, 8 aprilis 1983 (Prot. CD 985/83).

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses' for the patriarchate of Venice (Italy) with no description of the act; the same date appears on p. 248 confirming the Italian text of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours of Venice under Prot. CD 1165/82, so this line (printed 1165/83) presumably concerns the proper calendar in that Proper.
excerpt: Venetiae, 11 aprilis 1983 (Prot. CD 1165/83).

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses' for the diocese of Stockholm (Sweden) with no description of the act; a bare Calendaria line, recorded as a particular-calendar approval of the diocesan calendar.
excerpt: Holmiensis, 14 aprilis 1983 (Prot. CD 356/83).

target.institute: Congregatio sororum Beatae Mariae Virginis Consolatricis

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Congregation of the Sisters of Our Lady of Consolation with no description of the act; the 'Libri liturgici officiales' list in issue 209 (p. 813) records under the same protocol and date the confirmation of the Congregation's 'Messe Proprie - Calendario Liturgico', so this is presumably the approval of its proper calendar.
excerpt: Congregatio sororum Beatae Mariae Virginis Consolatricis, 21 aprilis 1983 (Prot. CD 199/83).

summary_en: The diocese of Asidonia-Jerez (Spain) may insert Blessed Angela of the Cross into its proper calendar on 5 November as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Assidonensis-Ierezensis, 23 aprilis 1983 (Prot. CD 578/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Angelae a Cruce in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 novembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Subiaco Congregation of the Order of St Benedict may introduce variations into the calendar of its English Province for the use of Pluscarden Abbey of the BVM and Sts John the Baptist and Andrew in Scotland.
excerpt: Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Congregatio Sublacensis, 7 maii 1983 (Prot. CD 308/83): conceditur ut in Calendarium Provinciae Angliae variationes inducantur, ad usum Abbatiae Pluscardensis B.V. Mariae et Ss. Ioannis Baptistae et Andreae in Scotia.

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Missionaries of the Holy Family with no description; the same protocol on p. 302 confirms the Latin text of the Congregation's Proper of Masses, so this line presumably concerns the proper calendar in that Proper.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum a S. Familia, 7 maii 1983 (Prot. CD 309/83).

summary_en: At the request of CELAM, confirms the election of St Turibius de Mogrovejo, bishop, as patron before God of all the bishops of Latin America; a patronage of a body of persons across a wider region rather than of a territory, so flagged for review.
excerpt: Consilium Episcoporum Americae Latinae (C.E.L.A.M.), 10 maii 1983 (Prot. CD 696/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Turibii de Mogrovejo, episcopi, Patroni apud Deum Episcoporum omnium Americae Latinae.

summary_en: For Japan the celebration of the 16 Martyrs of Japan beatified by John Paul II at Manila in 1981 is granted on 10 September as an obligatory memorial, together with the celebration of the 205 Blessed Martyrs kept on the same day in the proper calendar of the dioceses of Japan.
excerpt: Decreta generalia, 28 maii 1983 (Prot. CD 901/83): conceditur ut celebratio 16 martyrum Iaponiae, qui inter Beatos anno 1981 a Summo Pontifice Ioanne Paulo II in civitate Manilensi sunt relati, quotannis die 10 septembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat, una cum celebratione 205 Beatorum Martyrum, quae iuxta Calendarium proprium dioecesium Iaponiae eodem die peragitur.

target.institute: Institutum Fratrum Instructionis Christianae de Ploermel

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Brothers of Christian Instruction of Ploërmel with no description of the act; a bare Calendaria line, recorded as a particular-calendar approval per ruling.
excerpt: Institutum Fratrum Instructionis Christianae de Ploermel, 3 iunii 1983 (Prot. CD 577/83).

summary_en: The diocese of Vigevano (Italy) may insert St Lanfranc, bishop, into its proper calendar on 23 June as an obligatory memorial throughout the diocese, and as a feast in the parish of Gropello Cairoli.
excerpt: Viglevanensis, 9 iunii 1983 (Prot. CD 972/83): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Lanfranchi, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat quotannis die 23 iunii gradu memoriae obligatoriae in universa dioecesi, gradu vero festi in paroecia loci « Gropello Cairoli » nuncupati peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Eligius, bishop, as patron before God of the members of the Argentine Academy of Numismatics; an association patronage, so recorded at level 'other' for review.
excerpt: Argentinae dioceses, 11 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 233/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Eligii, episcopi, sodalium Academiae Argentinae de Nomismatica et Nummaria Patroni apud Deum.

celebration.name_latin: S. Anna, beatae Mariae Virginis genetrix

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Anne, mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as patroness before God of the city of Caserta (Italy); a city patronage, so recorded at level 'other' for review; the protocol number 973/83 is also printed for the Ogliastra patron decree of 7 November 1983 in issue 209.
excerpt: Casertana, 11 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 973/83): confirmatur electio Sanctae Annae, beatae Mariae Virginis genetricis, civitatis Casertanae apud Deum Patronae.

target.institute: Tertius Ordo Sancti Francisci « Pauperibus servientes »

summary_en: The Third Order of St Francis 'Serving the Poor' (Albertines) may transfer the celebration of the new Blessed Albert Kalinowski (Chmielowski) from 25 December, his dies natalis, to 17 June, the anniversary of his baptism.
excerpt: Tertius Ordo Sancti Francisci « Pauperibus servientes », 13 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 1076/83): conceditur ut celebratio novi Beati Alberti Kalinowski a die 25 decembris, eius natali, ad diem 17 iunii, eius baptismi anniversarium, transferri possit.

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Trinitarians with no description; the same protocol on p. 567 confirms the French text of the Order's Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours, so this line presumably concerns the proper calendar in that Proper.
excerpt: Ordo SS. Trinitatis, 16 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 1192/79).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Familiae religiosae' for the Discalced Carmelites with no description; the same protocol on p. 567 confirms the French text of the Order's Proper of the Liturgy of the Hours, so this line presumably concerns the proper calendar in that Proper.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 16 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 315/83).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nossa Senhora Mãe da Divina Graça »

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora Mãe da Divina Graça' as patroness before God of the diocese of Ponta Grossa (Brazil).
excerpt: De Ponta Grossa - Brasiliae, 25 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 1026/83): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v.d. « Nossa Senhora Mãe da Divina Graça » Patronae apud Deum diocesis De Ponta Grossa.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Raphaël Kalinowski a Sancto Ioseph

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the new Blessed Raphael Kalinowski of St Joseph into the Order's proper calendar on 19 November as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Die 25 iulii 1983 (Prot. CD 1089/83): conceditur ut celebratio novi Beati Raphaëlis Kalinowski a Sancto Ioseph in Calendarium proprium Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 19 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The Congregation of the Mission (Vincentians) may insert the liturgical celebration of St Jeanne-Antide Thouret into its proper calendar and that of the Daughters of Charity, on 23 May as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionis, 17 augusti 1983 (Prot. CD 1094/83): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Sanctae Ioannae Antidae Thouret inseri valeat in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Congregationis et Puellarum a Caritate, quotannis die 23 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Listed under 'Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses' for the diocese of Saint-Dié (France) with no description; the same protocol on p. 759 confirms the French text of the diocesan Proper of Masses, so this line presumably concerns the proper calendar in that Proper.
excerpt: Sanctus Deodatus, 1 septembris 1983 (Prot. CD 1783/83).

summary_en: For the pastoral good of the faithful the diocese of Stockholm (Sweden) may keep on the following Sunday in Ordinary Time the feast of the Presentation of the Lord, the solemnity of Sts Peter and Paul, the feast of the Transfiguration, the solemnity of the Assumption, the solemnity of St Bridget (7 October) and the solemnity of each parish's patron; the Nativity of St John the Baptist and All Saints may be kept on the nearest Saturday, and All Souls on the Sunday after the solemnity of All Saints.
excerpt:
Holmiensis, 2 septembris 1983 (Prot. CD 1269/83): conceditur ut, ad bonum pastorale fidelium procurandum, celebrationes quae sequuntur peragi valeant dominica « per annum » sequenti diem respectivum proprium uniuscuiusque celebrationis (cf. « Normae universales de Anno liturgico et de Calendario », n. 58):
— Festum Praesentationis Domini; — Sollemnitas SS. Petri et Pauli, Apostolorum; — Festum Transfigurationis Domini; — Sollemnitas B.M.V. in caelum Assumptae; — Sollemnitas S. Birgittae (die 7 octobris); — Sollemnitas Patroni uniuscuiusque paroeciae.
Conceditur insuper ut sollemnitas Nativitatis S. Ioannis Baptistae et Omnium Sanctorum peragi valeat sabbato proximo respectivo diei proprio et Commemoratio Omnium Fidelium defunctorum die dominica sollemnitatem Omnium Sanctorum sequenti.

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed seven martyrs Peter Cho Hwa-Seo, Joseph Cho Yun-Ho, Peter Lee Myeong-Seo, Peter Cheong Won-Chi, Bartholomew Cheong Mun-Ho, Peter Son Seon-Chi and Joseph Han Weon-Seo as patrons before God of the diocese of Jeonju (Korea); a group of seven, so no single celebration is filled.
excerpt: Ieoniuensis, 16 septembris 1983 (Prot. CD 1016/83): confirmatur electio Beatorum septem martyrum Petri Cho Hwa-Seo, Iosephi Cho Yun-Ho, Petri Lee Myeong-Seo, Petri Cheong Won-Chi, Bartholomaei Cheong Mun-Ho, Petri Son Seon-Chi, Iosephi Han Weon-Seo Patronorum apud Deum dioecesis Ieoniuensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Leopoldus Mandic a Castronovo, religiosus

summary_en: The Capuchins may transfer the liturgical celebration of Blessed Leopold Mandić of Castelnuovo, religious, from 30 July to 12 May.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 17 septembris 1983 (Prot. CD 1288/83): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Leopoldi Mandic a Castronovo, religiosi, a die 30 iulii ad diem 12 maii transferri possit.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Peter Claver, priest, as patron before God of the diocese of Lake Charles (USA).
excerpt: Lacus Carolini, 30 septembris 1983 (Prot. CD 1281/83) confirmatur electio Sancti Petri Claver, presbyteri, in Patronum apud Deum eiusdem dioeceseos.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Seville (Spain) may insert Blessed Angela of the Cross into its proper calendar on 5 November as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Hispalensis, 13 octobris 1983 (Prot. CD 1639/83): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Angelae a Cruce in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 novembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Brazilian Benedictine Congregation may celebrate St Scholastica on 10 February as a solemnity for its nuns.
excerpt: Congregatio Brasiliensis O.S.B., 14 octobris 1983 (Prot. CD 1643/83): conceditur ut celebratio S. Scholasticae, pro monialibus, quotannis die 10 februarii gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat;

summary_en: The Brazilian Benedictine Congregation may insert into its proper calendar, for monks and nuns, Blessed Roque González and companions, martyrs, on 19 November and St Matilda on 20 November, both as obligatory memorials.

summary_en: A decree for the Metropolis of Riga is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description of its content.
excerpt: Metropoliae Rigensis, 24 iulii 1984 (Prot. CD 1044/84).

summary_en: A decree for the diocese of Saint-Claude is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 600 confirms the French text of the Calendar and of the Proper of Masses, so it is recorded as an approval of the calendar text.
excerpt: Sancti Claudii, 4 augusti 1984 (Prot. CD 664/84).

summary_en: A decree for the diocese of Ajaccio is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 600 confirms the French text of the Calendar and of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours, so it is recorded as an approval of the calendar text.
excerpt: Adiacensis, 11 augusti 1984 (Prot. CD 812/84).

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Restituta, virgin and martyr, as patroness before God of the town of Calenzana, or of the region commonly called Balagne, in the diocese of Ajaccio (Corsica); a sub-diocesan territory, so recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Adiacensis, 22 augusti 1984 (Prot. CD 1261/84): confirmatur electio Sanctae Restitutae virginis et martyris Patronae apud Deum sive civitatis Calenzana nuncupatae sive regionis vulgo dictae Balagne.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, Provinciae Americae Septemtrionalis et Angliae

summary_en: In the provinces of North America and England of the Conventual Franciscans the commemoration of all the deceased of the Seraphic Order (friars, sisters, parents and benefactors) may be transferred from 24 November to 3 November, or, if impeded, to the first day free of a Sunday or solemnity after the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, Provinciae Americae Septemtrionalis et Angliae, 27 augusti 1984 (Prot. CD 1289/84): conceditur ut commemoratio Omnium defunctorum Seraphici Ordinis, nempe Fratrum, Sororum, Parentum ac Benefactorum, a die 24 novembris ad diem 3 ipsius mensis, vel eo impedito, ad primum diem liberum a dominica vel sollemnitate, post Commemorationem Omnium Fidelium Defunctorum, transferri possit.

summary_en: One-year concession for 1985: in the dioceses of Spain the solemnity of the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary may be celebrated on 8 December 1985, the Second Sunday of Advent.
excerpt: Hispaniae dioeceses, 25 septembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1546/84): conceditur ut sollemnitas Immaculatae Conceptionis beatae Mariae Virginis die 8 decembris 1985, dominica secunda Adventus, celebrari possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Santa Maria del Sasso »

summary_en: In the churches of the Casentino territory of the diocese of Arezzo (the municipalities of Capolona, Subbiano, Ortignano-Raggiolo, Castel Focognano, Bibbiena, Poppi and Chiusi della Verna) the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title « Santa Maria del Sasso » may be celebrated every year on 23 June as a solemnity; a sub-diocesan territory, so recorded as 'other' and flagged for review.
excerpt: Arretina, 1 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1680/84): conceditur ut in ecclesiis territorii Casentinensis (municipiorum scilicet, quae Capolona, Subbiano, Ortignano-Raggiolo, Castel Focognano, Bibbiana, Poppi, Chiusi della Verna nuncupantur) celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Santa Maria del Sasso » quotannis die 23 iunii gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

summary_en: A decree for the diocese of Orléans is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 946 confirms the French text of the Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours.
excerpt: Aurelianensis, 5 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1070/83).

summary_en: The Canons Regular of St Augustine may insert three celebrations into the Order's proper calendar: St Martin of León, priest, optional memorial on 12 January; St John of Oisterwijk, priest and martyr, optional memorial in the whole Order and feast in the Windesheim-Victorine Congregation, on 9 July; St Bertrand, bishop, optional memorial on 16 October. The same decree (p. 948) confirms the Latin Mass and Office texts of Sts Martin and Bertrand.
excerpt:
Canonici Regulares S. Augustini, 10 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1208/84): libenter conceditur ut, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeant celebrationes quae sequuntur:
die 12 ianuarii: S. Martini Legionensis, presbyteri, memoria ad libitum; die 9 iulii: S. Ioannis Ostervicani, presbyteri et martyris, gradu memoriae ad libitum in universo Ordine, gradu vero festi in Congregatione Vindesemensi-Victorina; die 16 octobris: S. Bertrandi, episcopi, memoria ad libitum.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Lucy, virgin and martyr, as patroness before God of the diocese of Mossoró (Brazil).
excerpt: Mossorensis, 11 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1533/84): confirmatur electio Sanctae Luciae, virginis et martyris, Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Mossorensis.

target.institute: Moniales Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Dominae Nostrae a Calvario

celebration.name_latin: Beata Rosalia Caelestis, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The Benedictine Nuns of Our Lady of Calvary may celebrate Blessed Rosalie Célestine (Rosalia Caelestis), virgin and martyr, every year on 27 January as an obligatory memorial; the same decree (p. 949) confirms the Latin and French texts of her Mass and Office.
excerpt: Moniales Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Dominae Nostrae a Calvario, 12 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1679/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Rosaliae Caelestis, virginis et martyris, quotannis die 27 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

target.institute: Institutum Filiarum a Sancto Ioseph - « Rivalba »

summary_en: The Institute of the Daughters of St Joseph of Rivalba may celebrate Blessed Clement Marchisio every year on 20 September as a feast.
excerpt: Institutum Filiarum a Sancto Ioseph - « Rivalba », 17 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1742/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Clementis Marchisio quotannis die 20 septembris gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: Canonici Regulares S. Augustini (Congregatio Vindesemensis - S. Victoris)

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Windesheim-St Victor Congregation of Canons Regular of St Augustine the optional memorial of St Bertrand, bishop, may be transferred from 16 October to 16 January.
excerpt: Canonici Regulares S. Augustini (Congregatio Vindesemensis - S. Victoris), 30 octobris 1984 (Prot. CD 1791/84): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio memoriae ad libitum Sancti Bertrandi episcopi a die 16 octobris ad diem 16 ianuarii transferri possit.

summary_en: A decree for the French-speaking dioceses of Belgium is listed under « Calendaria particularia — Dioeceses » with no description; the same protocol on p. 946 confirms the French text of the Proper of Masses.
excerpt: Belgii dioeceses linguae gallicae, 3 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 841/84).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Auxilium Christianorum », titulus Abbatiae de Buckfast

summary_en: The solemnity of the title of Buckfast Abbey (Blessed Virgin Mary) may be transferred from 15 August to 24 May, to be celebrated under the title of the Blessed Virgin Mary Help of Christians; a single-abbey item, flagged for review.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti (Congregatio anglica), 7 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1825/84): conceditur ut sollemnitas tituli Abbatiae beatae Mariae Virginis apud « Buckfast » a die 15 augusti ad diem 24 maii transferri possit, sub titulo beatae Mariae Virginis « Auxilii Christianorum » celebranda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Charles Borromeo, bishop, as patron before God of the diocese of São Carlos (Brazil).
excerpt: Sanctus Carolus in Brasilia, 8 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1714/84): confirmatur electio Sancti Caroli Borromeo episcopi Patroni apud Deum dioecesis Sancti Caroli in Brasilia.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception as patroness before God of the Republic of Tanzania.
excerpt: Tanzania, 8 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1732/84): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis Patronae apud Deum Reipublicae Tanzaniensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculati Cordis

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Heart as patroness before God of the nation of Angola.
excerpt: Angola, 21 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1547/84): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculati Cordis Patronae apud Deum nationis Angolensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Mediatricis omnium gratiarum

summary_en: In the churches of the Institute « Misioneras de Acción Parroquial » the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Mediatrix of all graces may be celebrated every year on the last Saturday of May as a solemnity.
excerpt: « Misioneras de Acción Parroquial », 30 novembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1822/84): conceditur ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Instituti celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Mediatricis omnium gratiarum quotannis ultimo sabbato mensis maii gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the archdiocese of Braga (Portugal); the Summarium prints only the heading line, no content. The protocol is printed with a hyphen, 'CD 1674-83'.
excerpt: Bracarensis, 1 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1674-83).

summary_en: Blessed Joseph De Loor, religious, is inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Passion of Jesus Christ (Passionists) and of the religious institutes using the same calendar, on 6 October each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis Iesu Christi, 4 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 879/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi De Loor, religiosi, quotannis die 6 octobris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda, inseri valeat in Calendarium proprium Congregationis Passionis Iesu Christi necnon Institutorum religiosarum, quae eodem utuntur Calendario.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars

summary_en: St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars is confirmed as patron before God of Ecuador (the dioceses of Ecuador).
excerpt: Aequatoriae dioeceses, 7 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1904/84): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars Patronae apud Deum Aequatoriae.

summary_en: Blessed Joseph De Loor, religious, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Bruges (Belgium), on 6 October each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Brugensis, 11 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1917/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi De Loor, religiosi, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 6 octobris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Blessed Joseph De Loor, religious, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Ghent (Belgium), on 6 October each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Gandavensis, 11 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1960/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi De Loor, religiosi, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 6 octobris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: St Martin of Dumio (of Braga), bishop, is confirmed as patron before God of the archdiocese of Braga (Portugal).
excerpt: Bracarensis, 14 decembris 1984 (Prot. 1675/84): confirmatur electio Sancti Martini Dumensis, episcopi, Patroni apud Deum Archidioecesis Bracarensis.

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary is confirmed as patron before God of the archdiocese of Paraná (Argentina).
excerpt: Paranensis, 18 decembris 1984 (Prot. 1943/84): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario Patronae apud Deum Archidioecesis Paranensis.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the dioceses of Rwanda; the Summarium prints only the heading line, no content.
excerpt: Rwandae dioeceses, 22 decembris 1984 (Prot. CD 1834/84).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Elisabeth a Sanctissima Trinitate, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Elizabeth of the Trinity, virgin, may be inserted into the calendar of the diocese of Dijon (France), on 8 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Divionensis, 15 ianuarii 1985 (Prot. CD 1902/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Elisabeth a Sanctissima Trinitate, virginis, in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Two patrons confirmed in one decree: the Blessed Virgin Mary of Fatima as patron before God of the archdiocese of San Francisco (USA), and St Francis of Assisi as patron before God of the city of San Francisco.
excerpt: Franciscopolitana, 17 ianuarii 1985 (Prot. CD 1968/84): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima Patronae apud Deum dioecesis et Sancti Francisci Assisiensis Patroni apud Deum civitatis v.d. « San Francisco ».

summary_en: The celebration of the Most Holy Name of Jesus is inserted into the proper calendar of the Province of Malta of the Order of Preachers, on 3 January each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Praedicatorum, 18 ianuarii 1985 (Prot. 1982/84): conceditur ut celebratio SS.mi Nominis Iesu in Calendarium proprium Provinciae Melitae eiusdem ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatae Maria Anna Vaillot et Odilia Baumgarten, martyres

summary_en: The liturgical celebration of Blessed Marie-Anne Vaillot and Blessed Odile Baumgarten, martyrs, is inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Mission and of the Daughters of Charity of St Vincent, on 1 February each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionis, 23 ianuarii 1985 (Prot. 197/85): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Mariae Annae Vaillot et Beatae Odiliae Baumgarten, martyrum, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Congregationis necnon Sororum a Caritate S. Vincentii inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 februarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the diocese of Vasto (Italy); the Summarium prints only the heading line. The same protocol and date appear on p. 86 confirming the Latin and Italian texts of the Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours.
excerpt: Vestana, 25 ianuarii 1985 (Prot. CD 571/83).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Divinae Providentiae Mater

summary_en: In the churches of the Institute 'Suore Benedettine della Divina Provvidenza' the titular celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Divine Providence, may be celebrated each year on the Saturday before the Second Sunday in Ordinary Time as a solemnity (movable date, hence month/day null).
excerpt: « Suore Benedettine della Divina Provvidenza », 5 februarii 1985 (Prot. 1920/84): conceditur ut in ecclesiis Instituti celebratio titularis Beatae Mariae Virginis Divinae Providentiae Matris, quotannis sabbato ante dominicam II « per annum » gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes a Faesulis seu Beatus Angelicus, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed John of Fiesole (Fra Angelico), priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Florence (Italy) on 18 February: as an obligatory memorial in the Basilica of San Marco and in the parish church of Vicchio di Mugello, as an optional memorial in the whole archdiocese. Flagged because the grade differs between the two churches and the rest of the archdiocese.

Blessed Marie-Léonie Paradis, virgin, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of Holy Cross, on 4 May each year as an optional memorial; the footnote on p. 149 explains that the same decree transfers her celebration from 3 May to 4 May because of the feast of Sts Philip and James. The same protocol also confirms the texts for her Mass and Office (p. 133).
excerpt: Congregatio a Sancta Cruce, 14 februarii 1985 (Prot. 422/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae Leoniae Paradis, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 4 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Elisabeth a SS. Trinitate, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Elizabeth of the Trinity, virgin, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Order of Discalced Carmelites, on 8 November each year: as a feast in the monastery of Dijon, as an optional memorial in the whole Order.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 18 februarii 1985 (Prot. 454/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Elisabethae a SS. Trinitate, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 novembris in monasterio Divionensi gradu festi, in universo autem Ordine gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Andreas Kim Taegon, presbyter, et Paulus Chong Hasang, et socii, martyres

summary_en: By decree of 12 March 1985, at the mandate of John Paul II, the celebration of Sts Andrew Kim Taegon, priest, Paul Chong Hasang and companions, martyrs (the Korean martyrs, canonised 6 May 1984), is inserted into the General Roman Calendar on 20 September as an obligatory memorial; the decree is printed in full with the covering letter to the presidents of the episcopal conferences, and the Latin Mass and Office texts follow on p. 207. A note on the choice of 20 September (rather than 26 September, already occupied by Sts Cosmas and Damian) is printed in Notitiae 232, p. 588.
excerpt: Instante quidem Episcoporum Coetu Coreano, litteris die 8 aprilis 1984 datis, ut celebratio Sanctorum martyrum Coreae Calendario Romano generali inscriberetur, Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria Sanctorum martyrum Coreae quotannis die 20 septembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae ab omnibus peragatur.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Apuliensis et Molisana

summary_en: For the Province of Apulia and Molise of the Order of Friars Minor: Blessed James Varingez (of Bitetto), religious, may be celebrated on 27 April each year as a feast in the conventual church of Bitetto (Italy) — a single-church concession. The same protocol also confirms the Italian texts of his Mass and Office (p. 192).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Apuliensis et Molisana, 14 martii 1985 (Prot. 543/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iacobi Varingez, religiosi, in ecclesia conventuali loci « Bitetto » nuncupati, quotannis die 27 aprilis gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the diocese of Cesena-Sarsina (Italy); the Summarium prints only the heading line. The same protocol and date on p. 192 confirm the Latin and Italian texts of the Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours.
excerpt: Caesenatensis et Sarsinatensis, 29 martii 1985 (Prot. 1788/85).

target.institute: Institutum Sororum Tertii Ordinis Regularis S. Francisci

celebration.name_latin: Beata Angelina de Montegiove, religiosa ac fundatrix
