summary_en: The Institute of Sisters of the Third Order Regular of St Francis may celebrate Blessed Angelina of Montegiove, religious and foundress, on 14 July each year as a feast. The same protocol also confirms her Mass and Office texts (p. 193).
excerpt: Institutum Sororum Tertii Ordinis Regularis S. Francisci, 29 martii 1985 (Prot. 587/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Angelinae de Montegiove, religiosae ac fundatricis, quotannis die 14 iulii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: For the Roman Province of the Order of the Most Holy Trinity: Blessed Anna Maria Taigi may be celebrated on 9 June each year as a feast in the Roman Basilica of San Crisogono, where her body rests — a single-church concession (Rome, Italy).
excerpt: Ordo SS. Trinitatis, Provincia Romana, 10 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 598/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Annae-Mariae Taigi, in Basilica Romana Sancti Chrysogoni ubi corpus Beatae religiose asservatur, quotannis die 9 iunii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: Blessed André Bessette may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of Holy Cross, on 6 January each year as an optional memorial in the whole Congregation and as a feast in St Joseph's Oratory in Montreal, where his body rests.
excerpt: Congregatio Sanctae Crucis, 12 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 658/85): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Andreae Bessette in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis peragenda die 6 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum in universa Congregatione, gradu vero festi in Sanctuario marianopolitano Sancti Ioseph, ubi corpus eiusdem Beati asservatur.

summary_en: Three celebrations are inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Paderborn (Germany): St Ulrich, bishop, on 4 July, optional memorial; Sts Hathumar and Badurad and Blessed Meinwerk on 9 August, optional memorial; Blessed Pauline von Mallinckrodt, religious, on 30 April, optional memorial. The same protocol (p. 266) confirms the Latin and German Mass texts of these celebrations.
excerpt:
Paderbornensis, 15 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 2001/84): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium Archidioecesis inseri valeat celebratio:
— Sancti Udalrici, episcopi, die 4 iulii, gradu memoriae ad libitum,
— Sanctorum Hathumar et Badurad necnon Beati Meinwerk, die 9 augusti, gradu memoriae ad libitum,
— Beatae Paulinae de Mallinckrodt, religiosae, die 30 aprilis, gradu memoriae ad libitum, quotannis peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Santa Maria del Sasso »

summary_en: In the parish churches of the Casentino area (diocese of Arezzo-Cortona-Sansepolcro, Italy) the evening Mass of the solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary 'Santa Maria del Sasso' may be celebrated each year on 23 June, notwithstanding the solemnity of the Nativity of St John the Baptist which begins that evening — a local observance ruling for one group of parishes.
excerpt: Arretina – Cortonensis – Biturgensis, 19 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 677/85): conceditur ut in ecclesiis paroeciarum loci « Casentino » nuncupati quotannis die 23 iunii celebrari possit Missa vespertina sollemnitatis beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Santa Maria del Sasso », sollemnitate Nativitatis S. Ioannis Baptistae, quae vespere incipit eiusdem diei, haud obstante.

summary_en: Blessed Pauline von Mallinckrodt is inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Sisters of Christian Charity, on 30 April each year as a feast.
excerpt: Congregatio sororum a caritate christiana, 19 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 678/85): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium celebratio Beatae Paulinae Mallinckrodt inseri valeat, quotannis die 30 aprilis gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Francescane missionarie del Cuore Immacolato di Maria

summary_en: Blessed Maria Caterina Troiani, foundress, is inserted into the proper calendar of the Franciscan Missionary Sisters of the Immaculate Heart of Mary, on 6 May each year as a feast.
excerpt: « Francescane missionarie del Cuore Immacolato di Maria », 22 aprilis 1985 (Prot. CD 697/85): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium celebratio liturgica Beatae Catharinae Troiani, fundatricis, inseri valeat, quotannis die 6 maii gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: In the communities of the Order of Friars Minor Conventual situated in the diocese of Padua (Italy), St Leopold Mandić of Castelnovo may be celebrated on 12 May each year as an obligatory memorial; flagged because the concession is limited to the Order's houses in one diocese.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, 24 aprilis 1985 (Prot. 684/85): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Leopoldi Mandic a Castelnovo in communitatibus, quae inveniuntur in dioec. Patavina, quotannis die 12 maii gradu memoriae obbligatoriae peragi valeat.

summary_en: The Order of Canons Regular of St Augustine may celebrate 'The Conversion of our Holy Father Augustine' on 24 April each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Canonicorum Regularium S. Augustini, 13 maii 1985 (Prot. 788/85): conceditur ut celebratio « In conversione Sancti Patris Augustini » quotannis die 24 aprilis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi possit.

summary_en: The institute 'Obreras de La Cruz' may celebrate the Exaltation of the Holy Cross on 14 September and the Blessed Virgin Mary of Sorrows on 15 September each year as solemnities.
excerpt: Obreras de La Cruz, 15 maii 1985 (Prot. 820/85): conceditur ut quotannis, celebrationes in Exaltatione Sanctae Crucis, die 14 septembris, et Beatae Mariae Virginis Perdolentis, die 15 eiusdem mensis, gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeant.

summary_en: Two celebrations are inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Naples (Italy): Blessed Bartolo Longo on 5 October and Blessed Jeremiah of Wallachia on 8 May, both as obligatory memorials.
excerpt: Neapolitana, 15 maii 1985 (Prot. 826/85): conceditur ut celebrationes Beati Bartholomaei Longo et Beati Ieremiae a Valachia in Calendarium proprium Archidioecesis inseri valeant, quotannis die 5 octobris et die 8 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragendae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Peru is approved (Summarium line reads only 'Calendarium proprium'); the same protocol and date on p. 327 confirm the Spanish text of the Proper of Masses. The report of the Lima meeting (Notitiae 228-229, p. 418) records that the calendar and proper Masses were confirmed by the decree of 29 May 1985.
excerpt: Dioeceses Peruviae, 29 maii 1985 (Prot. 1551/84): Calendarium proprium.

target.institute: Congregatio Sororum Servarum Beatae Mariae Virginis « Servas de Maria Ministras de los Enfermos »

summary_en: St Mary Desolata (Soledad Torres Acosta), virgin, is inserted into the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Servants of Mary, Ministers of the Sick, on 11 October each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum Servarum Beatae Mariae Virginis « Servas de Maria Ministras de los Enfermos », 29 maii 1985 (Prot. 898/85): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Mariae Desolatae, virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 11 octobris gradu sollemnitatis peragenda.

summary_en: St Bartholomew, apostle, is confirmed as patron before God of the parish community of Consell, diocese of Majorca (Spain) — a single-parish patron.
excerpt: Maioricensis, 5 iunii 1985 (Prot. 924/85): confirmatur electio Sancti Bartholomaei apostoli Patroni apud Deum communitatis paroecialis loci Consell nuncupati.

summary_en: Blessed Mercedes Molina may be inserted into the proper calendar of Ecuador, on 12 June each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Aequatoria, 11 iunii 1985 (Prot. 932/85): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium Aequatoriae inseri valeat celebratio Beatae Mercedes Molina, die 12 iunii, gradu memoriae ad libitum quotannis peragenda.

summary_en: St Sisenand, deacon and martyr, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Beja (Portugal), on 24 October each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Beiensis, 12 iunii 1985 (Prot. 491/85): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat celebratio Sancti Sisenandi, diaconi et martyris, die 24 octobris, gradu sollemnitatis, quotannis peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Mercedes de Jesús Molina y Ayala, virgo ac fundatrix

summary_en: Blessed Mercedes de Jesús Molina y Ayala, virgin and foundress, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Institute 'Santa Mariana de Jesús', on 12 June each year as a feast.
excerpt: Institutum « Santa Mariana de Jesús », 18 iunii 1985 (Prot. 971/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mercedes de Jesús Molina y Ayala, virginis ac fundatricis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 12 iunii gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Missionarii S. Francisci Salesii de Annecio

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the Missionaries of St Francis de Sales of Annecy; the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Missionarii S. Francisci Salesii de Annecio, 26 iunii 1985 (Prot. 989/85).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, is confirmed as patron before God of the elderly of Colombia — a patron of a category of persons, not of a place.
excerpt: Columbiae dioeceses, 27 iunii 1985 (Prot. 925/85): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars virginis Patronae apud Deum senum Columbiae.

summary_en: Blessed Peter Friedhofen may be inserted into the calendar of the diocese of Trier (Germany), on 23 June each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Trevirensis, 27 iunii 1985 (Prot. 984/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Petri Friedhofen in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 iunii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Blessed Peter Friedhofen may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Brothers of Mercy of Mary Help of Christians, on 23 June each year as a feast.
excerpt: Fratres misericordiae Mariae Auxiliatricis, 27 iunii 1985 (Prot. 995/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Petri Friedhofen in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 iunii gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Hospitalarius S. Ioannis de Deo

summary_en: Blessed Benedetto Menni may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Hospitaller Order of St John of God, on 24 April each year: as a memorial in the churches of the Order, as a feast in the churches of the Congregation 'Suore Ospedaliere del Sacro Cuore di Gesù'.

Particular calendar act for the archdiocese of Montpellier (France); the Summarium prints only the heading line. A line of the same date on p. 489 confirms the French text of the Proper of Masses and Lectionary but prints the protocol as '480/85' (with a garbled 'Prot. 1985 (Prot. 480/85)'), so the two numbers do not match.
excerpt: Mons Pessulanus, 11 iulii 1985 (Prot. CD 480/82).

summary_en: The Institute of the Missionaries of Mary Mediatrix may celebrate the Blessed Virgin Mary Mediatrix each year on 8 May (no grade printed).
excerpt: Institutum Missionariarum Mariae Mediatricis, 29 iulii 1985 (Prot. 1026/85): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Mediatricis quotannis die 8 maii peragi possit.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the archdiocese of Udine (Italy); the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Utinensis, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 1039/85).

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the diocese of Concordia-Pordenone (Italy); the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Concordiensis - Portus Naonis, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 1059/85).

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the archdiocese of Gorizia (Italy); the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Goritiensis-Gradiscana, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 1065/85).

celebration.name_latin: In Dedicatione Basilicae sacri Conventus Montis Senarii

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Order of Servants of Mary the anniversary of the Dedication of the Basilica of the Convent of Monte Senario may be transferred from 20 September to 22 September.
excerpt: Ordo Servorum Mariae, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 1094/85): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio anniversaria in Dedicatione Basilicae sacri Conventus Montis Senarii a die 20 septembris ad diem 22 eiusdem mensis transferri valeat.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the ecclesiastical region of Umbria (Italy), a group of dioceses below the national level; the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Italiae regio Umbria, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 353/84).

summary_en: Blessed Marie-Léonie Paradis, virgin, is confirmed as patron before God of the archdiocese of Sherbrooke (Canada).
excerpt: Sherbrookensis, 30 iulii 1985 (Prot. 417/85): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Leoniae Paradis, virginis, Patronae apud Deum eiusdem Archidioecesis.

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Santa Fe (Argentina) the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'de Guadalupe', titular and patron of the archdiocese, may be kept each year on the Saturday before the Second Sunday of Easter as a solemnity (movable date, hence month/day null).
excerpt: Sancta Fides in Argentina, 3 augusti 1985 (Prot. 472/85): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « de Guadalupe », titularis et patronae archidioecesis, quotannis sabbato ante dominicam II Paschae gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the dioceses of Angola and São Tomé (a two-nation episcopal conference, hence nation null); the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Angola et Sanctus Thoma, 5 augusti 1985 (Prot. 1773/84).

summary_en: Blessed Caterina Troiani may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Church of Ferentino (Italy), on 6 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ferentina, 6 augusti 1985 (Prot. 1147/84): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Catharinae Troiani in Calendarium Proprium Ecclesiae Ferentinae inseri valeat, quotannis die 6 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: St Teresa of Jesus is confirmed as patron before God of the city and municipality of Lanús, diocese of Lomas de Zamora (Argentina) — a civic (city) patron.
excerpt: Clivus Zamoerensis, 10 septembris 1985 (Prot. 1215/85): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Patronae apud Deum civitatis et municipii v. d. « Lanus ».

summary_en: St Francis of Assisi is confirmed as patron before God of the association 'Krippenfreunde' (friends of the crib) in the dioceses of Austria — a patron of an association, not of a place.
excerpt: Austriae dioeceses, 10 septembris 1985 (Prot. 526/85): confirmatur electio Sancti Francisci Assisiensis Patroni apud Deum consociationis v. d. « Krippenfreunde ».

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1985: the faculty to celebrate the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 December 1985, the Second Sunday of Advent, is left to the prudent pastoral judgement of the Italian Episcopal Conference.
excerpt: Decreta generalia, 13 septembris 1985 (Prot. 1255/85): prudenti iudicio pastorali Conferentiae Episcoporum remittitur facultas celebrandi Immaculatam Conceptionem beatae Mariae Virginis die 8 decembris 1985, dominica secunda Adventus.

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the dioceses of Australia the feast of St Mark, evangelist, may be transferred from 25 April to 26 April.
excerpt: Australiae dioeceses, 18 septembris 1985 (Prot. 1191/85): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio dioecesium Australiae celebratio festi S. Marci, evangelistae, a die 25 ad diem 26 aprilis transferri valeat.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1985: the faculty to celebrate the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary on 8 December 1985, the Second Sunday of Advent, is left to the prudent pastoral judgement of the Episcopal Conference of the Philippines.
excerpt: Die 24 septembris 1985 (Prot. 1305/85): prudenti iudicio pastorali Conferentiae Episcoporum remittitur facultas celebrandi Immaculatam Conceptionem beatae Mariae Virginis die 8 decembris 1985, dominica secunda Adventus.

summary_en: In the dioceses of Portugal the celebration of the Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary may be kept each year on the Saturday after the Second Sunday after Pentecost as an obligatory memorial (movable date, hence month/day null).
excerpt: Lusitaniae dioeceses, 25 septembris 1985 (Prot. 1204/84): conceditur ut, quotannis, celebratio Immaculati Cordis beatae Mariae Virginis, sabbato post dominicam II post Pentecosten, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

summary_en: In the diocese of San Luis (Argentina) the celebration of St Louis, king, patron of the diocese, may be kept each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Sanctus Ludovicus in Argentina, 2 octobris 1985 (Prot. 1292/85): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Ludovici, regis, dioecesis Patroni, quotannis gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

summary_en: Particular calendar act for the diocese 'Portus Magnus' (taken to be Portsmouth, England, hence GB — inferred); the Summarium prints only the heading line.
excerpt: Portus Magnus, 14 octobris 1985 (Prot. 1179/85).

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Order of Friars Minor Capuchin the celebration of Blessed Felix of Nicosia may be transferred from 31 May to 29 May, kept each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 25 octobris 1985 (Prot. 1324/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Felicis a Nicosia in Calendario proprio a die 31 maii ad diem 29 maii transferri valeat, quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Order of Friars Minor Capuchin the celebration of Blessed Diego of Cadiz may be transferred from 30 March to 5 January, kept each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Eodem die (Prot. 1326/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Didaci a Cadice in Calendario proprio a die 30 martii ad diem 5 ianuarii transferri valeat, quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Genoa (Italy) the celebration of Blessed Virginia Centurione Bracelli may be transferred from 15 December to 22 December, kept each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ianuensis, 25 octobris 1985 (Prot. 1339/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Verginiae Centurione Bracelli in Calendario proprio Archidioecesis a die 15 decembris ad diem 22 decembris transferri valeat, quotannis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: Blessed Juan del Castillo, priest, is confirmed as patron before God of those engaged in the missionary service of the diocese of Cuenca (Spain) — a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Conchensis, 16 novembris 1985 (Prot. 1447/85): confirmatur electio Beati Ioannis del Castillo, presbyteri, Patroni apud Deum eorum qui servitio missionali dioecesis Conchensis dant operam.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Congregation of Parish Cooperators of Christ the King recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Congregatio Cooperatorum Paroecialium Christi Regis, 29 novembris 1985 (Prot. 1422/85).

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the diocese of Bergamo (Italy) the celebration of Blessed Paola Elisabetta Cerioli may be transferred from 30 July to 23 January.
excerpt: Bergomensis, 30 novembris 1985 (Prot. 1371/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Paulae Elisabeth Cerioli in Calendario proprio Dioecesis a die 30 iulii ad diem 23 ianuarii transferri valeat.

target.institute: Congregatio a Sacra Familia - Institutum Sororum a Sacra Familia

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Congregation of the Holy Family and of the Institute of the Sisters of the Holy Family (of Bergamo) the celebration of Blessed Paola Elisabetta Cerioli may be transferred from 30 July to 23 January.
excerpt: Congregatio a Sacra Familia - Institutum Sororum a Sacra Familia, 30 novembris 1985 (Prot. 1545/85): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio Congregationis et Instituti celebratio Beatae Paulae Elisabeth Cerioli a die 30 iulii ad diem 23 ianuarii transferri valeat.

summary_en: The parishes of the diocese of Bergamo (Italy) which by immemorial custom follow the Ambrosian rite may use the calendar of that rite, with the celebrations proper to the diocese of Bergamo added — a ruling on which calendar a group of parishes follows.
excerpt: Eodem die (Prot. 1559/85): conceditur ut in paroeciis eiusdem dioecesis, quae pro celebrationibus liturgicis Ritum Ambrosianum ab immemorabili sequuntur, adhiberi valeat Calendarium istius Ritus, additis autem celebrationibus quae sunt propriae dioecesis Bergomensis.

summary_en: The election of Saint Maximilian Mary Kolbe as patron before God of the radio amateurs of Argentina is confirmed (patron of a category of persons).
excerpt: Argentina, 4 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1725/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Maximiliani Mariae Kolbe Patroni apud Deum Radioamatorum Nationis Argentinae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Perpetuo Succursu

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Virgen del perpetuo Socorro' as patroness before God of the diocese of Arecibo (Puerto Rico) is confirmed.
excerpt: Arecibensis, 10 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1516/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Virgen del perpetuo Socorro » Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Arecibensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'de Monte Carmelo' as patroness before God of the Venezuelan Army is confirmed (patron of the armed forces).
excerpt: Venetiola, 10 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1574/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « de Monte Carmelo » Patronae apud Deum Exercitus Venetiolani.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Lauretana' as patroness before God of the Venezuelan Air Force is confirmed (patron of the armed forces).
excerpt: Eodem die (Prot. 1575/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Lauretanae » Patronae apud Deum militum Aëriae Classis Venetiolanae.

summary_en: The diocese of Cremona (Italy) may inscribe either the Blessed Virgin Mary 'de Caravagio' or Saint Homobonus in its proper calendar with the title of principal patron, notwithstanding n. 31 of the Instruction on particular calendars and n. 5 of 'De Patronis constituendis'; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Cremonensis, 11 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1584/85): conceditur ut sive beata Maria Virgo « de Caravagio » sive Sanctus Homobonus in Calendario proprio dioecesis titulo « Patroni principalis » inscribi possint, normis n. 31 Instructionis « De Calendariis particularibus atque Officiorum et Missarum Propriis recognoscendis » et n. 5 « De Patronis constituendis » haud obstantibus.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Pius a S. Aloisio Campidelli

summary_en: The Congregation of the Passion may insert the celebration of Blessed Pius of St Aloysius Campidelli into its proper calendar, on 3 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis, 12 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1205/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Pii a S. Aloisio Campidelli in Calendarium proprium Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Missionary Sisters of the Kingship of Our Lord Jesus Christ (D.N.I.C.) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol and the page ends there, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Sorores Missionariae Regalitatis D.N.I.C., 12 decembris 1985 (Prot. 483/85).

summary_en: The Society of Jesus may insert three celebrations into its proper calendar, each as an optional memorial: Blessed Diego de San Vitores, priest and martyr, 6 October; Blessed José María Rubio, priest, 4 May; Blessed Francisco Gárate, religious, 10 September.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Succursu (Nuestra Señora del Socorro)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora del Socorro' as patroness before God of the city and archdiocese of Valencia (Venezuela) is confirmed; the same protocol is listed again in Notitiae 238 p. 321 with the date 13 February 1986 and the wording 'dioecesis Valentinae', so the date of the act is uncertain.
excerpt: Valentina in Venetiola, 7 ianuarii 1986 (Prot. 1525/85): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Socorro » civitatis et archidioecesis apud Deum Patronae.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, Provinciae in Gallia

summary_en: The two Provinces in France of the Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Frances d'Amboise, religious, into their proper calendar, on 5 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, Provinciae in Gallia, 28 ianuarii 1986 (Prot. 221/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Franciscae Amboise, religiosae, in Calendarium proprium duarum Provinciarum eiusdem Ordinis in Gallia inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel (Carmelites) may insert three celebrations into its proper calendar, each as an optional memorial: Blessed Mary of Jesus Crucified (Bouardy), virgin, 25 August; Blessed Raphael of St Joseph (Kalinowski), priest, 19 November; Blessed Elizabeth of the Trinity (Catez), virgin, 8 November.

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio S. Crucis de Cono Sur

summary_en: In the monasteries of the Benedictine Congregation of the Holy Cross of the Southern Cone, and in the monasteries of the nuns associated with it, the titular celebration of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross may be kept on 14 September each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio S. Crucis de Cono Sur, 7 februarii 1986 (Prot. 259/86): conceditur ut in monasteriis Congregationis necnon in monasteriis Sororum quae ipsi Congregationi sociantur, celebratio titularis « In exaltatione Sanctae Crucis » quotannis die 14 septembris gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Saint Angelus, priest, into its proper calendar, on 5 May each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 12 februarii 1986 (Prot. 167/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Angeli, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 maii gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Familiae Franciscales (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.), Provinciae Flandriae

summary_en: The Franciscan families (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.) of the Province of Flanders may insert some changes (not specified on the page) into their proper Franciscan calendar.
excerpt: Familiae Franciscales (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.), Provinciae Flandriae, 14 februarii 1986 (Prot. 195/86): conceditur ut aliquae immutationes in Calendarium Franciscanum Proprium inseri valeant.

target.institute: Sorores Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Provinciae Quebecensis, Abbatia « Sainte-Marie-des-deux-montagnes »

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Benedictine Sisters of the Province of Quebec, Abbey of Sainte-Marie-des-deux-montagnes (Canada), recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Sorores Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Provinciae Quebecensis, Abbatia « Sainte-Marie-des-deux-montagnes », 14 februarii 1986 (Prot. 216/86).

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Ioseph, Sponsus beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: The election of Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as patron before God of the diocese of Rivera (Uruguay) is confirmed.
excerpt: Rivoriensis, 17 februarii 1986 (Prot. 246/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Iosephi, Sponsi beatae Mariae Virginis, in Patronum apud Deum dioecesis Rivoriensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo (Nossa Senhora do Carmo)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora do Carmo' as patroness before God of the soldiers of the public security force called 'Guarda Nacional Republicana' in the dioceses of Portugal is confirmed (patron of an armed force).
excerpt: Lusitaniae dioeceses, 26 februarii 1986 (Prot. 321/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora do Carmo » in Patronam apud Deum militum a publica tutela qui « Guarda Nacional Republicana » nuncupantur.

summary_en: The election of Saint Anthony Mary Gianelli, bishop, as patron before God of the parish community of Carro, in the diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy), is confirmed (a single parish).
excerpt: Spediensis - Sarzanensis - Brugnatensis, 4 martii 1986 (Prot. 316/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Antonii Mariae Gianelli, episcopi, communitatis paroecialis Carrensis Patroni apud Deum.

summary_en: The dioceses of Australia may celebrate the Mass called 'Anzac day' every year on 25 April; a fixed-date Mass rather than a graded celebration, so the grade is left null.
excerpt: Australiae dioeceses, 12 martii 1986 (Prot. 1191/86): conceditur ut Missa pro « Anzac day » nuncupata quotannis die 25 aprilis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: The liturgical celebration of Blessed John of St Martha, priest and martyr, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Church of Tarragona (Spain), on 16 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Tarraconensis, 15 martii 1986 (Prot. 374/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Ioannis a Sancta Martha, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Tarraconensis inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Congregation of the Sisters of St Felix recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum a Sancto Felice, 18 martii 1986 (Prot. 367/86).

summary_en: The election of Saint Mary Magdalene as patroness before God of the village called Walleshausen, in the diocese of Augsburg (Germany), is confirmed (a single locality).
excerpt: Augustana Vindelicorum, 21 martii 1986 (Prot. 673/86): confirmatur electio Sanctae Mariae Magdalenae pagi « Walleshausen » nuncupati apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Benedictine Subiaco monasteries recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol; the same protocol appears on p. 318 as the confirmation of the Latin and Italian text of their Proper of the Liturgy of the Hours, so the calendar act may be part of that decree.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Monasteria Sublacensia, 21 martii 1986 (Prot. 978/85).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Titus Brandsma, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Blessed Titus Brandsma, priest and martyr, into its proper calendar on 27 July each year: as an optional memorial in the churches of the Order, and as an obligatory memorial in the churches of the Order's Dutch Province.
A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Cremona (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Cremonensis, 26 martii 1986 (Prot. 1583/85).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception as patroness before God of the diocese of Tampico (Mexico) is confirmed.
excerpt: Tampicensis, 3 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 243/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis Patronae apud Deum eiusdem dioecesis.

summary_en: The Congregation 'Opera Matris Orphanorum' may insert into its proper calendar the celebrations of Saint Jerome Emiliani on 8 February and of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Orphans, on 27 September, each as a solemnity (one line covers this institute and the Missionary Daughters of St Jerome Emiliani, Prot. 499/86).
excerpt: Congregatio « Opera Matris Orphanorum », 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 498/86) - Missionariae Filiae S. Hieronymi Emiliani, 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 499/86): conceditur ut celebrationes Sancti Hieronymi Emiliani, die 8 februarii, necnon beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Orphanorum, die 27 septembris, in Calendaria propria inseri valeant, quotannis gradu sollemnitatis peragendae.

summary_en: The Missionary Daughters of St Jerome Emiliani may insert into their proper calendar the celebrations of Saint Jerome Emiliani on 8 February and of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Orphans, on 27 September, each as a solemnity (one line covers this institute and the Congregation 'Opera Matris Orphanorum', Prot. 498/86).
excerpt: Congregatio « Opera Matris Orphanorum », 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 498/86) - Missionariae Filiae S. Hieronymi Emiliani, 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 499/86): conceditur ut celebrationes Sancti Hieronymi Emiliani, die 8 februarii, necnon beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Orphanorum, die 27 septembris, in Calendaria propria inseri valeant, quotannis gradu sollemnitatis peragendae.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Blessed Cyriac Elias Chavara, priest, into its proper calendar, on 3 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 25 aprilis 1986 Prot. 492/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Cyriaci Eliae Chavara, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Trieste (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Tergestina, 29 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 480/85).

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Nola (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol; a text confirmation for Nola of the same date is listed on p. 386 under Prot. 1355/85, so the calendar act may belong to that decree and one of the two protocol numbers may be a misprint.
excerpt: Nolana, 2 maii 1986 (Prot. 1335/86).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, sub titulo Visitationis

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Visitation as patroness before God of the members of the Pontifical Institute of Sacred Music (Rome) is confirmed (patron of an institution's members, not of a territory).
excerpt: Pontificium Institutum Musicae Sacrae, 6 maii 1986 (Prot. 1540/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo Visitationis, sodalium eiusdem Pontificii Instituti apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' as patroness before God of the public security officers of the Principality of Andorra is confirmed (patron of a category of persons).
excerpt: Andurensis Principatus, 14 maii 1986 (Prot. 559/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum » in Patronam apud Deum ministrorum publicae securitatis Andurensis Principatus.

target.institute: Societas Presbyterorum SS.mi Cordis Iesu de Betharram

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria a Iesu Crucifixo, virgo

summary_en: The Society of Priests of the Sacred Heart of Jesus of Bétharram may insert the celebration of Blessed Mary of Jesus Crucified, virgin, into its proper calendar, on 25 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Societas Presbyterorum SS.mi Cordis Iesu de Betharram, 17 maii 1986 (Prot. 609/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae a Iesu Crucifixo, virginis, in Calendarium proprium Societatis inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Two variations are introduced into the proper calendar of the diocese of Luçon (France): the celebration of the Blessed Martyrs of the diocese of Angers is inserted on 1 February as an optional memorial, and the celebration of Saint Henri Dorie, priest and martyr, is transferred from 8 March to 20 September as an obligatory memorial together with the other Korean martyr companions.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception as patroness before God of the nation of Equatorial Guinea is confirmed.
excerpt: Guinea Aequatorialis, 26 maii 1986 (Prot. 1596/83): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis in Patronam apud Deum Nationis Guineae Aequatorialis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Virgen Bisila »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Virgen Bisila' as patroness before God of the archdiocese of Malabo (Equatorial Guinea) is confirmed.
excerpt: Malaboënsis, 26 maii 1986 (Prot. 603/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v. g. « Virgen Bisila » in Patronam apud Deum Archidioecesis Malaboënsis.

target.institute: Moniales Passionis Iesu Christi in Archidioecesi Ianuensi

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « della Guardia »

summary_en: The Passionist Nuns in the archdiocese of Genoa (Italy) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'della Guardia' into the proper calendar of their monastery, on 29 August each year as a feast, the memorial of the Passion of St John the Baptist being transferred to the following day, 30 August.
excerpt: Moniales Passionis Iesu Christi in Archidioecesi Ianuensi, 31 maii 1986 (Prot. 665/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « della Guardia » in Calendarium proprium eiusdem monasterii inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 augusti gradu festi peragenda, memoria autem « in Passione S. Ioannis Baptistae » ad sequentem diem 30 augusti translata.

target.institute: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris Dei Scholarum Piarum

summary_en: The Order of Clerics Regular of the Poor of the Mother of God of the Pious Schools (Piarists) may transfer the celebration of the feast of the Most Holy Name of the Blessed Virgin Mary in its proper calendar from 8 May to 12 September; the printed protocol 673/86 is also carried by the Augsburg patron confirmation of 21 March 1986 (Notitiae 238 p. 320), so one of the two numbers is probably a misprint.
excerpt: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris De Scholarum Piarum, 31 maii 1986 (Prot. 673/86): conceditur ut celebratio festi Sanctissimi Nominis beatae Mariae Virginis in Calendario proprio eiusdem Ordinis a die 8 maii ad diem 12 septembris transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris Dei Scholarum Piarum

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Mater Dei Scholarum Piarum, Patrona Ordinis

summary_en: The Piarists may celebrate the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God of the Pious Schools, Patroness of the Order, on 8 May each year as a feast.
excerpt: Die 5 iunii 1986 (Prot. 672/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Die Scholarum Piarum, Patronae Ordinis, quotannis die 8 maii gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: The optional memorial of Blessed José María Rubio, inscribed on 4 May in the proper calendar of the Society of Jesus, may be transferred to 5 May.
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 16 iunii 1986 (Prot. 713/86): conceditur ut memoria ad libitum Beati Iosephi M. Rubio, in Calendario proprio die 4 maii inscripta, ad diem 5 maii transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the liturgical celebration of Blessed Titus Brandsma into its proper calendar, on 27 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 16 iunii 1986 (Prot. 714/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Titi Brandsma in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 27 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora de los dolores gloriosos' and of Saint Francis Borgia as patrons before God of the parish community of Our Lady's Nativity in Turís, archdiocese of Valencia (Spain), is confirmed (a single parish; two patrons named).
excerpt: Valentina, 16 iunii 1986 (Prot. 715/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de los dolores gloriosos » et Sancti Francisci de Borja in Patronos apud Deum communitatis paroecialis Nativitatis Dominae Nostrae in loco v. d. « Turís ».

summary_en: In the diocese of Eisenstadt (Austria) the memorials of Saint Leopold, Margrave of Austria, and of Saint Stephen, King of Hungary, may henceforth be celebrated as obligatory memorials on the days assigned to them in the calendar, because of the special devotion paid to these two saints there since ancient times.
excerpt: Sideropolitana, 24 iunii 1986 (Prot. 738/86): conceditur ut memoria Sancti Leopoldi Marchionis Austriae necnon memoria Sancti Stephani Hungariae Regis, ob peculiarem cultum his duobus Sanctis ab antiquis iam temporibus a fidelibus tributum, diebus in Calendario illis assignatis, in posterum gradu memoriae obligatoriae in dioecesi celebrari possint.

target.institute: Moniales Benedictinae ab adoratione perpetua SS. Sacramenti, Foederatio gallica

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Maximilianus Maria Kolbe, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The Benedictine Nuns of Perpetual Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament, French Federation, may insert the celebration of Saint Maximilian Mary Kolbe, priest and martyr, into their proper calendar, on 14 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Moniales Benedictinae ab adoratione perpetua SS. Sacramenti, Foederatio gallica, 2 iulii 1986 (Prot. 757/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Maximiliani Mariae Kolbe, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Foederationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 14 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo SS. Salvatoris v. S. Birgittae

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Order of the Most Holy Saviour of St Bridget recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Ordo SS. Salvatoris v. S. Birgittae, 4 iulii 1986 (Prot. 607/86).

target.institute: Moniales Clarissae, Foederatio Magnae Britanniae et Hiberniae

summary_en: The Poor Clare Nuns of the Federation of Great Britain and Ireland may insert the celebration of St Francis receiving the Stigmata into the Federation's proper calendar, on 17 September each year as a feast; the Federation spans two nations (GB and IE), so nation is left null.
excerpt: Moniales Clarissae, Foederatio Magnae Britanniae et Hiberniae, 8 iulii 1986 (Prot. 777/86): conceditur ut celebratio S. Francisci in Impressione Stigmatum in Calendarium proprium Foederationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 17 septembris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: Variations are granted for the proper calendar of the Franciscan families of Poland: 7 May Bl. Jeremiah of Wallachia, religious, optional memorial; 15 May St Margaret of Cortona, memorial; 23 May Dedication of the Basilica of St Francis in Assisi, feast; 14 July Sts John Jones and John Wall, martyrs (First Order), optional memorial; 14 July Bl. Angelina of Marsciano (Third Order), memorial; 2 September Bl. Beatrice da Silva, optional memorial; 15 November St Didacus of Alcalá, optional memorial.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia S. Petri martyris

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Dominican Province of St Peter Martyr the celebration of Blessed Joan of Aza, mother of St Dominic, kept as an optional memorial, may be transferred from 2 to 3 August.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia S. Petri martyris, 22 iulii 1986 (Prot. 769/86): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio eiusdem Provinciae celebratio Beatae Ioannae de Aza, sancti Dominici matris, quae gradu memoriae ad libitum peragitur, a die 2 ad diem 3 mensis augusti transferri possit.

summary_en: The celebration of Saint Gumbert, bishop and abbot, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Würzburg (Germany), on 15 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Herbipolensis, 25 iulii 1986 (Prot. 776/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Gumberti, episcopi et abbatis, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 15 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Octavianus, Avventor ac Solutor, martyres

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Turin (Italy) the liturgical celebration of Saints Octavius, Adventor and Solutor may be transferred from 20 November to 20 January.
excerpt: Taurinensis, 5 augusti 1986 (Prot. 841/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Sanctorum Octaviani, Avventoris ac Solutoris a die 20 novembris ad diem 20 ianuarii transferri possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes de Faesulis seu Beatus Angelicus, presbyter

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed John of Fiesole (Fra Angelico), priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Fiesole (Italy), on 18 February each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Fesulana, 3 septembris 1986 (Prot. 889/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioannis de Faesulis seu Beati Angelici, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 18 februarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum »

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Asidonia-Jerez (Spain), on 24 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Assidonensis-Ierezensis, 11 septembris 1986 (Prot. 911/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Societas Divini Salvatoris – Congregatio sororum Divini Salvatoris

summary_en: The Society of the Divine Saviour and the Congregation of the Sisters of the Divine Saviour may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of Apostles, into their proper calendar, to be kept each year on the first Saturday after the Ascension of the Lord as a feast (movable date, so month/day are null).
excerpt: Societas Divini Salvatoris – Congregatio sororum Divini Salvatoris, 15 septembris 1986 (Prot. 355/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Reginae Apostolorum in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis primo sabbato post Ascensionem Domini gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Maria a Cruce Manetti, virgo

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Maria of the Cross Manetti, virgin, into its proper calendar, on 23 April each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 21 octobris 1986 (Prot. 992/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Mariae a Cruce Manetti, virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum »

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Huelva (Spain), on 24 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Onubensis, 23 octobris 1986 (Prot. 1033/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum », in Calendarium proprium dioecesis Onubensis inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Norms of the Congregation for Divine Worship (dated 25 October 1986, no protocol printed) on the proper liturgical celebrations of the Italian dioceses united by decree n. 971/85 of the Congregation for Bishops of 30 September 1986: the anniversary of the dedication of the cathedral is a solemnity in the cathedral and a feast in the whole diocese, that of the concathedral a solemnity only in the concathedral; the principal patrons of the former dioceses become patrons of the new diocese and are celebrated with the same grade; other proper celebrations continue in the former territories with the same grade; the bishop is to draw up a new proper calendar per the Instruction Calendaria particularia n. 20.
excerpt: Secondo quanto stabilito nel Decreto della Congregazione per i Vescovi, i Patroni delle diocesi precedenti diventano Patroni della nuova diocesi. [...] Le altre celebrazioni proprie continueranno ad aver luogo nei territori delle precedenti diocesi, con lo stesso grado che avevano nel rispettivo calendario particolare.

target.institute: Oblatae Benedictinae Monasterii « La paix Notre-Dame à Flée »

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Quercu (« Notre-Dame du chêne »)

summary_en: The Benedictine Oblates of the monastery 'La paix Notre-Dame' at Flée (France) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary of the Oak ('Notre-Dame du chêne') into the monastery's proper calendar, on 1 September each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Oblatae Benedictinae Monasterii « La paix Notre-Dame à Flée », 14 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1086/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis a Quercu v.d. « Notre-Dame du chêne » in Calendarium proprium monasterii inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 septembris gradu memoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of Peace, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Warmia (Poland), on 1 September each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Varmiensis, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 613/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis, Reginae Pacis, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 septembris gradu memoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The election of Saint Joseph, spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as principal patron before God of the diocese of San Jose in California (USA), and of Saint Clare of Assisi as secondary patroness, is confirmed (two patrons named).
excerpt: Sanctus Ioseph in California, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 736/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Ioseph, beatae Mariae Virginis sponsi, dioecesis apud Deum Patroni principalis, atque Sanctae Clarae Assisiensis Patronae secundariae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Auxilium Christianorum (« Auxiliadora de los cristianos »)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Auxiliadora de los cristianos' as patroness before God of the diocese of Punta Arenas (Chile) is confirmed.
excerpt: Punta Arenas, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 865/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxiliadora de los cristianos » dioecesis apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Fidenza (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol; the same protocol and date appear on p. 957 as the confirmation of the Italian text of the diocese's Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours, so the calendar act may be part of that decree.
excerpt: Fidentina, 18 novembris 1986 (Prot. 985/86).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Cyriac Elias Chavara, priest, into its proper calendar, on 3 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Die 28 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1134/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Cyriaci Eliae Chavara, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Clifton (England) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the English text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 27).
excerpt: Cliftoniensis, 29 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1696/84).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Setefilla »

summary_en: Archdiocese of Seville (Spain): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora de Setefilla' as patroness before God of the town of Lora del Río and of the neighbouring places is confirmed; a local (town) patron, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Hispalensis, 5 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1175/86): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Setefilla » civitatis vulgo dictae Lora del Rio et locorum propinquorum apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: The election of Blessed John Grande, religious, as patron before God of the diocese of Asidonia-Jerez (Spain) is confirmed.
excerpt: Assidonensis-Ierezensis, 10 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1097/86): confirmatur electio beati Ioannis Grande, religiosi, apud Deum Patroni dioecesis Assidonensis-Ierezensis.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the united dioceses of Viterbo, Tuscania, Civita Castellana, Acquapendente and Bagnoregio (Italy) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Viterbiensis-Tuscanensis-Faliscodunensis-Aquipendiensis-Balneoregiensis, 12 decembris 1986 (Prot. 793/86).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the dioceses of Ecuador is approved (bare line under 'Calendaria particularia'); the same protocol confirms the Spanish translation of the Proprium Missarum (p. 26).
excerpt: Aequatoriae Dioeceses, 12 decembris 1986 (Prot. 862/86).

summary_en: The diocese of Minorca (Spain) may insert into its proper calendar the celebrations of St Catherine Thomas, virgin, on 28 July and of Blessed Raymond Llull on 27 November, both as memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out. The same protocol confirms the Latin, Catalan and Spanish texts of the Proprium (p. 28).
excerpt: Minoricensis, 15 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1070/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Catharinae Thomas, virginis, die 28 iulii, et celebratio beati Raimundi Llull, die 27 novembris, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant, quotannis, gradu memoriae peragendae.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, Provincia « Our Lady of Consolation » in Statibus Unitis Americae

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Conventual Franciscan Province 'Our Lady of Consolation' (United States) the feast of the Blessed Virgin Mary Consoler of the Afflicted, patroness of the Province, is transferred from 1 October to 25 May.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Conventualium, 17 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1208/86): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio Provinciae “Our Lady of Consolation” in Statibus Unitis Americae celebratio Festi Beatae Mariae Virginis Consolatricis Afflictorum, eiusdem Provinciae Patronae, a die primo octobris ad diem vicesimum quintum maii transferri valeat.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Bari (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and Italian texts of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 28).
excerpt: Barensis, 18 decembris 1986 (Prot. 438/86).

summary_en: Diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy): the election of St Leopold Mandić, priest, as patron before God of the parish community of St Paul in the city of La Spezia is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Spediensis-Sarzanensis-Brugnatensis, 19 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1214/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Leopoldi Mandic, presbyteri, communitatis paroecialis Sancti Pauli in civitate Spediensi Patroni apud Deum.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Clementina Nengapeta Anuarite, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The dioceses of Zaire may insert into the national proper calendar the celebration of Blessed Marie-Clementine Nengapeta Anuarite, virgin and martyr, on 1 December each year with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Dioeceses Zairenses, 19 decembris 1986 (Prot. 1219/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Clementinae Nengapeta Anuarite, virginis et martyris in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Nationis inseri valeat quotannis die 1 decembris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Aachen (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar St Arnold on 18 July and Blessed Pauline von Mallinckrodt, virgin, on 30 April, both as optional memorials, and may transfer the celebration of St Benedict of Aniane, abbot, from 12 to 11 February; three celebrations named, so none singled out. The same protocol confirms the German text of the collect and second reading for St Arnold (p. 170).
excerpt: Aquisgranensis, 10 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 187/87): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant sequentes celebrationes: — Sancti Arnoldi, quotannis die 18 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda; — Beatae Paulinae de Mallinckrodt, virginis, quotannis die 30 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda. Conceditur etiam ut celebratio Sancti Benedicti Anianensis, abbatis, a die 12 ad diem 11 mensis februarii transferri possit.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of San Jose in California (United States) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Sanctus Iosephus in California, 11 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1101/86).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Forlì-Bertinoro (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and Italian texts of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 170).
excerpt: Foroliviensis-Brittinoriensis, 13 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1129/86).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nossa Senhora das Dores »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora das Dores' as patroness before God of the diocese of Limeira (Brazil) is confirmed.
excerpt: Limeirensis, 13 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 1181/86): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora das Dores » apud Deum Patronae dioecesis Limeirensis.

summary_en: For five years, in the sanctuary of the Abbey of Montevergine (Italy), on 24 June First Vespers of the solemnity of St William, abbot, may be celebrated in place of Second Vespers of the solemnity of the Nativity of St John the Baptist; an occurrence ruling for one sanctuary, five-year term.
excerpt: Abbatia Montisvirginis, 17 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 236/87): conceditur ad quinquennium ut in sanctuario Abbatiae Montisvirginis die 24 iunii celebrari possint Vesperae I sollemnitatis Sancti Gulielmi, abbatis, loco Vesperarum II sollemnitatis « In nativitate Sancti Ioannis Baptistae ».

summary_en: Colombia: the election of St Gabriel the Archangel as patron before God of the soldiers of the Colombian army assigned to the Telecommunications corps is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Columbia, 31 ianuarii 1987 (Prot. 279/87): confirmatur electio Sancti Gabrielis Archangeli Patroni apud Deum militum ex Columbiano exercitu ordini Telecommunicationum addictorum.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Dominae Nostrae Vulneratae »

summary_en: Archdiocese of Split-Makarska (Yugoslavia, today Croatia): in the church-sanctuary of St Peter the Apostle in the city of Split the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Our Wounded Lady' may be kept on 23 January each year with the rank of feast; a single church, hence level 'other'. The same protocol confirms the Latin and Croatian texts of the Mass and Office (p. 214).
excerpt: Spalatensis - Macarscensis, 14 februarii 1987 (Prot. 891/86): conceditur ut in ecclesia-sanctuario Sancti Petri apostoli, in civitate Spalatensi exstructa, celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Dominae Nostre Vulneratae » quotannis die 23 ianuarii gradu festi peragi possit.

summary_en: The Salesians of Don Bosco may celebrate Blesseds Louis Versiglia, bishop, and Callistus Caravario, priest, martyrs, as an obligatory memorial, and may insert St Leonard Murialdo, priest, into the proper calendar of the Society on 19 May as an optional memorial; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Societas Sancti Francisci Salesii, 4 martii 1987 (Prot. 388/87): conceditur ut: — celebratio Beatorum Aloisii Versiglia, episcopi, et Callisti Caravario, presbyteri, martyrum, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi possit; — celebratio Sancti Leonardi Murialdo, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Societatis inseri valeat, quotannis die 19 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: One-year ruling for 1987 only: in the archdiocese of Bari-Bitonto (Italy), in which the ninth centenary of the translation of St Nicholas from Myra to Bari is solemnly commemorated, the celebration of the Translation may be kept on 9 May 1987 with the rank of solemnity.
excerpt: Barensis - Bituntina, 21 martii 1987 (Prot. 553/87): conceditur ut vertente hoc anno 1987, in quo IX expletum saeculum a Translatione e Myra ad Barium Sancti Nicolai episcopi sollemniter commemoratur, celebratio liturgica ipsius Translationis die 9 maii anni 1987 proxime venturo gradu sollemnitatis peragi possit.

target.institute: Congregatio Sororum S. Augustini in Polonia

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Congregation of the Sisters of St Augustine in Poland is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum S. Augustini in Polonia, 27 martii 1987 (Prot. 766/86).

target.institute: Institutum saeculare « Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos »

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, presbyter

summary_en: The secular institute 'Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos' may celebrate Blessed Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, priest, its founder, in its churches on 29 January each year with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Institutum saeculare « Hermandad de sacerdotes operarios Diocesanos », 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 261/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Emmanuelis Domingo y Sol, presbyteri, Fundatoris, in ecclesiis eiusdem Instituti quotannis die 29 ianuarii gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert Blesseds Maria Pilar of St Francis Borgia, Teresa of the Child Jesus and Maria Angeles of St Joseph, virgins and martyrs, into the proper calendar of the Order on 24 July as an optional memorial, and may transfer Blessed John Soreth, priest, from 24 July to 27 July; two celebrations named, so none singled out (the Soreth date was moved again on 11 November 1987 under the same protocol, see N1987-284-87-2).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 284/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatarum Mariae Pilar a Sancto Francisco Borgia, Teresiae a Iesu Infante et Mariae Angeles a Sancto Ioseph, virginum et martyrum, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda. Conceditur insuper ut in praedicto Calendario proprio celebratio Beati Ioannis Soreth, presbyteri, a die 24 iulii ad diem 27 iulii transferri possit.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: Cuba: the election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, as patroness before God of the elderly of Cuba is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Cuba, 1 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 594/87): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virginis, Patronae apud Deum senum Cubae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Military Ordinariate of Belgium is approved (bare line); a military ordinariate, recorded at level 'other'.
excerpt: Belgium, Ordinariatus Castrensis, 3 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 277/87).

summary_en: The diocese of Urgell (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the texts of the Mass and Office (p. 280).
excerpt: Urgellensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 243/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Barcelona (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial. The protocol is printed '373/86' here but '373/87' on the text-confirmation line of the same date on p. 280, so the number is uncertain.
excerpt: Barcinonensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 373/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: In the Congregation of the Sons of the Holy Family the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, its founder, is transferred from 17 December to 16 December, with the rank of feast.
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum Sacrae Familiae, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 384/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, eiusdem Congregationis Fundatoris, a die 17 decembris ad praecedentem diem 16 eiusdem mensis transferatur, quotannis gradu Festi peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Vic (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Manyanet Vives, priest, into its proper calendar on 16 December each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the texts of the Mass and Office (p. 280).
excerpt: Vicensis, 10 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 615/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Iosephi Manyanet Vives, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 decembris, gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: In the dioceses of Canada the celebration of St Marguerite Bourgeoys may be kept on 12 January each year as an obligatory memorial; recorded as a grade change on the assumption that the celebration was already in the Canadian calendar at a lower rank, which the line does not state.
excerpt: Canadiae dioeceses, 25 aprilis 1987 (Prot. 662/87): conceditur ut in dioecesibus Canadiae celebratio Sanctae Margaritae Bourgeoys quotannis die 12 ianuarii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, into the proper calendar of the Order on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 5 maii 1987 (Prot. 297/87): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Capuchins may transfer the anniversary of the dedication of their conventual church at Besançon (France) from 4 October to the following day, 5 October; a single church.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 8 maii 1987 (Proot. 709/87): conceditur ut celebratio anniversaria dedicationis ecclesiae conventualis Bisuntinae a die 4 octobris ad sequentem diem 5 eiusdem mensis transferri possit.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Saint-Hyacinthe (Canada) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Sanctus Hyacinthus, 25 maii 1987 (Prot. 651/87).

summary_en: The diocese of Pavia (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello into its calendar on 10 May each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol confirms the Italian text of the collect and second reading (p. 1036).
excerpt: Papiensis, 1 iunii 1987 (Prot. 787/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello, in Calendarium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 10 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, presbyter

summary_en: In the diocese of Tortosa (Spain) the celebration of Blessed Emmanuel Domingo y Sol, priest, may be kept on 29 January each year as an obligatory memorial in the episcopal city and as an optional memorial in the rest of the diocese; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Dertosensis, 2 iunii 1987 (Prot. 788/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Emmanuelis Doming y Sol, presbyteri, quotannis, die 29 ianuarii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae in civitate episcopali, gradu vero memoriae ad libitum in ceteris dioecesis partibus peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: The dioceses of the Netherlands may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) into the calendar of the Dutch dioceses on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Hollandiae dioeceses, 5 iunii 1987 (Prot. 808/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae (Edith Stein) in Calendarium dioecesium Hollandiae inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: In the Institute of the Benedictine Sisters of Providence the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello is transferred from 21 March to 10 May.
excerpt: Institutum Sororum Benedictinarum a Providentia, 22 iunii 1987 (Prot. 859/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello a die 21 martii ad diem 10 maii transferri valeat.

target.institute: Ordo beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede

summary_en: For five years the Order of Our Lady of Mercy may celebrate the votive Mass of Our Lady of Mercy in its churches and in those of religious aggregated to it on the days on which the Saturday Mass of the BVM is permitted (General Norms n. 15) and on the Saturdays of Advent (except 17-24 December) and of Easter time; a standing votive-Mass concession on fixed weekdays, recorded as 'other'.
excerpt: Ordo beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede, 24 iunii 1987 (Prot. 866/87): conceditur ad quinquennium ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Ordinis, necnon in ecclesiis religiosarum, quae ipsi Ordini sunt aggregatae, celebrari valeat Missa votiva de beata Maria Virgine de Mercede diebus quibus permittitur Missa de Sancta Maria in sabbato (« Normae universales de anno liturgico et de calendario », n. 15) atque sabbatis temporis Adventus (exceptis diebus a 17 ad 24 decembris inclusive) et temporis Paschae.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Orvieto-Todi (Italy) is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Urbevetana - Tudertina, 26 iunii 1987 (Prot. 713/87).

summary_en: In the diocesan calendar of Alba Iulia (Romania), for pastoral reasons, the feast of St Matthias, Apostle, is transferred from 14 May to 24 February, the feast of the Visitation from 31 May to 2 July and the memorial of St Elizabeth of Hungary from 17 to 19 November; three celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Alba Iuliensis, 2 iulii 1987 (Prot. 832/87): conceditur ut, attentis rationibus pastoralibus, celebrationes quae sequuntur, in Calendario dioecesis exstantes, transferri valeant: — Festum S. Matthiae, Apostoli, a die 14 maii ad diem 24 februarii; — Festum « In Visitatione BMV » a die 31 maii ad diem 2 iulii; — Memoria S. Elisabeth Hungariae, religiosae, a die 17 novembris ad diem 19 eiusdem mensis.

target.institute: « Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest »

celebration.name_latin: Dominus noster Iesus Christus Summus et Aeternus Sacerdos

summary_en: The 'Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest' (Australia) may celebrate Our Lord Jesus Christ, Eternal High Priest, in its churches each year on the Thursday after Pentecost with the rank of feast; an association, hence level 'other'. The same protocol confirms the Latin text of the Office (p. 1037).
excerpt: « Confraternity of Christ the eternal high priest », 10 iulii 1987 (Prot. 196/86): conceditur ut celebratio Domini nostri Iesu Christi Summi et Aeterni Sacerdotis in ecclesiis eiusdem Confraternitatis quotannis feria quinta post Pentecosten gradu festi peragi valeat.

summary_en: The diocese of Augsburg (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, martyr, on 9 August, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Augustana Vindelicorum, 10 iulii 1987 (Prot. 918/87): conceditur ut celebrationes Beatorum Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris, et Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, martyris, die 9 augusti, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeant quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragendae.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Genoa (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Benedicta Cambiagio Frassinello into its calendar on 10 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ianuensis, 20 iulii 1987 (Prot. 942/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Benedictae Cambiagio Frassinello, in Calendarium Archidioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 10 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Polish Province of the Order of Preachers is approved (bare line).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia Poloniae, 5 augusti 1987 (Prot. 751/87).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: Venezuela: the election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, as patroness before God of the elderly of Venezuela is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Venetiola, 6 augusti 1987 (Prot. 997/87): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virginis, Patronae apud Deum Senum Venetiolae.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Bernardus, Maria et Gratia, martyres

summary_en: Archdiocese of Valencia (Spain): the election of Sts Bernard, Mary and Grace, martyrs, as patrons before God of the town of Alzira is confirmed; a town patron, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Valentina, 20 augusti 1987 (Prot. 1020/87): confirmatur electio Sanctorum Bernardi, Mariae et Gratiae, martyrum in Patronos apud Deum civitatis v.d. « Alzira ».

summary_en: Archdiocese of Genoa-Bobbio (Italy): the celebration of St Tarsicius, titular and patron of the college of that name, and of St Cecilia, titular and patroness of the college of that name, may be kept each year with the rank of solemnity for the members of those colleges; two celebrations for two institutions, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Ianuensis-Bobiensis, 1 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1060/87): conceditur ut celebratio S. Tarsicii, titularis ac Patroni Collegii eiusdem nominis atque celebratio S. Caeciliae, titularis ac Patronae Collegii eiusdem nominis, quotannis pro Collegiorum praedictorum membris gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeant.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Nocera Inferiore-Sarno (Italy) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Italian text of the Proprium Missarum (p. 1152).
excerpt: Nucerina Paganorum - Sarnensis, 3 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1022/87).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Austrian Congregation of the Order of St Benedict is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin and German texts of the Proprium Missarum for the monasteries of the Congregation (p. 1152).
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio Austriaca, 4 septembris 1987 (Prot. 312/83).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the diocese of Soissons-Laon-Saint-Quentin (France) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the Latin text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 1213).
excerpt: Suessionensis - Laudunensis - Sanquintinensis, 8 septembris 1987 (Prot. CD 128/83).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia a Iesu « de los Andes », virgo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa of Jesus 'de los Andes', virgin, into the proper calendar of the Order on 13 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, 26 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1113/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae a Iesu « de los Andes », virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary 'Peregrina' as patroness before God of the parish community of the cathedral church of La Spezia is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Spediensis - Sarzanensis - Brugnatensis, 26 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1121/87): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis « Peregrinae » Patronae apud Deum communitatis paroecialis ecclesiae cathedralis Spediensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi »

summary_en: The archdiocese of Pisa (Italy) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi' into its proper calendar on 25 October each year, as a feast in the cathedral and as an obligatory memorial throughout the diocese; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Pisana, 29 septembris 1987 (Prot. 1131/87): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Maria SS.ma di sotto gli Organi » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 octobris in ecclesia cathedrali gradu festi in universa dioecesi gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The 'Dominicaines de Béthanie' may insert the celebration of Sts Martha, Mary and Lazarus into their proper calendar on 29 July each year with the rank of feast; the same protocol confirms the French text of the Mass and Office (p. 1215).
excerpt: Sorores v.d. « Dominicaines de Béthanie », 1 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1054/87): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctorum Marthae, Mariae et Lazari in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 iulii gradu festi peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo in caelum Assumpta

summary_en: Eparchy of Prešov (Czechoslovakia, today Slovakia): the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Assumed into Heaven as patroness before God of the parish community of the same title in Lutina is confirmed; a single parish, hence level 'other'.
excerpt: Prešoviensis, 3 octobris 1987 (Prot. 180/87): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae Patronae apud Deum communitatis paroecialis eiusdem tituli in loco v.d. « Lutina ».

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia a Iesu « de los Andes », virgo

summary_en: The dioceses of Chile may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa of Jesus 'de los Andes', virgin, of the Order of Discalced Carmelites, into the national proper calendar on 13 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Chiliae dioeceses, 6 octobris 1987 (Prot. 965/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae a Iesu « de los Andes », virginis ex Ordine Carmelitarum Discalceatorum, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 iulii, gradu memoriae ad libitum, peragenda.
