summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Rouen-Le Havre (France) is approved (bare line); the same protocol confirms the French text of the Proprium Missarum and Liturgiae Horarum (p. 1213).
excerpt: Rothomagensis - Portus Gratiae, 7 octobris 1987 (Prot. 306/87).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Georgius Matulaitis seu Matulewicz, episcopus

summary_en: In the dioceses of Lithuania the celebration of Blessed George Matulaitis (Matulewicz), bishop, may be transferred from 27 January to 12 July, to be kept each year as an obligatory memorial; protocol printed with a hyphen ('1189-87').
excerpt: Lituaniae dioeceses, 17 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1189-87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Georgii Matulaitis seu Matulewicz, episcopi, a die 27 ianuarii ad diem 12 iulii transferri possit, quotannis gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Munich and Freising (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Mary Theresa of Jesus Gerhardinger, virgin, on 9 May, both as obligatory memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Monacensis et Frisingensis, 20 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1177/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, quotannis die 3 novembris, gradu memoria obligatoriae peragenda, necnon celebratio Beatae Mariae Teresiae a Iesu Gerhardinger, virginis quotannis die 9 maii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeant.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Laurentius Ruiz et Socii, martyres

summary_en: The Order of Preachers may celebrate St Lawrence Ruiz and companions, martyrs, throughout the Order on 28 September each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, 30 octobris 1987 (Prot. 1129/87): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Laurentii Ruiz et Sociorum, martyrum, in universo Ordine quotannis die 28 septembris, gradu memoriae obligatoriae, peragi possit.

summary_en: The diocese of Würzburg (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November and Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, martyr, on 9 August, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Herbipolensis, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1218/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda necnon celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, martyris, die 9 augusti quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeant.

target.institute: Congregatio Canonicorum Regularium S. Augustini Lateranensium Austriaca

celebration.name_latin: Ss. Michael, Gabriel et Raphael, Archangeli

summary_en: In the monastery of Klosterneuburg (Austria) the Austrian Congregation of the Canons Regular of the Lateran may celebrate Sts Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels, on 29 September each year with the rank of solemnity; a single monastery.
excerpt: Congregatio Canonicorum Regularium S. Augustini Lateranensium Austriaca, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1220/87): conceditur ut celebratio Ss. Michaëlis, Gabrielis et Raphaëlis, Archangelorum, in Monasterio Claustroneuburgensi quotannis die 29 septembris, gradu sollemnitatis, peragi valeat.

target.institute: Sorores a caritate S. Crucis de Ingenbohl

summary_en: The Sisters of Charity of the Holy Cross of Ingenbohl (Switzerland) may insert the celebration of Blessed Ulrika Nisch, virgin (printed 'Nish'), into their proper calendar on 8 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Sorores a caritate S. Crucis de Ingenbohl, 10 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1222/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Ulricae Nish, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 maii, gradu memoriae obligatoriae, peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Freiburg (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Ulrika Nisch, virgin (printed 'Lisch'), into its proper calendar on 8 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Friburgensis, 10 novembris 1987 1987 (Prot. 1223/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Ulricae Lisch, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 8 maii, gradu memoriae ad libitum, peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may transfer the celebration of Blessed John Soreth, priest, from 27 July to 28 July; a second act under the same protocol as the 1 April 1987 change (N1987-284-87), which had moved him from 24 to 27 July.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 11 novembris 1987 (Prot. 284/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Soreth, presbyteri, a die 27 iulii ad diem 28 iulii transferri possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Carolina Kozka, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The diocese of Tarnów (Poland) may insert the celebration of Blessed Karolina Kózka into its proper calendar on 18 November each year, as an obligatory memorial throughout the diocese and as a feast in the cathedral basilica and in the parish church of Zabawa where her body rests; two ranks printed, so grade left null.
excerpt: Tarnoviensis, 13 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1241/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Carolinae Kozka in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 18 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae in universa dioecesi, gradu vero festi in Basilica Cathedrali et in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. « Zabawa », ubi corpus eiusdem Beatae religiose asservatur, peragenda.

summary_en: The Congregation of Ursuline Sisters 'of Calvarienberg' may insert the celebration of Blessed Blandina Merten into its proper calendar, on 18 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Sororum Ursulinarum « De Calvarienberg », 18 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1264/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Blandinae Merten in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 18 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel (O.Carm.) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) on 9 August and Blessed Teresa of Jesus 'de los Andes' on 13 July, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 20 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1273/87): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat: — celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum; — celebratio Beatae Teresiae a Iesu « de los Andes », die 13 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum quotannis peragendae.

summary_en: The Congregation of the Servants of Charity (Guanellians) may insert the celebration of Blessed Andrew Ferrari, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 3 February each year as an optional memorial. The same protocol on pp. 40-41 confirms Latin and Italian liturgical texts for the Blessed (not recorded).
excerpt: Congregatio Servorum a Caritate, 20 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1276/87): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Andreae Ferrari, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 februarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel as patroness before God of the parish community of the place called 'San Juan del Puerto', diocese of Huelva (Spain), is confirmed; a single parish.
excerpt: Onubensis, 21 novembris 1987 (Prot. 946/87): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo communitatis paroecialis loci v.d. « San Juan del Puerto » apud Deum Patronae.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Iordanus (Hyacinthus) Anzalone, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: For the dioceses of Sicily (Italy), the baptismal name Hyacinthus may be added to the title of the liturgical celebration of the new Saint Jordan Anzalone, priest and martyr; a sub-national regional calendar.
excerpt: Siciliae dioeceses, 24 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1277/87): conceditur ut in titulum celebrationis liturgicae novi Sancti Iordani Anzalone, presbyteri et martyris, addi possit nomen baptismatis eiusdem Sancti, nempe: Hyacinthus.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Virgen de la Candelaria de Chapi »

summary_en: The diocese of Arequipa (Peru) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Virgen de la Candelaria de Chapi' into its proper calendar, on 1 May each year throughout the diocese, with the grade of solemnity.
excerpt: Arequipensis, 28 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1271/87): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Virgen de la Candelaria de Chapi » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 maii, in universa dioecesi gradu sollemnitatis peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary 'Auxilium Christianorum' as patroness before God of the parish community of the place called 'La Ermita', diocese of Jericó (Colombia), is confirmed; a single parish.
excerpt: Iericoensis, 30 novembris 1987 (Prot. 1299/87): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis « Auxilium Christianorum » communitatis paroecialis loci v.d. « La Ermita » apud Deum Patronae.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the monastery of Discalced Carmelite nuns of Binissalem (Benisalem), diocese of Mallorca (Spain), St Teresa of the Child Jesus may be transferred from 1 October to 3 October and Blessed Mary of Jesus (López Rivas) from 12 September to 11 September; a single monastery, two celebrations named.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 19 decembris 1987 (Prot. 1357/87): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio Monasterii Monialium Carmelitarum Discalceatarum civitatis « Benisalem », in dioecesi Maioricensi: — celebratio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Infante a die 1 octobris ad diem 3 octobris transferri possit; — celebratio Beatae Mariae a Iesu (López Rivas) a die 12 septembris ad diem 11 septembris transferri possit.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Antonius de Padova, presbyter et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: The election of St Anthony of Padua, priest and doctor of the Church, as patron before God of the diocese of Piracicaba (Brazil) is confirmed.
excerpt: Piracicabensis, 2 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 1312/87): confirmatur electio Sancti Antonii de Padova, presbyteri et Ecclesiae doctoris, Patroni apud Deum dioecesis Piracicabensis.

summary_en: The diocese of Siedlce (Poland) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Leśna (Lesnioviensis) into its proper calendar, on 26 September each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Siedlcensis, 4 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 1380/87): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Lesnioviensis in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 26 septembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Hildesheim (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, on 8 August and Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 3 November, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Hildesiensis, 5 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 1347/87): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat — celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, die 8 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda; — et celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 3 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, into the proper calendar of the churches of the Order and of the monasteries of Discalced Carmelite nuns in the Netherlands, on 2 August each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 7 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 116/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, in Calendarium proprium ecclesiarum eiusdem Ordinis et monasteriorum monialium Carmelitarum Discalceatarum, in Hollandia, inseri valeat, quotannis die 2 augusti gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatae Maria Pilar, Teresia a Iesu Infante et Maria ab Angelis, virgines et martyres

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed Maria Pilar, Teresa of the Child Jesus and Maria of the Angels, virgins and martyrs, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Discalced Carmelite monastery of St Joseph in Guadalajara (Spain), on 24 July each year with the grade of feast; a single monastery.
excerpt: Eodem die (Prot. 117/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatarum Mariae Pilar, Teresiae a Iesu Infante et Mariae ab Angelis, virginum et martyrum, in Calendarium proprium Monasterii Sancti Ioseph in civitate Guadalaiarensi inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 iulii gradu festi peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo “of Guadalupe”

summary_en: The dioceses of the United States of America may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'of Guadalupe' into their proper calendar, on 12 December each year with the grade of feast. The same protocol on the same page confirms the English text of the Mass (not recorded).
excerpt: Civitatum Foederatarum Americae Septemtrionalis dioeceses, 8 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 1341/87): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo “of Guadalupe” in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 12 decembris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora del Perpetuo Socorro' as patroness before God of the Health Service of the armed forces and of the military hospitals in Venezuela is confirmed; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Venetiolae dioeceses, 21 ianuarii 1988 (Prot. 193/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Perpetuo Socorro » Patronae apud Deum Servitio Sanitatis Copiarum addictorum necnon hospitalium militum in Venetiola.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum - Provincia Picena

summary_en: In the calendar of the Picene Province of the Capuchin Friars Minor (Italy), the memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of Grace may be transferred from 8 May to 26 June.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum - Provincia Picena, 2 februarii 1988 (Prot. 189/88): conceditur ut in Calendario Provinciae Picenae celebratio memoriae beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Gratiae a die 8 maii ad diem 26 iunii transferri valeat.

summary_en: The dioceses of Chile may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mercy (de Mercede) into their proper calendar, on 24 September each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Chiliae dioeceses, 2 februarii 1988 (Prot. 253/88): conceditur ut in Calendarium Proprium dioecesium Chiliae inseri valeat celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis a Mercede, quotannis die 24 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The election of St Francis of Paola, hermit, as secondary patron before God of the city and diocese of Castellaneta (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Castellanetensis, 3 februarii 1988 (Prot. 252/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Francisci de Paola, eremitae, civitatis et dioecesis Castellanetensis apud Deum Patroni secundarii.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: In the churches of the Discalced Carmelites in Nigeria, the celebrations of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Our Lady of Nigeria' on 1 October and of St Teresa of the Child Jesus, virgin, on 3 October may be kept each year with the grade of feast; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 1 martii 1988 (Prot. 333/88): conceditur ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Ordinis in Nigeria celebrationes beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Our Lady of Nigeria », die 1 octobris, gradu festi, et Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Infante, virginis, die 3 octobris, gradu festi quotannis peragi valeant.

summary_en: The diocese of Regensburg (Germany) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Mary Theresa of Jesus Gerhardinger, virgin, on 9 May and Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, on 9 November, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Ratisbonensis, 4 martii 1988 (Prot. 242/88): conceditur ut celebrationes Beatae Mariae Teresiae a Iesu Gehardinger, virginis, die 9 maii, Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, die 9 novembris, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeant, quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragendae.

summary_en: The diocese of Speyer (Germany) may insert the celebration 'of the same Blessed' into its proper calendar, on 3 November each year as an obligatory memorial. The referent is ambiguous: the line follows the Regensburg entry naming Bl. Gerhardinger (9 May) and Bl. Rupert Mayer (3 November in Hildesheim), while the same protocol on p. 242 confirms the German text of the Liturgy of the Hours for Bl. Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) for Speyer; celebration left null.
excerpt: Spirensis, 7 martii 1988 (Prot. 245/88): conceditur ut celebratio eiusdem Beatae in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: In the church of the Carmelite monastery 'Montis Carmeli' at Vetralla (Italy), the celebration of St Paul of the Cross, priest, may be kept on 19 October each year as an obligatory memorial, using the texts of the Roman Missal and Liturgy of the Hours; a single monastery church.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 11 martii 1988 (Prot. 378/88): conceditur ut in ecclesia Monasterii « Montis Carmeli » in loco Vetralla nuncupato celebratio S. Pauli a Cruce, presbyteri, quotannis die 19 octobris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat, textibus adhibitis Missalis Romani et Liturgiae Horarum.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « di Capocolonna »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'di Capocolonna' as principal patroness before God of the archdiocese of Crotone-Santa Severina (Italy) is confirmed.
excerpt: Crotonensis – Sancta Severina, 12 martii 1988 (Prot. 162/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v.d. « di Capocolonna » eiusdem Archidioecesis apud Deum Patronae principalis.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Society of the Sacred Heart recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol. The same protocol on p. 328 confirms the French, English and Spanish texts of the Society's Proper of Masses (not recorded).
excerpt: « Société du Sacré Coeur », 17 martii 1988 (Prot. 888/87).

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Laurentius Ruiz et socii, martyres

summary_en: By decree of the Congregation for Divine Worship, at the request of the Bishops' Conference of the Philippines, the celebration of Saints Lawrence Ruiz and companions, martyrs, is inserted into the General Roman Calendar as an optional memorial on 28 September each year; the proper texts for Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours are printed at pp. 253-255.
excerpt: Summus Pontifex Ioannes Paulus II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria Sanctorum martyrum quotannis die 28 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum ab omnibus peragi possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Andacollo »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Andacollo' as patroness before God of the archdiocese of La Serena (Chile) is confirmed.
excerpt: Serenensis, 22 martii 1988 (Prot. 337/88): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Andacollo » archidioecesis Serenensis apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: The election of St Dominic 'de la Calzada' as patron before God of the associations in Spain called 'Administradores de Fincas de España' (property administrators) is confirmed; a patron of a profession.
excerpt: Hispania, 28 martii 1988 (Prot. 442/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Dominici v.d. « de la Calzada » consociationum in Hispania, quae « Administradores de Fincas de España » nuncupantur, apud Deum Patroni.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Petrina Morosini, virgo et martyr

summary_en: The diocese of Bergamo (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Pierina Morosini, virgin and martyr, into its proper calendar, on 6 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Bergomensis, 30 martii 1988 (Prot. 471/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Petrinae Morosini, virginis et martyris, quotannis die 6 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Nice (France) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol. Note that p. 394 confirms the French Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours for Nice on the same day under a different protocol (531/86).
excerpt: Nicensis, 19 aprilis 1988 (Prot. 351/86).

summary_en: The election of St John de Britto as patron before God of the diocese of Sivagangai (India) is confirmed.
excerpt: Sivagangaiensis, 20 aprilis 1988 (Prot. 491/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Ioannis de Britto eiusdem dioecesis apud Deum Patroni.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes Calabria, presbyter ac fundator

summary_en: In the churches of the Congregation of the Poor Servants of Divine Providence, the celebration of Blessed John Calabria, priest and founder, may be kept on 8 October each year with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Congregatio Pauperum Servorum Divinae Providentiae, 22 aprilis 1988 (Prot. 418/88): conceditur ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Congregationis celebratio Beati Ioannis Calabria, presbyteri ac fundatoris, quotannis die 8 octobris gradu festi peragi possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Iosephus Nascimbeni, presbyter ac fundator

summary_en: The Little Sisters of the Holy Family may keep the celebration of Blessed Joseph Nascimbeni, priest and founder, on 20 January each year with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Parvae Sorores a Sacra Familia, 26 aprilis 1988 (Prot. 574/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi Nascimbeni, presbyteri ac fundatoris, quotannis die 20 ianuarii gradu festi peragi possit.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Munich and Freising (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Gaspar Stanggassinger, priest, into its proper calendar, on 26 September each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Monacensis et Frisingensis, 27 aprilis 1988 (Prot. 576/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Gasparis Stanggassinger, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 26 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: By decree of 30 April 1988 the Congregation for Divine Worship approves and confirms, for the dioceses of Zaire, the French text of the Order of Mass with its Praenotanda, Calendar and proper Masses (the 'Missel Romain pour les diocèses du Zaïre'); the Summarium of Notitiae 263 lists the same act at p. 393 (text confirmation) and as a bare Calendaria particularia line at p. 396.
excerpt: Congregatio pro Cultu Divino, vigore facultatum sibi a Summo Pontifice IOANNE PAULO II tributarum, textum Ordinis Missae cum Praenotandis, Calendario et Missis propriis adiunctis, lingua gallica exaratum et huic Decreto adnexum, libenter approbat seu confirmat.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Viviers (France) recorded as a bare approval line. The protocol printed (1520/85) is the same as the Zaire line that follows and as the Zaire Ordo Missae confirmation on p. 393, while p. 394 gives 562/87 for the Viviers Proper of Masses; the protocol may be misprinted, transcribed as printed.
excerpt: Vivariensis, 9 maii 1988 (Prot. 1520/85).

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Valence (France) recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 473 confirm the French text of the Proper of Masses (not recorded).
excerpt: Valentinensis, 19 maii 1988 (Prot. 543/87).

summary_en: The dioceses of Japan may keep the celebration of the Holy Martyrs of Nagasaki (Lawrence Ruiz and companions, canonized by John Paul II on 18 October 1987) on 28 September each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Iaponiae dioeceses, 24 maii 1988 (Prot. 673/88): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctorum Martyrum Nagasakiensium, qui a Summo Pontifice Ioanne Paulo II die 18 octobris 1987 in albo Sanctorum sunt inscripti, quotannis die 28 septembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Padua (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 473 confirm the texts of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours (not recorded).
excerpt: Patavina, 26 maii 1988 (Prot. 1348/87).

target.institute: Congregatio Filiorum Sanctae Familiae Iesu, Mariae et Ioseph

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Congregation of the Sons of the Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 474 confirm the Catalan translation of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours (not recorded).
excerpt: Congregatio Filiorum Sanctae Familiae Iesu, Mariae et Ioseph, 31 maii 1988 (Prot. 667/88).

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Andreas Dung-Lac, presbyter, et socii, martyres

summary_en: The dioceses of Vietnam may insert the celebration of Saints Andrew Dung-Lac, priest, and companions, martyrs, into their proper calendar, on 24 November each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Vietnamenses dioeceses, 3 iunii 1988 (Prot. 630/88): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctorum Andreae Dund-Lac, presbyteri, ac Sociorum, martyrum, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Moulins (France) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol.
excerpt: Molinensis, 13 iunii 1988 (Prot. 190/87).

summary_en: The diocese of Verona (Italy) may insert into its proper calendar Blessed Joseph Nascimbeni, priest, on 20 January and Blessed John Calabria, priest, on 8 October, both as optional memorials; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Veronensis, 17 iunii 1988 (Prot. 824/88): conceditur ut celebratio — Beati Iosephi Nascimbeni, presbyteri, die 20 ianuarii; — et Beati Ioannis Calabria, presbyteri, die 8 octobris in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The dioceses of New Zealand may celebrate the Mass called 'Anzac day' on 25 April each year; a fixed-date Mass concession recorded under a Calendaria particularia heading.
excerpt: Novae Zelandiae dioeceses, 18 iunii 1988 (Prot. 541/85): conceditur ut Missa de « Anzac day » nuncupata quotannis die 25 aprilis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Pontoise (France) recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 729 confirm the French text of the Proper of Masses (not recorded).
excerpt: Pontisarensis, 23 iunii 1988 (Prot. 628/88).

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Breda (Netherlands) recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 730 confirm the Dutch text of the Proper of Masses (not recorded).
excerpt: Bredana, 12 iulii 1988 (Prot. 854/88).

summary_en: The election of Blessed Marcelo Spínola y Maestre, bishop, as patron before God of the Metropolitan Chapter of Seville (Spain) is confirmed; the patron of a cathedral chapter.
excerpt: Hispalensis, 15 iulii 1988 (Prot. 961/88): confirmatur electio Beati Marcelli Spinola y Maestre, episcopi, Patroni apud Deum Capituli Metropolitani Hispalensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Marcellus Spinola y Maestre, episcopus

summary_en: The archdiocese of Seville (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Marcelo Spínola y Maestre, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 19 January each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol on p. 729 allows the use of the texts confirmed in 1987 (not recorded).
excerpt: Hispalensis, 15 iulii 1988 (Prot. 962/88): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium Archidioecesis celebratio Beati Marcelli Spinola y Maestre, episcopi, inseri valeat, quotannis die 19 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo – Provincia Bavariae

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: In the churches of the Bavarian Province of the Discalced Carmelites and in the church of the Cologne monastery, the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, may be kept on 9 August each year as an obligatory memorial, in accordance with n. 24 of the Instruction 'Calendaria particularia' of 24 June 1970.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo – Provincia Bavariae, 19 iulii 1988 (Prot. 421/88): conceditur ut in ecclesiis eiusdem Ordinis in Provincia Bavariae necnon in ecclesia monasterii Coloniensis celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat, ad normam n. 24 Instructionis « Calendaria particularia » diei 24 iunii 1970 (AAS 1970, pp. 651-663).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter

summary_en: The diocese of Lleida (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest, into its proper calendar, on 20 March each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol on p. 730 allows the diocese to use the Discalced Carmelite texts (not recorded).
excerpt: Illerdensis, 25 iulii 1988 (Prot. 987/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 20 martii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Refugium in necessitatibus »

summary_en: The diocese of Haarlem (Netherlands; today Haarlem-Amsterdam) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Refugium in necessitatibus' (Our Lady of Need, Heiloo) into its proper calendar, each year on the last Saturday of May with the grade of memorial; the date is movable (last Saturday of May), so no day is given. The same protocol confirms the Latin and Dutch Mass text (p. 730) and grants a five-year votive Mass at the shrine of Heiloo (p. 735), neither recorded.
excerpt: Harlemensis, 26 iulii 1988 (Prot. 976/88): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Refugium in necessitatibus » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis ultimo sabbato mensis maii, gradu memoriae peragenda.

summary_en: In the particular calendar of the Institute of Benedictine Sisters of Providence, St Benedict, abbot (11 July) is to be kept as a solemnity, St Jerome Emiliani (8 February) and the Holy Guardian Angels (2 October) as feasts; three celebrations named, so none singled out. The same protocol on p. 733 confirms the Latin Liturgy of the Hours text for the BVM 'Mater Providentiae' (not recorded).
excerpt: Institutum Sororum Benedictinarum a Providentia, 1 augusti 1988 (Prot. 839/88): conceditur ut in Calendario particulari eiusdem Instituti — celebratio S. Benedicti, abbatis (11 iulii) gradu sollemnitatis; — celebratio S. Hieronymi Emiliani (8 februarii) gradu festi; — celebratio Ss. Angelorum Custodum (2 octobris) gradu festi peragantur.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the archdiocese of Siena-Colle di Val d'Elsa-Montalcino (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol.
excerpt: Senensis-Collensis-Ilciensis, 5 augusti 1988 (Prot. 396/88).

summary_en: The diocese of Rotterdam (Netherlands) may insert the celebration of Blessed Jeroen (Hieron), priest and martyr, into its proper calendar, on 17 August each year as an optional memorial in the diocese and as an obligatory memorial in the parish church of Noordwijk where his relics are kept. Page 730 confirms the Latin and Dutch collect for the Blessed under Prot. 988/88 (as printed; not recorded).
excerpt: Roterodamensis, 19 augusti 1988 (Prot. 998/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ieronis, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 17 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum in dioecesi, gradu vero memoriae obligatoriae in ecclesia paroeciali loci v.d. « Noordwijk », ubi exuviae eiusdem Beati religiose asservantur, peragenda.

summary_en: The election of St Simon de Rojas, priest, as secondary patron before God of the city of Móstoles (archdiocese of Madrid, Spain) is confirmed; a single city.
excerpt: Matritensis, 31 augusti 1988 (Prot. 1013/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Simonis de Rojas, presbyteri, Patroni secundarii apud Deum civitatis v.d. « Móstoles ».

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein)

summary_en: The diocese of Münster (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein) into its proper calendar, on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Monasteriensis, 1 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1123/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein) in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Salesians of Don Bosco may insert the celebration of Blessed Laura Vicuña into their proper calendar, on 22 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Societas S. Francisci Salesii, 6 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1107/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Laurae Vicuña in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Institutum Sororum Pauperum a S. Catharina Senensi

celebration.name_latin: Beata Savina Petrilli, virgo ac fundatrix

summary_en: The Institute of the Poor Sisters of St Catherine of Siena may keep the celebration of Blessed Savina Petrilli, virgin and foundress, on 18 April each year with the grade of feast.
excerpt: Institutum Sororum Pauperum a S. Catharina Senensi, 6 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1135/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Savinae Petrilli, virginis ac fundatricis, quotannis die 18 aprilis gradu festi peragi possit.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Military Ordinariate of the Netherlands recorded as a bare approval line; the same protocol and date on p. 730 confirm its Proper of Masses (not recorded). The target is a military ordinariate, not a territorial diocese.
excerpt: Hollandiae Ordinariatus Castrensis, 7 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1150/88).

summary_en: The election of St Hermes, martyr, as patron before God of the municipality of Gabicce Mare (archdiocese of Pesaro, Italy) is confirmed; a single municipality.
excerpt: Pisaurensis, 23 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1217/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Hermetis martyris Patroni apud Deum municipii v.d. « Gabicce Mare ».

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Spoleto-Norcia (Italy) the celebration of Blessed Pietro Bonilli, priest, may be transferred from 5 January to 24 April.
excerpt: Spoletana-Nursina, 24 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1208/88): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio Beati Petri Bonilli, presbyteri, a die 5 ianuarii ad diem 24 aprilis transferri valeat.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Catania (Italy) may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Benedict Dusmet, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 September each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Catanensis, 26 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1232/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi Benedicti Dusmet, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Benedictine Confederation may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Benedict Dusmet, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 September each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Confoederatio Ordinis Sancti Benedicti, 26 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1233/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi Benedicti Dusmet, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter

summary_en: The Carmelites (O.Carm.) may insert the celebration of Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest, into their proper calendar, on 20 March each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 29 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1244/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 20 martii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Michael Augustinus Pro, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The dioceses of Mexico may insert the celebration of Blessed Miguel Agustín Pro, priest and martyr, into their proper calendar, on 23 November each year as an optional memorial, and as a feast in the church where the Blessed is buried. The same protocol confirms the Spanish texts (p. 874, p. 877) and grants the same celebration to the Society of Jesus (p. 880, recorded separately).
excerpt: Mexicum, 30 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1245/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Michaelis Augustini Pro, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum, in ecclesia vero ubi Beatus sepultus est, gradu festi peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Michael Augustinus Pro, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The Society of Jesus may insert the celebration of Blessed Miguel Agustín Pro, priest and martyr, into its proper calendar, on 23 November each year as an optional memorial, and as a feast in the church where the Blessed is buried; same protocol as the Mexican national concession on p. 878.
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 30 septembris 1988 (Prot. 1245/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Michaelis Augustini Pro, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum, in ecclesia vero ubi Beatus sepultus est, gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora de la Medalla Milagrosa' as patroness before God of the city of Nuevo Casas Grandes (diocese of Nuevo Casas Grandes, Mexico) is confirmed; a single city.
excerpt: Neograndicasensis, 3 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1248/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Medalla Milagrosa » Patronae apud Deum civitatis v.d. « Nuevo Casas Grandes ».

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Nossa Senhora aparecida »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora Aparecida' as patroness before God of the diocese of Itabira-Fabriciano (Brazil) is confirmed.
excerpt: Itabirensis-Fabriciannensis, 12 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1210/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora aparecida », Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Itabirensis-Fabriciannensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Nuestra Señora de Zapopan»

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Nuestra Señora de Zapopan» as patroness before God of the archdiocese of Guadalajara (Mexico); no date is given on the page.
excerpt: Guadalaiarensis, 18 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1249/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «Nuestra Señora de Zapopan» Patronae apud Deum Archidioecesis Guadalaiarensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Honoratus a Biala Podlaska, presbyter

summary_en: The Capuchin Friars Minor may insert the celebration of Blessed Honorat of Biała Podlaska (Koźmiński), priest, into their proper calendar, on 13 October each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum Capuccinorum, 18 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1278/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Honorati a Biala Podlaska, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 octobris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Laurentius Ruiz et socii, martyres

summary_en: In Poland the celebration of Saints Lawrence Ruiz and companions, martyrs, may be transferred from 28 September to 26 September; the same protocol on p. 876 confirms the Polish texts for the celebration (not recorded).
excerpt: Polonia, 18 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1279/88): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctorum Laurentii Ruiz et sociorum, martyrum, a die 28 ad diem 26 septembris transferri valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter

summary_en: The Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest, into their proper calendar, on 7 November each year as an optional memorial; the same protocol grants the celebration as a feast to the Teresian Carmelite Missionaries (p. 880, recorded separately).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 20 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1256/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 7 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter ac Fundator

summary_en: The Institute of the Teresian Carmelite Missionaries may insert the celebration of Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest and founder, into its proper calendar, on 7 November each year with the grade of feast; same protocol as the Discalced Carmelite concession on p. 879.
excerpt: Institutum Carmelitarum Missionariarum Teresianarum, 20 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1256/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri ac Fundatoris, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 7 novembris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Rancagua (Chile) may insert the celebration of Blessed Laura Vicuña, virgin, into its proper calendar, on 22 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Rancaguensis, 21 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1374/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Laurae Vicuña, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The election of Blessed Margaret (of Città di Castello) as patroness before God of the blind ('non vedenti') and of the marginalised ('emarginati') is confirmed for the diocese of Urbino-Urbania-Sant'Angelo in Vado-Città di Castello (Italy); a patron of categories of persons.
excerpt: Urbitanensis-Urbaniensis-Sancti Angeli in vado-Civitatis Castelli, 26 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1368/88): confirmatur electio Beatae Margaritae Patronae apud Deum eorum qui « non vedenti » et « emarginati » vulgo appellantur.

summary_en: The diocese of Münster (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Monasteriensis, 28 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1126/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Paderborn (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Paderbornensis, 28 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1389/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Copenhagen (Denmark) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen (Niels Steensen), bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year with the grade of memorial.
excerpt: Hafnia, 28 octobris 1988 (Prot. 1398/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae

summary_en: The Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Gérard, priest, into their proper calendar, on 29 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Missionariorum Oblatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae, 8 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1412/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi Gérard, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Schwerin (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Sverinensis, 9 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1416/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Osnabrück (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Osnabrugensis, 9 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1417/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The dioceses of Argentina may insert the celebration of Blessed Laura Vicuña, virgin, into the national proper calendar, on 22 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Argentinae dioeceses, 9 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1441/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Laurae Vicuña, virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Nationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 22 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Valencia (Spain) may insert the celebration of Blessed Josefa Naval Girbés, virgin, into its proper calendar, on 10 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Valentina, 9 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1445/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Iosephae Naval Girbés, virginis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 10 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese of Hildesheim (Germany) may insert the celebration of Blessed Nicolaus Stensen, bishop, into its proper calendar, on 25 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Hildesiensis, 9 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1447/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 25 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The diocese printed as 'Vegensis' may insert the celebration of Blessed Jacques Jules Bonnaud (Jesuit martyr of 1792, born in Cap-Français, Saint-Domingue) into its proper calendar, on 2 September each year as an optional memorial. The diocese is most probably La Vega (Dominican Republic) but the identification is not certain, so the nation is left null.
excerpt: Vegensis, 10 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1449/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iacobi Iulii Bonnaud in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 2 septembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Termoli-Larino (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol.
excerpt: Thermulae-Larinensis, 11 novembris 1988 (Prot. 277/88).

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Mater Ecclesiae' as patroness before God of the diocese of Caguas (Puerto Rico) is confirmed.
excerpt: Caguana, 12 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1367/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Matris Ecclesiae », Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Caguanae.

summary_en: The dioceses of Lesotho may insert the celebration of Blessed Joseph Gérard, priest, secondary patron of Lesotho, into the national proper calendar, on 29 May each year as an obligatory memorial (his election as secondary patron is confirmed separately at p. 881).
excerpt: Lesotho dioeceses, 19 novembris 1988 (Prot. 1467/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Iosephi Gérard, presbyteri, Patroni secundarii « of Lesotho », in Calendarium proprium dioecesium nationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculate as principal patroness and of Blessed Joseph Gérard as secondary patron of Lesotho is confirmed; two celebrations named, so none singled out. The protocol is printed as '(302/88)' without the word Prot.
excerpt: « Lesotho », 19 novembris 1988 (302/88): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae Patronae principalis et Beati Iosephi Gérard Patroni secundarii « of Lesotho ».

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Abruzzi Province of the Friars Minor recorded as a bare line printing only the province and date, with no protocol number; p. 877 confirms the Latin and Italian Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours of the same province on the same date under Prot. 1198/88, which may be the same act.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Minorum, Provincia Aprutina, 24 novembris 1988.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Vincentia Maria Lopez Vicuña, virgo

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Vicenta María López Vicuña, virgin, as patroness before God of the members of the «Trabajadoras del Hogar» (domestic workers) in Peru; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Peruviae dioeceses, 7 decembris 1988 (Prot. 1550/88): confirmatur electio Sanctae Vincentiae Mariae Lopez Vicuña, virginis, Patronae apud Deum sodalium in Peruvia, quae «Trabajadoras del Hogar» nuncupantur.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Discalced Carmelites the celebration of Blessed Josefa Naval Girbés, virgin, may be transferred from 24 February to 6 November.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 21 decembris 1988 (Prot. 1202/88): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio Beatae Iosephae Naval Girbés, virginis, a die 24 februarii ad diem 6 novembris transferri valeat.

summary_en: Four celebrations may be inserted into the calendar of the dioceses of Poland, each as a memorial: Blessed George Matulewicz, bishop (27 January); Blessed Michael Kozal, bishop and martyr (14 June); Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr (9 August); Blessed Karolina Kózka, virgin and martyr (18 November).

target.institute: Congregationes Religiosarum quae a Beato Honorato Koźmiński sunt fundatae

summary_en: The religious congregations founded by Blessed Honorat Koźmiński may insert the celebration of Blessed Honorat Koźmiński, priest and founder, into their proper calendars, on 13 October each year as a feast (the same protocol also allows them the Mass and Office texts approved for the Capuchins, printed on p. 274).
excerpt: Congregationes Religiosarum quae a Beato Honorato Koźmiński sunt fundatae, 2 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1571/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Honorati Koźmiński, presbyteri ac fundatoris, in Calendariis propriis earundem Congregationum Religiosarum inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 octobris gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Martin, bishop of Tours, as patron before God of the members of the Commissariat of the Land Forces (army commissariat) in France, for the French military ordinariate; a patron of a category of persons, not of a diocese.
excerpt: Galliae Ordinariatus Castrensis, 12 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1586/88): confirmatur electio Sancti Martini, episcopi Turonensis, Patroni apud Deum membrorum Commissariatus Copiarum de terra in Gallia.

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Maria Magdalena a Nagasaki, martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Mary Magdalene of Nagasaki, martyr, as patroness before God of the Secular Fraternity of the Order of Augustinian Recollects; the patron of an association.
excerpt: Fraternitas saecularis Ordinis Augustinianorum Recollectorum, 14 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1476/88): confirmatur electio Sanctae Mariae Magdalenae a Nagasaki, martyris, Patronae apud Deum eiusdem Fraternitatis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «María Auxiliadora»

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «María Auxiliadora» may be inserted into the proper calendar of the dioceses of Peru, on 24 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Peruviae dioeceses, 18 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 183/89): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «María Auxiliadora» in Calendarium proprium dioecesium inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Congregation of the Servants of Charity may transfer the celebration of Blessed Andrea Carlo Ferrari, bishop, from 3 February to 1 February.
excerpt: Congregatio Servorum a Caritate, 20 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1267/87), conceditur ut celebratio Beati Andreae Caroli Ferrari, episcopi, a die 3 februarii ad diem 1 eiusdem mensis transferri possit.

summary_en: For the dioceses of the United States four celebrations may be inserted into the proper calendar, each as an optional memorial: Blessed Katharine Drexel, virgin (3 March); St Jane Frances de Chantal, virgin (18 August); Blessed Junípero Serra, priest (28 August); St Rose Philippine Duchesne, virgin (18 November).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Mallorca (Spain), on 7 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Maioricensis, 25 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1572/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 7 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio v.d. «Suore di Betania del Sacro Cuore»

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the Congregation «Suore di Betania del Sacro Cuore»; the page prints only the institute, date and protocol number with no text of the act (the same protocol on p. 274 confirms the Italian text of its Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours), presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Congregatio v.d. «Suore di Betania del Sacro Cuore», 30 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1574/88).

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the archdiocese of Trani-Barletta-Bisceglie (Italy); the page prints only the diocese, date and protocol number with no text of the act, presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Tranensis-Barolensis-Vigiliensis, 31 ianuarii 1989 (Prot. 1370/87).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virgo

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars, virgin, as patroness before God of the elderly living in Mexico; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Mexici dioeceses, 4 februarii 1989 (Prot. 267/89): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars, virginis, Patronae apud Deum senum qui in Mexico degunt.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Cunibert, bishop, as patron before God of the locality of Remich (Luxembourg); a local patron of a single town.
excerpt: Luxemburgum, 10 februarii 1989 (Prot. 276/89): confirmatur electio Sancti Cuniberti, episcopi, Patroni apud Deum loci v.d. «Remich».

target.institute: Societas Sancti Francisci Salesii in Polonia

summary_en: The Salesians in Poland may transfer the celebration of St Dominic Savio in their proper calendar from 6 May to 5 May.
excerpt: Societas Sancti Francisci Salesii in Polonia, 13 februarii 1989 (Prot. 285/89): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio Sancti Dominici Savio a die 6 maii ad diem 5 eiusdem mensis transferri valeat.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Regina Caelorum»

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Regina Caelorum» (Queen of Heaven) as patroness before God of the diocese of Lexington (USA); no date is given on the page.
excerpt: Lexingtonensis, 16 februarii 1989 (Prot. 239/89): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «Regina Caelorum» Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Lexingtonensis.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Maria Giuseppa Rossello, virgin, as patroness before God of the potters and ceramic artists of the region of Liguria (Italy); a patron of a profession.
excerpt: Liguriae dioeceses in Italia, 27 februarii 1989 (Prot. 368/89): confirmatur electio Sanctae Mariae Iosephae Rossello, virginis, Patronae apud Deum figulorum et artis figlinae peritorum regionis Liguriae.

target.institute: Societas parisiensis missionum ad exteras gentes

summary_en: Confirms two changes to the proper calendar of the Paris Foreign Missions Society: the Blessed Martyrs of China on 3 February as a memorial, and Sts Pierre Borie and Étienne Cuénot, bishops, Théophane Vénard, priest, and companions, martyrs of Vietnam, on 24 November as a memorial (the same protocol also confirms the French texts, p. 328).

Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Speyer (Germany), on 3 November each year as an optional memorial (the same protocol also grants the Mass and Office texts approved for Munich-Freising, p. 327).
excerpt: Spirensis, 1 martii 1989 (Prot. 1536/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: The Franciscan families of the French-speaking regions may add four optional memorials to their proper calendar: St Benedict the African, religious (4 April); the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Good Shepherd (Saturday before the Fourth Sunday of Easter); Blessed Frédéric Janssoone, priest (5 August); Blessed Antoine Chevrier, priest (3 October).

Confirms two changes to the calendar of the diocese of Gurk (Austria): St Valentine, martyr, on 14 February as an optional memorial, and Sts Cyril, monk, and Methodius, bishop, on 5 July as a feast (the same protocol also confirms the diocese's proper texts, p. 327).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Madonna del Pilerio»

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Madonna del Pilerio» as patroness before God of the archdiocese of Cosenza-Bisignano (Italy); no date is given on the page.
excerpt: Cosentina-Bisinianensis, 6 martii 1989 (Prot. 287/89): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «Madonna del Pilerio» Patronae apud Deum Archidioecesis Consentinae-Bisinianensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Nuestra Señora de la Concepción»

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Nuestra Señora de la Concepción» as patroness before God of the city of Utrera (archdiocese of Seville, Spain); a patron of a single town. The protocol is printed as «(38/89)» without the word Prot.
excerpt: Hispalensis, 7 martii 1989 (38/89): confirmantur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «Nuestra Señora de la Concepción» Patronae apud Deum civitatis vulgo dictae «Utrera».

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Ignatius Clemens Delgado, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Ignatius Clemente Delgado, priest and martyr, as patron before God of the missionaries of the archdiocese of Zaragoza (Spain); a patron of a category of persons, not of the archdiocese itself.
excerpt: Caesaraugustana, 9 martii 1989 (Prot. 360/89): confirmatur electio Sancti Ignatii Clementis Delgado, presbyteri et martyris, Patroni apud Deum missionariorum Archidioecesis Caesaraugustanae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Benedicta a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyr

summary_en: Blessed Teresa Benedicta of the Cross (Edith Stein), martyr, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the dioceses of the Netherlands, on 9 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Hollandiae dioeceses, 10 martii 1989 (Prot. 974/88): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce (Edith Stein), martyris, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 9 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Carolus a Sancto Andrea, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed Charles of St Andrew (Houben), priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Roermond (Netherlands), on 5 March each year as an optional memorial (the same protocol also confirms the Dutch collect, p. 327).
excerpt: Ruremundensis, 11 martii 1989 (Prot. 24/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Caroli a Sancto Andrea, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 martii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Blessed Honorat Koźmiński, priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the dioceses of Poland, on 13 October each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Poloniae dioeceses, 16 martii 1989 (Prot. 355/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Honorati Kozminski, presbyteri, in calendarium proprium dioecesium Poloniae inseri valeat, quotannis die 13 octobris gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Foederatio Monasteriorum «Adoratrici perpetue del SS. Sacramento» in Italia

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the Federation of monasteries «Adoratrici perpetue del SS. Sacramento» in Italy; the page prints only the institute, date and protocol number with no text of the act (the same protocol on p. 431 confirms the Italian text of its Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours), presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Foederatio Monasteriorum «Adoratrici perpetue del SS. Sacramento» in Italia, 31 martii 1989 (Prot. CD 71/89).

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the diocese of Quimper-Léon (France); the page prints only the diocese, date and protocol number with no text of the act (the same protocol on p. 430 confirms the French and Breton texts of the Proper of Masses), presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Corisopitensis-Leonensis, 4 aprilis 1989 (Prot. 526/88).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Franciscus Palau y Quer, presbyter

summary_en: The diocese of Lleida (Spain) may transfer the celebration of Blessed Francisco Palau y Quer, priest, from 20 March to 7 November.
excerpt: Illerdensis, 7 aprilis 1989 (Prot. CD 112/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Francisci Palau y Quer, presbyteri, a die 20 martii ad diem 7 novembris transferri possit.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Michaël Pius a Zerbo et socii, martyres

summary_en: Blessed Michele Pio Fasoli of Zerbo and companions, martyrs, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Pavia (Italy), on 20 November each year as an optional memorial (the same protocol also confirms the texts, p. 431).
excerpt: Papiensis, 12 aprilis 1989 (Prot. CD 146/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Michaëlis Pii a Zerbo et sociorum, martyrum, in calendarium proprium eiusdem dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 20 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Felix of Cantalice as patron before God of his native town (Cantalice) and as secondary patron of the whole diocese of Rieti (Italy); no date is given on the page.

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the archdiocese of Reggio Calabria-Bova (Italy); the page prints only the diocese, date and protocol number with no text of the act, presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Rheginensis-Bovensis, 29 maii 1989 (Prot. CD 260/89).

celebration.name_latin: Ss. Andreas Dung-Lac, presbyter, et socii, martyres

summary_en: By decree of 1 June 1989, by mandate of John Paul II, the celebration of the Vietnamese martyrs Sts Andrew Dung-Lac, priest, and companions (canonized 19 June 1988) is inserted into the General Roman Calendar on 24 November each year as an obligatory memorial, to be inscribed in all Ordines and in future liturgical books.
excerpt:
Instante quidem Episcoporum Coetu Vietnamensi, litteris die 12 aprilis 1989 datis, ut celebratio Sanctorum Martyrum Vietnamensium Andreae Dung-Lac, presbyteri et sociorum, Calendario Romano generali inscriberetur, Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria Sanctorum Martyrum Vietnamensium quotannis die 24 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae ab omnibus peragatur.
Nova igitur memoria cunctis Ordinibus pro Missae et Liturgiae Horarum celebratione erit inscribenda atque eius indicatio ponetur in libris liturgicis cura Conferentiarum Episcoporum in posterum edendis.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, Provincia Austriaca

summary_en: Decree 'De variatione inducenda in n. 5 Normarum universalium de anno liturgico et de calendario': solemnities occurring on the Sundays of Advent, Lent and Easter are no longer anticipated to the Saturday but transferred to the following Monday (or to the Monday after the Second Sunday of Easter when the occurrence is on Palm Sunday or Easter Sunday); particular calendars already prepared for 1991 may keep the previous solution. Norm to be observed by all henceforth.
excerpt:
« Propter suum peculiare momentum, dominica suam cedit celebrationem solummodo sollemnitatibus necnon festis Domini; dominicæ vero Adventus, Quadragesimæ et Paschæ super omnia festa Domini et super omnes sollemnitates præcedentiam habent. Sollemnitates autem in his dominicis occurrentes ad feriam secundam sequentem transferuntur, nisi agatur de occurrentia in Dominica in Palmis aut in Dominica Resurrectionis Domini ».
Ex ædibus Congregationis de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum, die 22 aprilis 1990, Dominica II Paschæ « in albis ».

The protocol is printed «13291330/94/L», apparently a misprint for 1329-1330/94/L (the text approvals for Cormier and Galand on pp. 304 and 307 carry Prot. 1329/94/L and 1330/94/L).

summary_en: Notification of the Congregation 'on some aspects of proper calendars and proper liturgical texts' (Notificazione su alcuni aspetti dei calendari e dei testi liturgici propri), signed 20 September 1997, no protocol printed. Operative rules: a celebration entered in a particular calendar keeps the day it has in the General Calendar even if its grade changes (n. 5); the Congregation will no longer grant transfers of General Calendar celebrations impeded in a particular calendar except for exceptional pastoral reasons affecting many faithful, and the impeded celebration is transferred rather than the impeding one (nn. 12-13); a solemnity grade for the principal diocesan patron is contrary to the Table of Liturgical Days and discouraged (n. 19); in a religious calendar only one of Title, Founder or principal Patron may be a solemnity, the other two being feasts, and a Blessed founder gets the grade of feast (n. 20); only one patron may be chosen under the 1973 Normae de Patronis (n. 21); new Blesseds should be entered only in geographically limited calendars, preferably as optional memorials (nn. 28-32); celebrations of religious institutes are not to be added to diocesan calendars (nn. 34-37).
excerpt:
NOTIFICAZIONE SU ALCUNI ASPETTI DEI CALENDARI E DEI TESTI LITURGICI PROPRI
12. Per il futuro, quindi, la Congregazione intende insistere di più sulla necessità di mantenere le celebrazioni del Calendario Generale al giorno loro assegnato, e di non concedere il trasferimento ad altro giorno delle celebrazioni impedienti, se non per motivi pastorali eccezionali, che interessino un considerevole numero di fedeli.
Memoria dei SS. Andrea Kim Taegon e Compagni, martiri, 20 settembre 1997. Jorge Medina Estévez, Arcivescovo Pro-Prefetto

summary_en: Notification of the Congregation for Divine Worship on the dedication or blessing of a church in honour of a Blessed: since the cult of Blesseds is limited to places where it is granted, the diocesan bishop may ask the Holy See to inscribe in the particular calendar a Blessed connected with the diocese, and where such a Blessed is legitimately inscribed in the particular calendar the bishop may dedicate a church in his honour without an indult; a general norm on church titles that is conditioned on the particular calendar, recorded for review.
excerpt:
1. Cum liturgicus Beatorum cultus tantum in locis et modis finitis conceditur, ut patet ex ipsa formula Beatificationis, Episcopo dioecesano competit, pro sua dioecesi, Apostolicam Sedem rogare ut in Calendario particulari quidam inscriptus sit Beatus qui in ipsa dioecesi habuit originem, longiorem commorationem, apostolicam actuositatem, obitum vel sepulturam.
2. In huiusmodi dioecesibus, ubi in Calendario particulari celebratio alicuius Beati legitime inscribitur, Episcopus dioecesanus ecclesiam, aedificatam vel aedificandam intra fines suae dioecesis, Deo dicare vel benedicere valet in honorem eiusdem Beati, sine Apostolicae Sedis indulto.

summary_en: Notification «De titulo ecclesiae»: general norms on the title of a church and on patrons; a church's title must be the Trinity, the Lord, the Holy Spirit, the Blessed Virgin, the holy angels or a Saint or Blessed inscribed in the Roman Martyrology (n. 2); only one title unless the Saints are inscribed together in the proper calendar (n. 3); a Blessed not yet inscribed in the legitimate diocesan calendar cannot be chosen as title without an indult (n. 4); a patron must be a created person, never the Trinity or a divine Person (n. 8); the election of a patron has liturgical effect only when confirmed by decree of this Congregation (n. 9); the patron of a place is distinct from a church's title (n. 10). Recorded as a general norm touching titular and patronal celebrations; review whether it belongs in the register.
excerpt: 9. Patronus eligendus est a clero et a fidelibus, quae electio approbanda est a competenti auctoritate ecclesiastica. Ut effectum liturgicum habeantur, electio et approbatio indigent confirmatione Congregationis de Culto Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum, quae decreto eiusdem Dicasterii conceditur.

summary_en: Notification «De cultu Beatorum»: general norms on the liturgical cult of Blesseds and their place in particular calendars: a Blessed's celebration is assigned to the dies natalis, or to the nearest free day when impeded (n. 5); in the particular calendar of a diocese, religious family or wider territory it is an optional memorial, an obligatory memorial in the church where the relics are kept, and the grade of feast is generally reserved to the founder in his institute's calendar (n. 6); only Blesseds of particular significance are to be inscribed in the whole diocese or institute (n. 7); a Blessed already inscribed in the particular calendar may be chosen as titular of a church without indult and is then celebrated there as a feast (n. 9); a Blessed may be chosen as patron of a place or association with confirmation of the Holy See (n. 10); Blesseds without a formal decree may be kept in a particular calendar marked with an asterisk (n. 14).
excerpt: 6. Celebratio cuiuslibet Beati in Calendario particulari dioecesis vel familiae religiosae vel in amplioris territorii legitime inscripti gradu memoriae ad libitum fit et gradu memoriae obligatoriae in ecclesia, in qua exuviae eius asservantur; gradus vero festi plerumque reservatur in Calendario Instituti religiosi Beato, qui illius Instituti fundator fuit.

summary_en: Eleven optional memorials are inserted into the General Roman Calendar on the occasion of the new Missale Romanum and Martyrologium Romanum: 3 Jan Most Holy Name of Jesus; 8 Feb St Josephine Bakhita; 13 May BVM of Fatima; 21 May Ss Christopher Magallanes and companions; 22 May St Rita of Cascia; 9 Jul Ss Augustine Zhao Rong and companions; 20 Jul St Apollinaris; 24 Jul St Sharbel Makhluf; 9 Aug St Teresa Benedicta of the Cross; 12 Sep Most Holy Name of Mary; 25 Nov St Catherine of Alexandria. Conferences may fix the starting date in their territory, not later than 1 January 2004.
excerpt: Cum gradu memoriae ad libitum erunt ideo peragenda: die 3 ianuarii, Ss. Nominis Iesu; die 8 februarii, S. Iosephinae Bakhita, virginis; die 13 maii, Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima; die 21 maii, Ss. Christophori Magallanes, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum; die 22 maii, S. Ritae de Cascia, religiosae; die 9 iulii, Ss. Augustini Zhao Rong, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum; die 20 iulii, S. Apollinaris, episcopi et martyris; die 24 iulii, S. Sarbelii Makhūf, presbyteri; die 9 augusti, S. Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, virginis et martyris; die 12 septembris, Ss. Nominis Beatae Virginis Mariae; die 25 novembris, S. Catharinae Alexandrinae, virginis et martyris.

summary_en: Decree promulgating the Martyrologium Romanum, editio typica altera (2004), followed by the full list of variations from the 2001 edition: emended praenotanda, 114 new elogia for 117 Saints and Blesseds (51 saints of ancient cult, 66 Blesseds beatified 7 Oct 2001 – 25 Apr 2004, plus the elogium of Our Lady of Guadalupe recently inserted in the General Calendar), 19 elogia set among the praetermissa, and 27 elogia moved to another day. The individual elogia are not itemised here.
excerpt:
Prot. N. 1140/04/L
DECRETUM
[…] Proinde Congregatio de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum editionem hanc alteram Martyrologii Romani vigore facultatum specialium a Summo Pontifice IOANNE PAULO PP. summary_en: Notification of the Congregation (no protocol printed; voted at the Ordinary session of 6 November 2006, approved by Benedict XVI on 7 December 2006, dated 25 December 2006) laying down nine criteria for inserting saints into the General Roman Calendar: the decision belongs to the Pope; a saint may be inserted for the significant universal importance of his or her spiritual message, with regard to geographical origin, historical epoch and state of life; normally at least ten years must have passed since canonization; the celebration must already be in the proper calendar of those entitled; the request comes from the Bishops' Conference of the place with a two-thirds vote (or directly from institutes of pontifical right and circumscriptions depending on the Holy See); the Congregation may consult at least three Conferences of different continents and proposes the grade of celebration. The introductory page (617) misprints the papal approval as 7 December 2007.
excerpt:
NOTIFICAZIONE
L'INSERIMENTO DI SANTI NEL CALENDARIO ROMANO GENERALE
1. Compete al Sommo Pontefice la decisione concernente l'inserimento di Santi nel Calendario Romano Generale. [...] 8. Spetta alla Congregazione di proporre il grado di celebrazione. [...] Dalla Sede della Congregazione per il Culto Divino e la Disciplina dei Sacramenti, il 25 dicembre 2006, Solennità del Natale del Signore.

summary_en: By the decree on the liturgical cult of Blessed John Paul II, pope, his celebration is inscribed on 22 October as a memorial in the proper calendar of the Diocese of Rome (the same decree does the same for all the dioceses of Poland, recorded as N2011-119-11-L-2); other particular calendars may petition the Congregation for an optional memorial. The Italian version (pp. 239-240) is dated by misprint '2 aprile 2001'.
excerpt: Disponitur, insuper, ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, in Calendario proprio Dioecesis Romanae seu Almae Urbis atque omnium Dioecesium Poloniae die 22 octobris gradu memoriae quotannis peragenda inscribatur.

summary_en: By the same decree on the liturgical cult of Blessed John Paul II, pope, his celebration is inscribed on 22 October as a memorial in the proper calendar of all the dioceses of Poland (the Polish national calendar is separately granted the memorial under Prot. 300/11/L, see N2011-300-11-L).
excerpt: Disponitur, insuper, ut celebratio Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, in Calendario proprio Dioecesis Romanae seu Almae Urbis atque omnium Dioecesium Poloniae die 22 octobris gradu memoriae quotannis peragenda inscribatur.

summary_en: The proper calendar of the archdiocese of Cosenza-Bisignano (Italy) is approved.

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Managua (Nicaragua) the feast of St Turibius of Mogrovejo, bishop (printed 'Beati Turibii'), may be transferred from 23 March to 27 April; the same protocol number is also printed for a Sant Feliu de Llobregat concession (N2011-299-11-L-2), so one of the two is a misprint.
excerpt: Managuensis, Nicaragua: ut festum Beati Turibii de Mogrovejo, episcopi, a die 23 martii ad diem 27 aprilis transferri valeat conceditur (8 apr. 2011; Prot. 299/11/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is granted to the national calendar of Poland on 22 October as a memorial (cf. the decree Prot. N. 119/11/L, N2011-119-11-L-2).
excerpt: Poloniae: 22 octobris, Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, memoria (11 apr. 2011; Prot. 300/11/L).

summary_en: The proper calendar of Lesotho is approved.
excerpt: Lesothi: Calendarium proprium (12 apr. 2011; Prot. 310/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Iosephus Tous y Soler, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed Josep Tous y Soler, priest, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of Sant Feliu de Llobregat (Spain) on 27 May as an optional memorial; the protocol number 299/11/L is also printed for the Managua transfer (N2011-299-11-L), so one of the two is a misprint.

summary_en: In the diocese of Trier (Germany) St Maximinus, bishop (29 May), St Paulinus, bishop (31 August) and St Willibrord, bishop (7 November) are celebrated as memorials; whether this is a new inscription or a change of rank is not stated (the same decree also transfers St Simeon, see N2011-307-11-L-2).

Insuper ut memoria ad libitum Sancti Simeonis a die 1 iunii ad diem 2 eiusdem mensis transferri valeat conceditur (9 maii 2011; Prot. 307/11/L).

summary_en: In the diocese of Trier (Germany) the optional memorial of St Simeon may be transferred from 1 June to 2 June.
excerpt: Insuper ut memoria ad libitum Sancti Simeonis a die 1 iunii ad diem 2 eiusdem mensis transferri valeat conceditur (9 maii 2011; Prot. 307/11/L).

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Paderborn (Germany) the memorial of St Mary Magdalene may be transferred from 22 July to 21 July.

summary_en: For the Spiritual Family 'The Work' the memorial of St Abraham, Patriarch, may be transferred from 9 October to 5 October.

summary_en: For the Congregation of the Daughters of Jesus, St Cándida María de Jesús Cipitria y Barriola (printed 'Burrida'), virgin and foundress, is celebrated on 9 August as a solemnity, and the celebration of St Teresa Benedicta of the Cross, virgin and martyr, is moved from that day to 17 August; two celebrations in one decree.
